entries.title: Kaldheim Citadels: 10 two-color realm land pools (150 cards)
entries.body:
Build 150 realm-themed pool cards across the 10 Kaldheim two-color lands
(Istfell/Starnheim/Axgard/Bretagard/Karfell/Surtland/Immersturm/Skemfar/
Gnottvold/Littjara), each keyed by landSet + led by a realm legendary.
Flip all 10 land taps conjure-named -> discover landSet. Add 10 pool tests
(37 checks each). Suite 251 -> 261.

entries.title: Build 5 Tarkir Dragonspire pools: Ojutai/Dromoka/Silumgar/Kolaghan/Atarka
entries.body:
75 uncollectible dual-color cards keyed by landSet Ojutai(W/U)/Dromoka(G/W)/
Silumgar(U/B)/Kolaghan(B/R)/Atarka(R/G) - the 5 Tarkir dragon-clan two-color lands:
- Ojutai (W/U): wisdom/dragons - Elusive flyers, draw/scry, Divine Shield, Freeze, control.
- Dromoka (G/W): endurance - big Trample, +1/+1 anthems, lifegain, Taunt, Warrior tokens, fight.
- Silumgar (U/B): control - Deathtouch, Elusive, discard, bounce, freeze, destroy.
- Kolaghan (B/R): speed - Rush/Charge haste, burn, Lifesteal, Rush-grant anthems.
- Atarka (R/G): ferocity - big Trample beasts, haste, burn (targeted/AoE/face), +stats.

Fixed 5 dragonspire taps: conjure-named -> discover landSet. Built via build_dragonspires.mjs.
5 new pool tests (37 each; dragonspire land id + dual-color patch). Suite 246 -> 251.

entries.title: Build 5 Strixhaven Campus pools: Silverquill/Prismari/Witherbloom/Quandrix/Lorehold
entries.body:
75 uncollectible dual-color cards keyed by landSet Silverquill(W/B)/Prismari(U/R)/
Witherbloom(B/G)/Quandrix(G/U)/Lorehold(R/W) - the 5 Strixhaven college two-color lands,
themed to each college:
- Silverquill (W/B): eloquence/inklings - lifedrain, Inkling(Elusive) tokens, +1/+1, silence, removal.
- Prismari (U/R): elemental art - burn (targeted/AoE), draw/scry, Elusive elementals, ramp.
- Witherbloom (B/G): life & death - Deathtouch, drain/lifegain, Pest tokens, big beasts, removal.
- Quandrix (G/U): fractals - ramp, +1/+1, Fractal tokens, heavy draw/scry, big Elusive/Trample.
- Lorehold (R/W): history/spirits - go-wide Spirit tokens, Rush/Charge, buffs, Divine Shield, burn.

Fixed 5 campus taps: conjure-named -> discover landSet. Built via build_strixhaven.mjs.
5 new pool tests (37 each) - NOTE: campus tests need land id `<x>_campus` (not temple_of_)
+ landSet-tag check (Killian/Kianne use real names, not the college). Suite 241 -> 246.

entries.title: Build Theros temple pools batch 3 (final): Pharika/Xenagos/Klothys
entries.body:
45 uncollectible dual-color cards keyed by landSet Pharika(B/G)/Xenagos(R/G)/
Klothys(R/G) - completes all 11 two-color Theros god-temples.
- Pharika (B/G): affliction - Deathtouch/Poisonous snakes, Lifesteal drain, big beasts,
  recursion, discard, board-clear + lifegain.
- Xenagos (R/G): revels - Rush/Charge haste, Trample beasts, Satyr tokens, +stats/haste
  anthems, huge trampler.
- Klothys (R/G): destiny - ramp (gain-mana), Trample, Fight (Calix), burn, +1/+1 anthems.

Fixed 3 temple taps: conjure-named -> discover landSet. Built via build_theros3c.mjs.
3 new pool tests (37 each); suite 238 -> 241. All 11 two-color Theros temples now built.

entries.title: Build Theros temple pools batch 2: Phenax/Keranos/Kruphix/Mogis
entries.body:
60 uncollectible dual-color cards keyed by landSet Phenax(U/B)/Keranos(U/R)/
Kruphix(G/U)/Mogis(B/R), Theros-flavored to each god:
- Phenax (U/B): deception - Elusive/Deathtouch, discard, freeze, bounce, removal, Reborn.
- Keranos (U/R): storms - burn (targeted/AoE/face), draw/scry, Elusive, Windfury.
- Kruphix (G/U): horizons - ramp (gain-mana), heavy draw/scry, big Elusive/Trample, +1/+1.
- Mogis (B/R): slaughter - Rush/Charge haste, burn, Lifesteal drain, aggressive anthems.

Fixed 4 temple taps: conjure-named -> discover landSet. Built via build_theros4b.mjs
(spliced before bant_citadel). 4 new pool tests (37 each); suite 234 -> 238.

entries.title: Build 4 two-color Theros temple pools: Ephara/Athreos/Iroas/Karametra
entries.body:
First batch of the 11 two-color Theros god-temples (the white-paired ones). 60
uncollectible dual-color cards keyed by landSet Ephara(W/U)/Athreos(W/B)/Iroas(R/W)/
Karametra(G/W), Theros-flavored to each god:
- Ephara (W/U): order + tempo - Divine Shield/Taunt/Elusive, draw/scry, bounce, Soldier tokens.
- Athreos (W/B): passage/death - Lifesteal drain, Deathtouch, Reborn recursion, discard, removal.
- Iroas (R/W): victory/combat - Rush/Charge/First Strike, buff+haste, weapons, burn, Divine Shield.
- Karametra (G/W): harvest - Elephant/Saproling tokens, ramp (gain-mana), +1/+1, lifegain, big Taunt.

Fixed all 4 temple taps: conjure-named match -> discover landSet. Pool cards built via
scratchpad/build_theros4.mjs (spliced before bant_citadel; re-serialize preserved the
existing 2-space format - clean +60-card diff). 4 new pool tests (37 each); suite 230 -> 234.

entries.title: Build Simic (G/U) guildgate pool (15 cards) - completes all 10 guildgates
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color G/U cards keyed by landSet:"Simic". Simic identity =
green big-creatures/ramp/counters + blue card-advantage/evasion: +1/+1 "graft/evolve"
buffs (Ascendancy anthem, Charm, Initiate/Fluxmage/Guildmage/Manipulator/Growth Chamber),
big evasive/Trample bodies (Sky Swallower 6/6 Elusive+Trample, Ragworm, Basilisk
Deathtouch, Keyrune Elusive Crab), card draw (Momir Vig, Guildmage, Cluestone, Locket),
ramp (Signet, Locket, Growth Chamber). All real Ravnica Simic cards.

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Simic" -> discover landSet:"Simic".
New suite simic_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + G/U dual-color patch).
Full suite 229 -> 230. ALL 10 two-color guildgates now built (150 guild cards).

entries.title: Build Boros (R/W) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color R/W cards keyed by landSet:"Boros". Boros identity =
red aggression/haste + white go-wide/combat: Rush/First Strike/Windfury aggressors
(Elite, Recruit, Mastiff, Swiftblade, Challenger), Battlecry anthems + Rush grants
(Razia, Battleshaper, Challenger mentor), soldier tokens (Garrison, Keyrune), burn
(Charm 4-to-creature, Guildmage, Fury-Shield 3-to-face), Taunt/First Strike wall
(Reckoner), Divine Shield angel (Razia).

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Boros" -> discover landSet:"Boros".
New suite boros_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + R/W dual-color patch).
Full suite 228 -> 229.

entries.title: Build Izzet (U/R) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color R/U cards keyed by landSet:"Izzet". Izzet identity =
blue card-advantage/tempo + red burn: targeted burn (Charm, Guildmage, Ral, Command,
Electroblast), board burn (Staticaster ping, Niv-Mizzet 4-to-all + draw), heavy card
draw (Chemister, Chronarch, Inventor, Melek, Cluestone, Locket), Elusive drakes/weirds
(Niv-Mizzet, Melek, Inventor, Keyrune elemental), ramp (Signet, Locket).

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Izzet" -> discover landSet:"Izzet".
New suite izzet_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + R/U dual-color patch).
Full suite 227 -> 228.

entries.title: Build Orzhov (W/B) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color B/W cards keyed by landSet:"Orzhov". Orzhov identity =
white protection/lifegain + black death/drain: Lifesteal drain (Obzedat, Kaya, Teysa,
Advisor, Ghost Drake, Cleric, Keyrune Spirit), life-loss to face (Obzedat/Guildmage/
Gift Battlecry drains), removal (Kaya destroy, Charm destroy-small, Pontiff -1/-1 sweep),
Deathtouch (Teysa, Enforcer), Taunt walls, discard (Racketeers), lifegain (Advokist).

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Orzhov" -> discover landSet:"Orzhov".
New suite orzhov_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + B/W dual-color patch).
Full suite 226 -> 227.

entries.title: Build Selesnya (G/W) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color G/W cards keyed by landSet:"Selesnya". Selesnya identity =
green big-creatures/ramp + white go-wide/protection/lifegain: token swarm (Evangel,
Eulogist, Gardener, Charm, Keyrune Saprolings/Wolf), +1/+1 anthems (Guildmage, Bloom
Hulk, Emmara +DivineShield), Taunt/Divine Shield walls (Sentry, Guardian, Trostani),
lifegain (Trostani), a board-ping archer (Sagittar), ramp (Signet, Locket), draw.

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Selesnya" -> discover landSet:"Selesnya".
New suite selesnya_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + G/W dual-color patch).
Full suite 225 -> 226.

entries.title: Build Gruul (R/G) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color G/R cards keyed by landSet:"Gruul". Gruul identity =
red aggression/haste + green big-creatures/ramp: Trample beaters (Borborygmos 7/6,
War Plow, Nodorog, Ruric Thar, Ragebeast), Rush/riot haste (Spellbreaker, Scrapper,
Ruric Thar, Guildmage/War Chant grants), Fight (Ragebeast Battlecry), aggressive
anthems (Beastmaster, War Chant), AoE (Borborygmos Battlecry 3 to all enemy creatures),
ramp (Signet, Locket), Trample beast tokens (Keyrune, Charm pump).

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Gruul" -> discover landSet:"Gruul".
New suite gruul_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + G/R dual-color patch).
Full suite 224 -> 225.

entries.title: Build Golgari (B/G) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color B/G cards keyed by landSet:"Golgari". Golgari identity =
black death/recursion + green big-creatures: Deathtouch everywhere (Jarad, Vraska,
Savra, Decoy, Longlegs, Guildmage-grant, Germination/Keyrune tokens), Trample beaters
(Grave-Troll 6/6, Rotwurm, Raider, Jarad), Lifesteal drain (Savra, Rotwurm), Reborn
recursion (Findbroker), lifegain (Brownscale), removal (Vraska destroy, Charm -1/-1
sweep = 1 to all enemy creatures), card draw.

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Golgari" -> discover landSet:"Golgari".
New suite golgari_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + B/G dual-color patch).
Full suite 223 -> 224.

entries.title: Delete the "Assemble a Contraption" demo card
entries.body:
Removed the collectible neutral demo sorcery (assemble_a_contraption) per request;
the Assemble mechanic is still exercised via E.assemble() directly and the real
contraptions (Widget/Hard Hat Area). Dropped its now-stale sprocket_test assertion.
No art was associated. Suite stays 223 green.

entries.title: Build Rakdos (B/R) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color B/R cards keyed by landSet:"Rakdos". Rakdos identity =
red aggression/burn + black sacrifice/drain: haste beaters (Cackler/Trumpeter/
Shred-Freak Rush, Exava/Pit Dragon/Lord Charge), Lifesteal demons (Lord of Riots,
Defiler), burn (Charm, Guildmage, Firewheeler face+creature, Showstopper board wipe
= damage all-creatures), aggressive anthem, a weapon (Riteknife), Cleave dragon.

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Rakdos" -> discover landSet:"Rakdos".
New suite rakdos_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + B/R dual-color patch).
Full suite 222 -> 223.

entries.title: Build Dimir (U/B) guildgate pool (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color U/B cards keyed by landSet:"Dimir". Dimir identity =
blue tempo/card-advantage + black death/disruption: Elusive "unblockable" infiltrators
(Infiltrator, House Guard, Cutpurse, Spybug), hand disruption (Circu, Guildmage,
Cutpurse, Machinations = enemy-discard), Deathtouch assassins (Lazav, Doppelganger,
Keyrune token), card selection (Informant scry+draw, Cluestone, Machinations), ramp
(Signet, Locket), and small-creature removal (Charm = destroy maxAttack 3).

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Dimir" -> discover landSet:"Dimir".
New suite dimir_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; guildgate id + U/B dual-color patch).
Full suite 221 -> 222.

entries.title: Build Azorius (W/U) guildgate pool - first two-color land (15 cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible dual-color W/U cards keyed by landSet:"Azorius" - the first
two-color guildgate pool (mono temples were the template; Abzan is the 3-color one).
Azorius identity = white order/protection + blue tempo/card-advantage: Elusive flyers
(Sphinx, Skyguard, Herald), detain via Freeze (Guildmage, Arrester, Justiciar mass),
Divine Shield/Taunt walls (Lavinia, Knight), card draw + lifegain + ramp (Charm, Ploy,
Signet, Cluestone, Locket), a token-maker (Keyrune), and a bounce+draw control finisher
(Arbiter). All proven primitives from the white + blue palettes.

Fixed the guildgate tap: conjure-named match:"Azorius" -> discover landSet:"Azorius"
(the guildgate already has W+U boost taps, so its color identity is unchanged).

New suite azorius_pool_test.mjs (37 checks; patched from the mono template for the
guildgate id + dual-color W/U check). Full suite 220 -> 221.

entries.title: Build green temples: Nylea + Rhonas pools (30 mono-green cards)
entries.body:
Two mono-G advanced-land pools keyed by landSet:"Nylea"/"Rhonas" - completes all
10 mono-color Theros/Amonkhet temples.
- Nylea (the hunt): Trample beasts, +1/+1 anthems, ramp (gain-mana), beast tokens,
  Deathtouch vipers, Fight removal (Omen), lifegain.
- Rhonas (strength): huge Trample bodies (Wurm 8/8, Stalwart 7/7, Hydra), big +stats
  buffs, Fight (Trial), a rare Destroy (Hour of Glory), ramp dorks. God = Deathtouch
  + Trample + team +2/+2 anthem.

Green identity: trample/deathtouch keywords, buff (single + friendly-creatures anthem),
fight (green removal), gain-mana ramp, big Beast/Wurm summons - all proven primitives
(skipped adapt's pick-heavy UI). Fixed both temple taps: conjure-named -> discover landSet.

New suites nylea_pool_test.mjs + rhonas_pool_test.mjs (37 each); full suite 218 -> 220.

entries.title: Build red temples: Hazoret + Purphoros pools (30 mono-red cards)
entries.body:
Two mono-R advanced-land pools keyed by landSet:"Hazoret"/"Purphoros".
- Hazoret (zeal/warriors/haste): Rush/Charge/First Strike/Cleave bodies, haste-grant
  buffs, warrior tokens, weapons (Flameblade, Spear), burn.
- Purphoros (forge/burn): direct damage (targeted, AoE, face), Cleave/Rush creatures,
  Rush-grant anthems, a Golem-maker, a weapon (Magmaforge). God = Battlecry burn both
  the opponent and their board.

Red identity: rush/charge/windfury/first_strike/cleave keywords, damage (creature/
enemy-creatures/enemy-heroes/any), grant of haste via buff, weapon cards (attack+
durability) - all proven primitives. Fixed both temple taps: conjure-named -> discover landSet.

New suites hazoret_pool_test.mjs + purphoros_pool_test.mjs (37 each); full suite 216 -> 218.

entries.title: Build black temples: Erebos + Bontu pools (30 mono-black cards)
entries.body:
Two mono-B advanced-land pools keyed by landSet:"Erebos"/"Bontu".
- Erebos (god of the dead): drain, Deathtouch, Lifesteal, Reborn undeath, Zombie
  tokens, discard, removal. 12/15 real Theros cards + Omen (invented) + reflavored
  Scourgemark/Hymn.
- Bontu (ambition/sacrifice): drain, board wipe (Last Reckoning = destroy-all),
  destroy+value "sacrifice" spells, Deathtouch swarm, Lifesteal. 2 real (God-Eternal
  Bontu, Last Reckoning) + 13 themed/invented.

Black identity: lifesteal (drain), deathtouch, reborn, deathrattle, damage to
enemy-heroes (drain), destroy / destroy-all, enemy-discard, Zombie/Insect summons -
all proven primitives. Fixed both temple taps: conjure-named match -> discover landSet.

New suites erebos_pool_test.mjs + bontu_pool_test.mjs (37 each); full suite 214 -> 216.

entries.title: Build blue temples: Thassa + Kefnet pools (30 mono-blue cards)
entries.body:
Two mono-U advanced-land pools keyed by landSet:"Thassa"/"Kefnet".
- Thassa (sea god): tempo/card-draw/scry, Elusive sea creatures, freeze, bounce.
  12/15 are real Theros cards (God of the Sea, Bident, Kenessos, Ordeal, Bounty,
  Devourer, Emissary, Intervention, Ire, Oracle, Rebuff, Tidal Wave) + 3 invented
  (Mystic, Leviathan, Serpent).
- Kefnet (knowledge god): heavy card-draw/scry, Elusive flyers, bounce/freeze.
  3/15 real (God-Eternal Kefnet, Last Word, Cartouche of Knowledge) + 12 invented.

Blue identity uses Elusive (evasion), scry, draw, freeze (enemy-creatures / single),
bounce (enemy-creature) - all proven primitives. "Counter target spell" isn't an
effect (counters are Secrets), so Rebuff/Rebuke/Last Word reflavored to bounce tempo.
Fixed both temple taps: conjure-named match -> discover landSet.

New suites thassa_pool_test.mjs + kefnet_pool_test.mjs (37 each); full suite 212 -> 214.

entries.title: Oketra pool tweaks: Initiate Deathrattle, Truth duplicate, Invocation wording
entries.body:
- Oketra's Initiate: add "Deathrattle: Planeshift" (deathrattle:[{planeshift}] +
  deathrattle keyword) — on death it shifts the arena to a new plane.
- Oketra's Truth: discover now carries duplicate:true, so you get 2 copies of the
  discovered card.
- Oketra's Invocation: reworded to "Creatures you control gain Reborn."

oketra_pool_test.mjs +4 checks (Initiate dies to combat -> planeshift fires;
Truth pend has duplicate flag -> 2 copies land in hand). Suite stays 212 green.

entries.title: Build Temple of Oketra advanced-land pool (15 mono-white cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible mono-W "Oketra" cards keyed by landSet:"Oketra", same pattern as
Heliod/Abzan. Amonkhet white-god identity: order, +1/+1 anthems, First Strike, go-wide
soldier/zombie/cat tokens, Reborn (embalm/eternalize), lifegain. Real cards adapted
(God-Eternal Oketra, Attendant, Avenger, Last Mercy) + themed ones (Caracal=Regal
Caracal, Cartouche=Cartouche of Solidarity, Trial=Trial of Solidarity) + invented
(Invocation/Truth/Solidarity/Light Arrow/Initiate/Command/Charm/Vindication).

Uses only proven effect primitives (buff single & friendly-creatures w/ grant of
first_strike/divine_shield/reborn, summon w/ keywords, heal, discover landSet, destroy
w/ minAttack). Fixed the temple tap: conjure-named match -> discover landSet:"Oketra"
(name-match conjure filters out collectible:false pool cards).

New regression suite oketra_pool_test.mjs (37 checks); full suite 211 -> 212 green.

entries.title: Build Temple of Heliod advanced-land pool (15 mono-white cards)
entries.body:
15 uncollectible mono-W "Heliod" cards keyed by landSet:"Heliod", the way Abzan
is built. Faithful adaptations of the Theros Heliod cards: gods (Divine Shield +
token/lifesteal battlecries), anthems (Dictate, Spear), auras (Chosen, Punishment,
Ordeal), tutors (Pilgrim, Intervention, Generosity), go-wide (Evangel), plus 3
invented white cards (Radiant Dawn, Warped Eclipse, Betrayal) to round out 15.

Fixed the temple's tap: switched conjure-named match:"Heliod" -> discover
landSet:"Heliod". The name-match conjure path filters out collectible:false cards
(handlers-copy.js:1211), so the pool would have been invisible; the landSet branch
intentionally includes uncollectible pool members. Now the land Discovers its pool.

New regression suite heliod_pool_test.mjs: pool is exactly 15, all mono-W/uncollectible,
each plays without throwing and leaves valid state, and the temple discover offers only
Heliod cards. Full suite 210 -> 211 green.

entries.title: Keywords: fix stale Enrich tooltip; dedupe Investigate/Cook
entries.body:
Investigate, Enrich, and Cook are already keyworded (engine effects + glossary).
But: Enrich's tooltip still described the old Treasure Token ("Sacrifice: gain 1
mana") — updated to the current 3-way choice. And Investigate/Cook each had a
duplicate glossary entry — removed the redundant ones (kept the tagged primary).
Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Keywords: add Overkill, Dormant, Silence, Forgetful tooltips
entries.body:
Four engine-backed mechanics appeared on cards without a glossary entry (so no
bold/tooltip in the gallery, wiki, or in-game face): Overkill (~10 cards),
Dormant (~66), Silence (~37), Forgetful (1). Added glossary entries; bumped
gallery ?v so the tooltips refresh.

entries.title: Packs / deck builder / game: revalidate cards.json on every load
entries.body:
The packs page, deck builder, and in-game card DB fetched cards.json with no
cache-bust, so a returning visitor could keep a stale copy and not see newly
added cards. Switched to fetch('cards.json', {cache:'no-cache'}) — the browser
revalidates against the server each load (304 if unchanged, fresh after a
deploy), so new cards appear instantly for everyone with no ?v to bump.

entries.title: Add Offworld Vermin (3/4 Alien Beast, Taunt/Venomous, Deathrattle: Static)
entries.body:
New collectible common neutral creature: 3-cost 3/4 Alien Beast with Taunt,
Venomous, and Deathrattle: grant a creature you control Static (reuses the
grant-target target-a-creature pick). All keywords already exist. Art wired
(art/offworld_vermin.jpg, the 294x218 art-window crop; deployed via wrangler).

Verified: 3/4 with the three keywords, Deathrattle grants Static. Suite 210 green.

entries.title: Tomb of Annihilation: one line into the final room
entries.body:
Both branches now converge at Sandfall Cell before the payoff: Oubliette ->
Sandfall Cell (was -> Cradle). So only Sandfall Cell points at Cradle of the
Death God, and the flowchart shows a single line into the last room instead of
two. Still 5 rooms; the dungeon walks to completion via either branch.

dungeon_test 22/22 (it walks the Veils path, unaffected). Suite 210 green.
Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Contraptions: Jamming Device text; Genetic Recombinator cross-swap
entries.body:
- Jamming Device -> "Contraption: Freeze all creatures you don't control"
  (text; it already freezes enemy-creatures).
- Genetic Recombinator -> "A random creature you control swaps stats with a
  random creature you don't control". New `swap-stats-cross` effect: swaps
  attack/current-health between a random friendly and a random enemy creature
  (auto, no-op if either side is empty).

Tests: sprocket_test +1 (5/1 friendly and 1/5 enemy swap to 1/5 and 5/1);
effect count 1112 -> 1113. Suite 210 green; AI sim clean. Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Contraptions: Hard Hat Area text; Inflation Station now targets
entries.body:
- Hard Hat Area -> "Contraption: Assemble twice." (text).
- Inflation Station -> "Contraption: Target creature gains +3/+3", now targeted:
  new `buff-target` effect {attack,health} -> buffCreatureChoice (core.js), a
  lone creature auto-gets it, 2+ opens a buff-target pick; resolvePick branch +
  game.js modal; AI resolves via the generic pick path.

Tests: sprocket_test +3 (lone-creature auto, 2-creature target pick, Division
1v1); effect count 1111 -> 1112. Suite 210 green; AI sim clean. Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Contraption reword: Boomflinger / Division Table / Arms Depot
entries.body:
- Boomflinger -> "Each opponent loses 3 life" (text; it already hits every
  opponent via enemy-heroes).
- Division Table -> "Target player loses 2 life", now genuinely targeted:
  target-player gained a `damage` action (applyPlayerAction -> damageHero),
  auto in 1v1, a pick in a free-for-all. Modal shows "loses N life".
- Arms Depot -> "Bolster 2".

Test: sprocket_test +1 (Division Table 1v1 auto-damage). Suite 210 green; AI
sim clean. Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Hypnotic Swirly Disc + Insufferable Syphon: choose which player
entries.body:
Both now genuinely target a player: auto in 1v1, a pick among opponents in a
free-for-all (matching the descriptions). New `target-player` effect
{action:'mill'|'discard', value} -> targetOpponent() (core.js): 1 opponent
auto-applies, 2+ opens a pick; resolvePick 'target-player' + a game.js modal;
AI resolves via the generic pick path. mill/enemy-discard handlers gained an
`e.player` option to hit a chosen player.

Tests: sprocket_test +4 (1v1 auto mill/discard, 3-player pick targets only the
chosen opponent); effect count 1110 -> 1111. Suite 210 green; AI sim clean.
Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Contraptions: Turbo-Thwacking targets (not random); reword 4 descriptions
entries.body:
- Turbo-Thwacking Auto-Hammer now lets YOU pick the creature that gains Windfury
  instead of a random one. New `grant-target` effect: when a contraption fires it,
  a lone creature auto-gets the keyword; with 2+ it opens a target pick
  (grantKeywordToChoice + resolvePick 'grant-target' + a game.js pick modal; the
  AI resolves via the generic pick path). Description -> "Contraption: Target
  creature you control gains Windfury."
- Reworded: Widget "Contraption: Assemble.", Hypnotic Swirly Disc "Contraption:
  Target player mills 2.", Insufferable Syphon "Contraption: Target player
  discards a card."

Tests: sprocket_test +1 (lone-creature auto vs 2-creature target pick);
effect count 1109 -> 1110. Suite 210 green; AI sim clean. Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Add Exuberant Conspirator (3/2 Elf, Battlecry: Advance / Deathrattle: Planeshift)
entries.body:
New collectible uncommon neutral creature: 2-cost 3/2 Elf. Battlecry: Advance
(venture a dungeon on play); Deathrattle: Planeshift (shift the arena to a random
plane on death). Both are existing keywords/effects, so the description shows both
tooltips. Art wired (battlecards/art/exuberant_conspirator.jpg, deployed via wrangler).

Verified: 3/2 summon, Battlecry queues the dungeon pick, Deathrattle shifts the
plane. Suite 210 green (no fragile-test regression from the deck-RNG shift).

entries.title: In-game dungeon panel with a "you are here" marker
entries.body:
While you're venturing (p.dungeon set), a fixed left-side panel shows your
dungeon's flowchart card with the current room highlighted, plus the room name.
updateDungeonPanel() (called from updateHud) renders the type:"dungeon" card via
drawCardFace(card, {currentRoom}); it redraws only when the room changes and
hides when you're not in a dungeon. Reuses the drawDungeonFace currentRoom
highlight built for the cards. Verified the data path end-to-end headlessly
(advance -> pick -> p.dungeon -> dungeon card + room resolve).

entries.title: Dungeon cards: procedural room-flowchart face + wiki visuals
entries.body:
Each Advance dungeon is now a no-cost type:"dungeon" card (lost_mine, tomb,
mad_mage; uncollectible) whose face is a room flowchart drawn procedurally from
engine/dungeons.js:
- cardart.js drawDungeonFace(): lays rooms out by longest-path depth (rows) with
  branch columns, draws arrows between rooms, room name + effect text per node,
  START / ★-payoff badges, per-dungeon theming, and an optional "you are here"
  highlight (currentRoom) for future in-game use. drawCardFace dispatches on
  type:"dungeon".
- designwiki Advance Dungeons section now renders each dungeon's flowchart card
  face beside its readable room breakdown. (The cards also appear in the gallery.)

All procedural from the game's own data — no external images. Suite 210 green
(dungeon cards are uncollectible, so no deck-RNG shift). Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Contraptions: real Scryfall art; drop the "(MTG Unstable)" label
entries.body:
- Fetched each of the 21 Contraptions' art_crop from Scryfall (t:contraption),
  cropped to the 294x218 art window, saved to battlecards/art/<id>.jpg, and
  registered in art/index.json (deployed via wrangler).
- Removed "(MTG Unstable)" from all 21 Contraption card descriptions and from
  the designwiki Contraptions blurb.
- Bumped designwiki ?v (20260831 -> 20260832).

entries.title: Add Merciless Innovator (2/2 Gnome, Battlecry: Assemble)
entries.body:
New common neutral creature: 2-cost 2/2 Gnome named Merciless Innovator with
"Battlecry: Assemble" (assembles a random Contraption on play). Art wired
(battlecards/art/merciless_innovator.jpg, 294x218; registered in art/index.json,
deployed via wrangler).

Also hardened ffa_duel_test: adding any collectible card shifts createGame's RNG
stream, which changed a start-of-game shuffle in seat 0's deck (king_llane, a
GENERATED card). The deck-contamination check now only flags real deckbuildable
strays, ignoring generated/shuffled-in cards. Suite 210 green.

entries.title: Color identity for players: show it in the HUD (display only)
entries.body:
Surfaces each player's live color identity (the WUBRG colors their current
lands can produce, per E.colorIdentity) as small colored dots:
- the human's, in the always-visible mana readout (#mana-hud)
- each opponent's, in their panel

Display only, per request — no casting restriction; the identity still gates
land upgrades + scarcity as before. Updated every HUD refresh, so pips appear
/ disappear as lands are developed, upgraded, or sacrificed.

entries.title: Remove Double Strike; Turbo-Thwacking grants Windfury instead
entries.body:
Per request, Double Strike is not wanted in the game. Reverted the combat
primitive entirely (removed the DOUBLE_STRIKE keyword, restored resolveCombat's
original first-strike-only logic, dropped the glossary entry, deleted
double_strike_test.mjs). Turbo-Thwacking Auto-Hammer now grants Windfury (attack
twice this turn) — an existing keyword — reusing the same `grant` effect.

sprocket_test.mjs: the Turbo-Thwacking check now asserts a Windfury grant.
Suite 210 green; AI sim clean. Gallery ?v bumped.

entries.title: Double Strike combat primitive; port Turbo-Thwacking Auto-Hammer
entries.body:
New hard-tier primitive: the DOUBLE_STRIKE keyword. A creature with double
strike deals its combat damage TWICE — it strikes first (first-strike timing)
then strikes again, so it can kill a defender before taking a hit back. Built
into the creature-combat block alongside the existing first-strike handling
(double strike implies first-strike ordering + a second strike; the both-have-
it edge is handled in the simultaneous branch). Existing first-strike behavior
is unchanged.

Ports the hard-tier contraption:
- Turbo-Thwacking Auto-Hammer -> grant a friendly creature Double Strike
  (reuses `grant`, which auto-blesses a random friendly when untargeted).

keywords.js: Double Strike glossary + gallery ?v bump. Test:
double_strike_test.mjs (8 checks: two hits, kill-before-retaliation, survivor
takes one retaliation, first-strike regression, the contraption grant). Suite
210 -> 211 green; AI sim clean. Contraption roster now 21.

entries.title: Add random-enemy-creature damage target; port Thud-for-Duds
entries.body:
New engine primitive: `{type:'damage', target:'random-enemy', value:N, count?}`
hits N random enemy creatures (distinct when count > 1) — added as a case in the
damage handler's target switch, mirroring freeze's random-enemy.

Ports the last easy-ish contraption:
- Thud-for-Duds -> deal 3 to a random enemy creature (was 2d6-difference).

Contraption roster now 20. sprocket_test.mjs: targeted check that the primitive
lands 3 on an enemy creature, plus the fire-all sweep. Suite 210 green; AI sim clean.

entries.title: Contraptions: port the medium batch (10 more, 19 total)
entries.body:
Ported 10 more MTG (Unstable) contraptions that convert with a small
approximation, all auto-resolving:

- Boomflinger -> enemy hero loses 3
- Dogsnail Engine -> gain 3 life
- Rapid Prototyper -> summon a 2/2 Construct
- Gift Horse -> summon two 1/1 Goblins
- Faerie Aerie -> summon two 1/1 Faeries (drops the flying/draw/exile rider)
- Genetic Recombinator -> +2/+2 to your two weakest (two bolsters)
- Jamming Device -> freeze the enemy's creatures (approximates -1/-1)
- Hypnotic Swirly Disc -> enemy mills 2
- Record Store -> Scry 2
- Hard Hat Area -> Assemble two random Contraptions

Skipped Thud-for-Duds (damage has no random-enemy-creature auto target) and the
hard tier (grant-ability / copy / block-forcing / tap-untap / graveyard / type-
changing). sprocket_test.mjs now fires EVERY contraption once to catch bad effect
shapes (41 checks). Suite 210 green; 10-game AI sim clean.

entries.title: Contraptions: port 9 clean MTG (Unstable) contraptions
entries.body:
Replaced the 6 placeholders with 9 real MTG contraptions whose "whenever you
crank" effect auto-resolves (no targeting), matching how Magepunk contraptions
fire. All 0-cost, uncollectible, contraption:true.

- Division Table -> enemy hero loses 2
- Insufferable Syphon -> enemy hero discards a card
- Sap Sucker -> gain 1 mana this turn
- Widget Contraption -> Assemble a random Contraption (thematic self-reference)
- Arms Depot -> +2/+2 to your weakest creature (bolster)
- Inflation Station -> +3/+3 to your weakest creature (bolster)
- Gnomeball Machine -> summon two 1/1 Gnome Mechs
- Dispatch Dispensary -> summon a 2/2 Rogue
- Goblin Slingshot -> your creatures get +1/+0

MTG targeted "target creature" buffs map to bolster (auto weakest); "target
player" maps to the enemy hero. cards.json edited via localized text-splice
(no reformat). sprocket_test.mjs updated to the new ids (22 checks). Suite 210
green; 10-game AI sim clean (incl. Widget's assemble-on-crank chaining).

entries.title: Sprocket: contraptions stay put; a cycling indicator fires them
entries.body:
Reworked per feedback: Contraptions no longer shift between slots. They STAY
in the slot you placed them, and a visible indicator cycles 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1
each of your turns, firing whatever Contraption sits in the slot it lands on.
So a Contraption fires each time the indicator comes back around to it, and
the slot you choose sets how many ticks until the indicator first reaches it.

- core.js: per-player sprocketPointer (0->1->2->0); crankSprocket fires the
  pointed slot (Contraption persists) then advances the pointer; contraptionEta()
  helper. Replaces the old fire-slot-1-then-shift model.
- game.js: a gold ring indicator (makeRing) marks the human's active slot and
  cycles with the pointer; Assemble modal shows each slot's real ETA + marks the
  pointed slot. Contraptions render in fixed slots.
- keywords.js: Assemble/Contraption tooltips updated to the indicator model.

Test: sprocket_test.mjs reworked (21 checks: persistence, re-fire on cycle,
pointer cycling, ETA). Suite 210 green; AI sim clean. Bumped gallery ?v.

entries.title: Sprocket + Contraptions: Assemble mechanic
entries.body:
Adds the Sprocket (3 Contraption slots per player) and the Assemble keyword.

- Assemble grants a RANDOM Contraption; you choose which slot it goes in
  (overwriting whatever's there). Slot 1 fires at the start of your next turn,
  slot 2 the turn after, slot 3 the turn after that.
- At each of your turn-starts the Contraption in slot 1 activates once and is
  removed, then the slots advance (2 -> 1, 3 -> 2).

Engine (core.js): per-player `sprocket:[null,null,null]`; assemble() (random
roll + slot pick), placeContraption() (overwrite), crankSprocket() wired into
the turn-start sequence; resolvePick 'assemble' branch. Snapshotted wholesale
so it carries through serialize with no extra wiring.
handlers-misc.js: register('assemble'). keywords.js: Assemble + Contraption.
game.js: the Assemble slot-pick modal + a small 3-slot sprocket render.
cards.json: 6 placeholder Contraptions (uncollectible) + a demo "Assemble a
Contraption" card. The real MTG-derived roster is a separate task.

Tests: sprocket_test.mjs (19). effect_registry count 1108 -> 1109. Fixed a
latent isolation gap in weapons_wave30 (reset soulPool in setup: the new
collectible card shifted default-deck RNG so a Souleater weapon landed in the
default deck and pre-seeded soulPool in createGame). Suite 209 -> 210 green;
10-game AI-vs-AI sim clean. Bumped gallery ?v for the new keywords.

entries.title: Advanced-land scarcity: each is globally unique
entries.body:
An advanced land can exist at most once across the whole table. While any
player controls it, it's removed from every other player's (and their own
other slots') upgrade options; sacrificing/replacing/losing it frees it up
again. Basics stay unlimited for everyone.

- core.js: new takenAdvancedLands(state) (non-basic land ids in any p.lands);
  availableUpgrades excludes them. upgradeLand already re-validates through
  availableUpgrades, so it's rejected at execution too. UI (openTapMenu) and
  AI both read availableUpgrades — no extra wiring.

Test: color_identity_test.mjs +6 scarcity checks (33 -> 39). Suite 209 green.

entries.title: Treasure Token: sacrifice is now a 3-way choice
entries.body:
Sacrificing a Treasure Token now lets you choose:
  1. Gain 1 mana (the old behavior).
  2. Color-boost a creature you control — pick one of the 5 colors, then a
     creature, and roll that color's boost table onto it.
  3. Discover a card of a color — pick one of the 5 colors, then take 1 of 3
     cards of that color.

- core.js: `sacrificeToken` routes `sac.choose:'treasure'` into a pick chain;
  `resolvePick` gains a 'treasure' mode with stages main -> color -> (creature |
  discover), mirroring the 'advance' chaining.
- handlers-copy.js: the discover pool gains a `color` mode — any card of that
  colour (colored cards are uncollectible by design, so those are NOT excluded).
- game.js: `openPickModal` renders the treasure label picks per stage.
- cards.json: treasure_token `sac` -> `{choose:'treasure'}` + new description.

AI resolves via the existing generic pick path (takes the first option). Test:
treasure_token_test.mjs (16 checks). Suite 208 -> 209 green.

entries.title: Fix armor underflow: floor at 0 in gainArmor
entries.body:
validateGameState flagged "p0 armor invalid (-N)" in AI-vs-AI sims. Root
cause: Frozen Buckler ("Gain 10 Armor. At the start of your next turn, lose
5 Armor.") — if the +10 was spent below 5 (soaking damage) before the delayed
{type:'armor', value:-5} fired, gainArmor did `armor += amount` with no floor,
leaving armor negative and stuck. Any gain tied to a debuffed-negative Attack
(gain-armor-eq-attack) could underflow the same way.

gainArmor now floors: `armor = Math.max(0, armor + amount)`. Also floored the
one direct-write path (gain-armor-no-trigger) for the same invariant.

Test: armor_floor_test.mjs (7 checks). Suite 207 -> 208 green. The 60-game
deterministic AI-vs-AI sim that previously hit the violation (seed 1049) now
reports zero armor-invalid violations.

entries.title: Color-identity land slots: blank -> basic -> advanced, in place
entries.body:
A land slot now progresses blank -> basic -> advanced by UPGRADING in place,
gated by a live color identity read from the boost taps of ALL your current
lands (basic + advanced), not the `colors` field — so Abzan Citadel (colors:[]
but taps W/B/G) reads correctly as WBG.

Engine (core.js):
- landColors(def): the colors a land can produce (its boost taps) — the
  identity signal.
- colorIdentity: union of landColors() over every current land (was basics-only,
  reading .colors).
- availableLands: basics only (a blank slot can only ever become a basic).
- availableUpgrades(landUid): advanced lands the slot can upgrade INTO — must
  share a color with the land's CURRENT colors AND fit within your identity.
- upgradeLand(landUid, advId): in-place upgrade, same 3-mana + each-opponent-a-Coin
  cost as buyLand; inherits the tapped state (no tap-then-upgrade double mana).
- buyLand restricted to basics; sacrificeLand unchanged (sheds identity, draws).

UI (game.js): the land tap menu now lists "Upgrade -> <Advanced Land>" options;
develop menu shows basics only; new actUpgrade + MP-relay 'upgrade' action.

AI (ai.js): develops basics toward the colors its hand wants, then upgrades
basics into advanced lands (prefers ones matching those colors).

Test: color_identity_test.mjs (33 checks). Suite 206 -> 207 green. Headless
AI-vs-AI sim: games complete, upgrade path exercised, no land-related invariant
violations.

entries.title: Land Sets: tag the 5x70 monocolor + 15 Abzan pools via landSet
entries.body:
Introduces a `landSet` card tag as the single source of truth for what a
land generates, separate from the broad color lists:
- Basic Land Sets: the 70 monocolor cards of each color, tagged by their
  basic land — Plains (W), Island (U), Swamp (B), Mountain (R), Forest (G).
- Advanced Land Sets: the 15 Abzan cards -> landSet 'Abzan'.
All 365 set cards are now collectible:false with no rarity (obtainable
only via their land, not packs/deckbuilder).

Pool logic draws from the tag (and INCLUDES the now-uncollectible members):
- `conjure`/`discover` handlers gain a `landSet` branch (handlers-copy.js).
- The 5 basic lands conjure exactly their 70-card set (was: any card of
  that color, mono AND multicolor); Abzan Citadel discovers landSet:'Abzan';
  Abzan Strike conjures from landSet:'Abzan' (was conjure-named, which now
  excludes uncollectible).

abzan_pool_test.mjs +Basic-Land-Set coverage (each set = 70 mono,
uncollectible, no rarity; land conjures from its set). Suite 206/206.

entries.title: Add Advance + Time Travel keywords; reword the timeway locations
entries.body:
Resolves the 'Advance' naming clash: the 4 Across-the-Timeways location
cards (Past/Present Silvermoon + Gnomeregan) used "Advance to the
present/future!" for their time-progression (advance-location), which
would collide with the new dungeon Advance keyword. Reworded them to
"Time Travel to the present/future!" (description + tap text), so:
  - Advance is now unique to Abzan Runemark -> keyword: "venture a dungeon"
  - Time Travel is unique to the 4 locations -> keyword: "transform to the
    next era"
Both added to the glossary as separate keywords. Also tightened
Runemark's text to lean on the tooltips: "+2/+2, Taunt while you have
Coven, and Inspire: Advance." (bolds exactly Taunt/Coven/Inspire/Advance).

Bumped the card-gallery cache-bust ?v 20260810 -> 20260818 (viewer.html
+ viewer.js) so the gallery reloads keywords.js and shows the new
Coven/Advance/Time Travel tooltips. Suite 206/206.

entries.title: Show Coven as a keyword (Inspire already was)
entries.body:
Added a Coven glossary entry so it's bolded in the rules text with a
tooltip, like other keywords. Inspire was already in the glossary;
Runemark now surfaces Taunt, Inspire, and Coven. Skipped an 'Advance'
entry — it'd collide with the Gnomeregan "Advance to the present!"
location cards (a different mechanic).

entries.title: Rename the dungeon mechanic 'venture' -> 'advance'
entries.body:
The mechanic is called Advance (Runemark's "Inspire: Advance"), so the
effect type, function, pick mode/flag, and event are renamed to match:
effect 'venture'->'advance', function venture()->advance(), pickQueue
mode:'venture'->mode:'advance' + the enter/room flag, resolvePick's
pend.venture->pend.advance, the 'ventureRoom' event->'advanceRoom', and
the UI modal title ("Advance — choose a dungeon"). "Venture into the
Dungeon" stays only as an MTG reference in comments. The real card
"Venture Co. Mercenary" is untouched.

Suite 206/206 (dungeon 22/22, registry still 1108).

entries.title: Venture into the Dungeon (the Advance mechanic) + Runemark's Inspire
entries.body:
Advance = MTG's "Venture into the Dungeon." Adds the three Adventures in
the Forgotten Realms dungeons (Lost Mine of Phandelver, Tomb of
Annihilation, Dungeon of the Mad Mage), pulled from Scryfall oracle text.

- NEW engine/dungeons.js: pure DUNGEONS data (rooms -> effects + branches).
  Room effects use the normal DSL; since rooms auto-trigger, targeted ones
  use auto-resolving variants (bolster for +1/+1, freeze/all-heroes
  broadcasts). A few clauses adapted where the DSL can't express them
  (Tomb "lose N unless…" -> the discard/life half; Mad Mage "exile top 2,
  play"/"draw 3, cast free" -> draw). The Atropal = 4/4 deathtouch.
- venture()/enterRoom() live in core.js (needs execEffects/emit); DUNGEONS
  is a no-import data module so the base module has no cycle. Per-player
  `dungeon` + `completedDungeons` (snapshotted wholesale, so MP/replay
  carry them). resolvePick routes venture picks.
- On first venture the player PICKS a dungeon; branch rooms are a pick too.
  Reuses the pick modal's label mode (like Adapt) — new mode:'venture'
  branch in game.js; AI auto-resolves venture picks (ai.js).
- Abzan Runemark's "Inspire: Advance": `attach` now carries an `ongoing`,
  so the enchanted creature gets ongoing{on:'hero-power-used',
  effects:[venture]} — it ventures each hero power (Inspire), alongside
  its Coven:Taunt.

New dungeon_test.mjs (22 checks: all 3 dungeons walk to their payoff +
complete, fresh venture starts anew, Runemark Inspire ventures). Registry
count 1107->1108. Suite 206/206; AI-vs-AI venture smoke: 0 validation
violations.

entries.title: Implement Coven, restore Abzan Runemark's conditional Taunt
entries.body:
Coven = you control 3+ creatures with DISTINCT Attack values (three
different attacks, not three bodies — five 1/1s don't qualify; a 1/1,
2/2, 3/3 do). It's a live on/off condition: the effect deactivates the
moment you no longer meet it.

Implemented by extending the existing `condKeyword` toggle (already used
by Southsea Deckhand's while:'weapon') with a while:'coven' branch, backed
by a new hasCoven() helper (core.js) computed once per player each aura
recompute. `attach` now carries a `condKeyword`, so Abzan Runemark grants
+2/+2 plus Taunt-while-Coven (previously dropped as an adaptation). The
aura recompute's delta-tracking gives the on/off toggle for free.

abzan_pool_test.mjs +6 checks (hasCoven cases, Taunt gated by Coven,
and the full break/restore toggle). Suite 205/205.

entries.title: Abzan: build the 7 missing pool cards + Citadel Discovers all 15
entries.body:
Completes the Abzan advanced-land pool. Built the 7 cards named in the
Planned Card Dex but never designed, sourced from tools/data/all_cards.json
(the paper/Magepunk scans): Advantage, Battlepriest, Runemark, Sand
Blessing, Strike, Survivalist, Warlord — all W/B/G, cardClass magepunk.

Converted Abzan Citadel's tap from a random conjure-named to a real
Discover (pick 1 of 3), and taught the `discover` effect a themed `match`
mode that filters by name and ALLOWS colored cards (no existing discover
uses `match`, so nothing else changes). The pool is dynamic name-match,
so it now resolves to all 15 non-land Abzan cards.

Faithful ports where the engine allows; three adaptations the DSL can't
express as data: Runemark drops Coven/Inspire flavor (keeps +2/+2 &
Taunt via `attach`); Sand Blessing keeps the "your creatures have Taunt"
anthem but drops the "5: destroy a Taunt/Windfury creature" ability
(needs an OR-keyword target + enchantment-activated support); Warlord
keeps Battlecry: draw 2 but drops the die->exile replacement (no
death-replacement hook exists). Survivalist's "X: deal X" uses
spend-all-mana-damage.

New abzan_pool_test.mjs (16 checks: flip, 15-card pool, themed discover
incl. colored, each new card works). Suite 205/205. Art deploys to
magepunk-cardart separately.

entries.title: Abzan: flip colors to the advanced-land structure
entries.body:
The advanced-land pattern is a COLORLESS land that Discovers from a pool
of themed, colored cards. Abzan was inverted: the Citadel carried W/B/G
and its 8 pool cards were colorless. Flipped so Abzan Citadel is
colorless and the pool (Falconer, Charm, Ascendancy, Guide, Skycaptain,
Steward, Fortification, Infantry) is the W/B/G wedge. The conjure-named
tap matches by name, so discovery is unaffected.

entries.title: AI: don't ramp lands while the hand is over the limit
entries.body:
Verifying AI play with large hands surfaced one rough edge: when flush
with mana but holding a bloated hand, the land-development rule (0b)
would spend the turn buying lands (ramping) and play only 1 card — e.g.
22 cards + 10 mana -> 3 lands bought, 1 creature. A flooded hand should
be dumping cards (or it discards them at end of turn), not ramping.

Guarded 0b with `p.hand.length <= HAND_LIMIT`, so ramping only happens
when the hand isn't over the limit. Same case now plays 2 creatures with
all 10 mana instead. Only affects >15-card hands, so normal early-game
land development is unchanged.

Everything else already checked out: the AI uses all its mana each turn
(0 wasted), dumps cheap cards up to the mana limit, and over 940
AI-vs-AI turns had 0 crashes / 0 state-validation violations at <=11ms
per turn. handcap_test.mjs +4 checks (20 total); suite 204/204.

entries.title: AI discards sensibly on end-of-turn cleanup (keep bombs, shed chaff)
entries.body:
When over the hand limit, both discard resolvers (ai.js step -1a and
game.js resolveAIDiscards) dumped the most EXPENSIVE cards — a rule
carried over from Loot discards. For an over-15 cleanup that's backwards:
it threw away finishers (a 12/12 Taunt, a 10/10 Deathrattle) to keep
thirteen 1-drops.

Cleanup discards (pend.cleanup) now shed the least valuable cards via
AI.cleanupDiscardUids / handKeepValue: value ≈ cost (impact proxy) + a
stat/keyword bonus so a strong cheap card outranks a weak pricier one.
Loot/other discards keep the old "dump priciest" behavior (unchanged).

Verified: the same 18-card hand now discards three 1-cost chaff and keeps
all three bombs. handcap_test.mjs +5 checks (16 total); suite 204/204.

entries.title: Hand size: no mid-turn hard cap, discard to 15 at end of turn
entries.body:
The hand rule is MTG-style (per invariant I6): you may hold more than 15
cards DURING your turn — draw and card generation never burn — and the
hand is trimmed to 15 only at end of turn. drawCards already honored
this, but ~85 card-generation guards (conjure/discover/copy/add-card/
add-token/...) silently dropped generated cards once the hand hit 15.

Rather than edit ~85 sites, split the constant:
  - HAND_LIMIT = 15  — the real hand size, enforced at end of turn
  - MAX_HAND   = 40  — a high mid-turn safety ceiling the generation
                       guards reference; normal play never approaches it

So every `hand.length < MAX_HAND` generation guard now allows up to 40
(effectively no cap), while the genuinely-15 sites were repointed at
HAND_LIMIT: the end-of-turn cleanup trim (core.js), the `hand-full`
condition (cost.js), and the fill-to-limit effects — Well of Eternity
(handlers-copy), Thistle Tea (handlers-misc), Halazzi/fill-hand-token
(handlers-summon), and Godfrey. Thistle Tea's `count` copies are now
uncapped mid-turn too.

New handcap_test.mjs (11 checks: generation/draw/add-token past 15 not
dropped, fill still stops at 15, end-of-turn trims to 15). Suite 204/204.
Verified in a real turn cycle: 18 cards held mid-turn -> 15 at end of
turn, 0 state-validation violations.

entries.title: Fix add-token: generated Magnetic tokens, and honor count
entries.body:
The add-token effect (tokens created into hand) instantiated an inline
def that dropped two fields:

- Magnetic: the def passed keywords:['magnetic'] but the engine's flag
  lives on `magnetic`, not in keywords, so the generated token came out
  magnetic:false and could NOT merge. From the Scrapheap's Sparkbots
  were the visible victim. Now the handler sets magnetic from either an
  `e.magnetic` field or a 'magnetic' keyword (and strips the bogus
  keyword), and carries magnetizeTribes.

- count: the handler created exactly one token, ignoring e.count. So
  "Get three ... Sparkbots" (From the Scrapheap) gave one, and "Get
  eight ... Bandits" (The Badlands Bandits) gave one. Now it loops
  e.count, stopping at hand cap, and applies withGift per token.

drone_deconstructor was already fine — it uses add-card on the real
ttn_sparkbot token (magnetic:true preserved).

magnetic_test.mjs +8 checks (generated-token coverage); suite 203/203.

entries.title: Teach the AI to Magnetize onto its Mechs
entries.body:
The AI played Magnetic minions as standalone bodies (pickTarget returns
null for them, so they were summoned normally). Now, before playing a
Magnetic creature, the AI considers merging it onto a friendly Mech (or
its magnetizeTribes).

Because the board cap is large (MAX_BOARD=40), space is rarely the
constraint, so the decision is value-based: fuse when it stacks a
keyword (Divine Shield / Taunt / Lifesteal / Windfury / Rush / Poison /
Deathtouch / Stealth), a Deathrattle, or an Ongoing — or when there's a
Divine Shield Mech to load stats behind; otherwise develop a separate
body (going wide is strong in this format). Target picks the best
carrier: shielded first, then a Taunt wall, then the biggest threat.

magnetic_test.mjs extended with 3 AI scenarios (fuse a keyword minion,
body-out a vanilla stat-stick, body-out when no Mech). Suite 203/203.

entries.title: Fix Magnetic: 6 unflagged minions, tribe targets, and a drop hint
entries.body:
The Magnetic keyword worked in the engine, but three things made it
"not work" in practice:

1. Six minions named "Magnetic" in their text but were missing the
   `magnetic` flag, so the engine never merged them: skaterbot,
   treetech_jungledrone, dinotomaton, gogogo_goram, diving_rig,
   furious_furnace. Flag added.

2. Cards that read "can Magnetize to <tribe> as well as Mechs" could
   only merge onto Mechs. Added a `magnetizeTribes` field (default
   Mech-only) wired through the engine merge check and the UI drop:
   prosthetic_hand→Undead, windsoul_automaton→Totem, diving_rig→Pirate,
   absorbent_parasite→Beast. Copy effects carry it too.

3. Dragging a Magnetic card over a Mech gave no cue — the normal
   "release to play" hint + a placement gap showed, so players dropped
   into a gap and it played as a vanilla minion. Now the hint reads
   "release to Magnetize X onto Y", the gap marker hides, and the
   glossary says "drop onto a friendly Mech" (was the misleading
   "play it left of").

New regression suite magnetic_test.mjs (19 checks); full engine suite
203/203.

entries.title: Add per-species battleScale for authentic relative sprite sizing
entries.body:
Sprites are fit into the 96px box (contain), then multiplied by a new
per-species `battleScale` so mons draw at their real relative size —
Diglett 0.60, Pikachu 0.74, Charizard 1.19, Snorlax 1.28, Onix/Wailord
capped at 1.90 — instead of every mon flattened to the same size.

- tools/gen_battlescale.mjs: derives battleScale from canonical Pokedex
  height (Showdown pokedex.ts heightm) via scale = clamp((h/1m)^0.33,
  0.6, 1.9). 951 species scaled; fakemon/no-height default to 1.0. Field
  written into species_battle.json only where it deviates (absent => 1).
- battle.js drawSide, pvp.js drawMon, evolution.js: multiply the box-fit
  by battleScale. PvP mons arrive without a species handle, so main.js
  feeds pvp a sprite->scale map on boot. Evolution bottom-anchors + clamps
  so a big mon can't overflow the small view.
- gen_designwiki: expose battleScale on wiki pokemon entries.

Species data deployed to owdata; wiki regenerated.

entries.title: Fix battle sprite sizing: normalize every mon to the 96px canvas
entries.body:
Battle front/back sprites were drawn as native_size × fixed_scale, where
the scale was tuned for the standard 96x96 canvas. But the sprite set has
1101 distinct native sizes (12px crops up to 256px Gen-9 art), so only
643 of 1751 in-game mons rendered at a sensible size:
  - 423 rendered OVERSIZED  (the 256px Gen-9 batch, ~2.7x too big)
  - 685 rendered UNDERSIZED (Rolycoly 20px ~0.2x, many fakemon ~0.35x)

The menu renderers (party/summary/dex/starter) already fit sprites into a
box via min(box/w, box/h); the battle path (battle.js drawSide, pvp.js
drawMon) and the evolution scene were the only ones still scaling raw
dims. Fit each into a 96 box (contain), preserving aspect and consistent
bottom-anchoring. The 643 already-correct 96px sprites are unchanged.

entries.title: Update design wiki + Magepunk News for the overworld work
entries.body:
Wiki (designwiki/data) was seeded from the old Lua project and had gone stale vs the
web game. New tools/gen_designwiki.mjs rebuilds it from the LIVE game data
(overworld/data/*): pokemon.json/moves.json/abilities.json regenerated in full, and
regions.json refreshed in place (reusing the region/map/trainer skeleton, pulling every
encounter table + trainer team from the current data). Now the wiki reflects: the
repaired fakemon movesets/abilities (e.g. scarazor is Bug with a spread learnset;
fawnlora's ability is Overgrow), the day/night wild tables (Johto authentic +
FR/Emerald fakemon "grass (night)" methods, incl. the missingno easter egg), and the
fakemon now on trainers. Ability descriptions are carried over; formatting matches the
repo (minified dexes, pretty regions).

News (magepunknews): extended gen-magepunknews.mjs GAME_FILES to also track overworld/
game modules + the data-shipping tools, so the RPG's gameplay commits become patch
notes. Rebuilt news.json — 917 entries, incl. 34 overworld patch notes (the cross-region
spine, day/night encounters, fishing, and the full fakemon repair/deploy).

entries.title: Fakemon repair: spread merged L1 moves into a rising level ladder
entries.body:
Merging two donors piled both their level-1 moves onto L1 (139 of 310 movesets had >=8
moves at L1). combinedMoveset now runs spreadLevels: keep ~3 starting moves at L1, then
step the rest up by ~2 levels each (respecting any naturally higher-level move). Learnsets
read like real ones and low-level fakemon get a sensible progression.

Result (deterministic full re-repair): L1-flooded movesets 139 -> 0, STAB guarantee intact
(0 zero-STAB). e.g. scarazor's 18-at-L1 becomes 3 starters + a L4..L36 ladder with bugbuzz
at L10. Only species_battle.json changed; redeployed to owdata and verified live. Tool tracked.

entries.title: Fakemon repair: guarantee 2-3 STAB moves on combined movesets
entries.body:
A handful of repaired fakemon ended up with 0 type-matching moves (mainly Fairy — Gen
1-5 donors carry almost no Fairy moves). repair_fakemon.mjs now runs an ensureStab pass:
if a combined moveset has <2 STAB, it injects a weak/mid/strong spread of REAL damaging
moves of the fakemon's own type(s) (pulled straight from moves_battle.json, so Fairy etc.
work) at sensible levels, without dropping any STAB when re-capping to 20.

Result (full deterministic re-repair from the pristine backup): all 310 combined movesets
now have >=2 STAB (was 5 with 0, 7 with 1). e.g. regirice (Fairy) gains disarmingvoice/
playrough/lightofruin. Only species_battle.json changed (~12 mons); redeployed to owdata
(1 file uploaded) and verified live. Only the tool is tracked here.

entries.title: Trainer fakemon: level/stage sanity pass (power band <-> trainer level)
entries.body:
Bias the deploy so a fakemon's power (BST band: <=340/420/480/520/560/>560) never
exceeds the trainer's level band (ace <12/22/32/40/48/>=48). A feasibility check
confirmed enough level-appropriate trainers to host every band with no forced
under-tier placements. Assignment: phase 1 places the STRONGEST fakemon first (fewest
valid hosts) into a same-band, type-matched trainer; phase 2 fills remaining slots with
the strongest fakemon that still FITS the level (band <= trainer band), type-matched,
round-robin.

Result (re-run over the restored originals): 3093 parties, all 474 unused fakemon
deployed, and 0 OVER-TIER placements. Now a L6 youngster gets a BST-265 basic (unymph),
Brock a BST-345 Rock (rebble), Giovanni a BST-530 Ground (fuzzabod), Drake's Dragon E4 a
BST-580 Steel/Dragon (aldroxas). Tests green (gymstory 15, villain 47, frontier 24, boot 5).

(Data files gitignored -> deploy trainers.json/trainer_teams.json to owdata; backups at
*.pre_fakemon.bak. Only the tool is tracked.)

entries.title: Deploy the remaining fakemon via trainers (+1 per team)
entries.body:
The 474 fakemon that never landed in a wild list (day or night) now appear on
trainers. tools/deploy_fakemon_trainers.mjs appends one UNUSED fakemon (num<=0,
absent from every wild table + FREM night + Johto day/night) to each trainer party
with <6 mons, in both data/trainers.json .rosters and data/trainer_teams.json —
type-matched to the team's dominant type, at the party's ace level. A two-phase
assignment (coverage pass, then type-matched fill) guarantees every one of the 474 is
deployed at least once.

Result: 3093 trainer parties got a fakemon; all 474 unused fakemon now appear (0
missing); 0 teams exceed 6; 0 unknown species. e.g. Brock (Rock gym) gains cragoat
(Rock) at L14; Misty (Water) gains bullfount (Water) at L21. Tests green (gymstory 15,
villain 47, frontier 24, quest 76, boot 5).

NOTE: trainers.json / trainer_teams.json are gitignored (served from owdata) — edited
in place (backups at *.pre_fakemon.bak) and must be deployed to owdata. Only the tool
is tracked here. Reproducible: node tools/deploy_fakemon_trainers.mjs.

entries.title: Repair 364 needs-work fakemon: combined movesets + fixed abilities
entries.body:
Two placeholder defects, two fixes (tools/repair_fakemon.mjs):
- DUPLICATE (copy-paste) learnsets (310, incl. the 165- and 65-mon clusters): each
  gets a fresh, type-appropriate moveset by MERGING the level-up learnsets of two
  different Gen 1-5 Pokemon (one donor per type; two of the mono-type), moves deduped
  to their earliest level, sorted, capped at 20, with collision-avoidance so no two
  fakemon (or a real mon) share a result.
- MISMATCHED starter abilities (178, e.g. Torrent on a Grass mon): the off-type
  ability is replaced with the primary type's default (Grass->Overgrow, etc.).

Result: all 623 fakemon are now CLEAN (0 duplicate learnsets, 0 bad abilities; every
learnset move is valid). The FR/Emerald night pool grows 259 -> 623, so
encounters_frem_night.js is regenerated with far more variety (149 distinct species
across the 918 night slots, still all fakemon, biome-matched).

NOTE: the repaired species_battle.json / species_abilities.json are gitignored (served
from owdata) — they were edited in place (backups at *.pre_repair.bak) and must be
deployed to owdata to go live. Only the tool + the regenerated night module are tracked
here. Test green (encounters 14, frontier 24, boot 5, legendary 30).

entries.title: FR/Emerald night encounters: biome-matched fakemon lists
entries.body:
FireRed Kanto + Emerald Hoenn have no vanilla day/night. Populate their NIGHT grass
lists from the completed fakemon, prioritized over later-gen mons.

- tools/gen_frem_night.mjs: for each Gen-3 land map, reads the base table to infer the
  biome (its weighted type profile) + level range, then builds a 6-slot night list from
  the 259 CLEAN fakemon FIRST (unique learnset + type-matched ability), biome-matched
  (must share a type; nocturnal types as a tiebreak) with a per-map hash for variety,
  BST-laddered (rarer slot = stronger), levels tracking the map's base range. Later-gen
  (Gen 4+) is fill only. Region-classified by species so Johto/JohKanto are excluded.
- overworld/encounters_frem_night.js (new, generated): FREM_NIGHT for 153 maps (95 Kanto
  + 58 Hoenn) — every slot filled by clean fakemon (later-gen wasn't needed). e.g.
  Viridian Forest gets Bug fakemon, Mt Moon cave Rock/Poison, Route 1 Normal/Flying birds.
- encounters.js: pick() uses FREM_NIGHT for NIGHT + LAND only; day/morning keep the base
  table + reweighting; Johto's authentic tables still take precedence.

Test: encounters_daynight_test.mjs (14 — Route 1 day = base pidgey/rattata, night = all
fakemon biome-matched Normal/Flying within the base level range, and a night fakemon
builds into a real wild battle). Regression green (boot5/legendary30/crossregion21/
quest76/progression15).

entries.title: Extend authentic day/night grass tables to JohKanto (Gen-2 Kanto)
entries.body:
The generator now also parses pokecrystal data/wild/kanto_grass.asm (Crystal's Gen-2
Kanto = the JohKanto region). 30 maps resolve: 23 to the namespaced MAP_JOHKANTO_*,
and 7 shared border maps (Mt Moon, Diglett's Cave, Victory Road, Tohjo Falls, Routes
26-28) to their plain Crystal-id-space MAP_* — each verified against its base table's
species so there's no FireRed/Emerald collision, and the Johto pass wins any overlap.

overworld/encounters_daynight.js is now 91 maps (61 Johto + 30 JohKanto) — e.g.
JohKanto Route 1 gains Hoothoot at night. encounters.js is unchanged (it already reads
DAYNIGHT). Test extended (11 — adds a JohKanto Route 1 Hoothoot-at-night check).
Regression green (boot5/legendary30/crossregion21/quest76).

entries.title: Authentic per-map day/night grass tables for Johto (Gen-2)
entries.body:
The reweighting/overlay was a synthesis; Johto (Gen-2) actually HAS real per-map
morning/day/night grass tables. Extract and use them.

- tools/gen_johto_daynight.mjs: parses pokecrystal data/wild/johto_grass.asm (61 maps,
  7 slots x morn/day/nite, Gen-2 slot weights [30,30,20,10,5,4,1]; species constant ->
  web id via lowercase+strip-underscore, verified clean for all 90 species) and emits
  the tracked module below. (The base data/encounters.json is read-only owdata, so these
  live in code.)
- overworld/encounters_daynight.js (new, generated): DAYNIGHT[map].land.{morning,day,night}
  for all 61 Johto grass maps — e.g. Sprout Tower Rattata by day / Gastly at night, Route 29
  gains Hoothoot at night.
- encounters.js: pick() now prefers the authentic per-map table for the current phase
  (raw weights, no reweighting/overlay) and falls back to the base owdata table + the
  code reweighting/overlay for Kanto (FireRed) / Hoenn (Emerald), which are Gen-3 and have
  no vanilla day/night split.

Test: encounters_daynight_test.mjs extended (10 — Sprout Tower Rattata->Gastly and Route 29
Hoothoot-at-night prove the authentic tables override + swap species by time). Regression
green (boot5/legendary30/progression15/quest76/crossregion21/villain47/rival9).

entries.title: Day/night wild encounters (code-driven) + fishing cleanup
entries.body:
encounters.json is served read-only from owdata, so time-of-day variation can't be
data — it now lives in encounters.js: each slot's weight is scaled per Clock.phase()
by a nocturnal/diurnal species classification (e.g. Route 1 rattata ~15% by day ->
~90% at night), and after dark ~28% of LAND rolls are swapped for a night-dweller
from NIGHT_POOL (hoothoot/zubat/oddish/…) so even all-diurnal routes differ at night.
pick() takes an optional phase (defaults to the live Clock) so roll() and the
double-battle partner pick are both time-aware.

Fishing was already fully wired (castRod, reached from the bag on any rod) — I only
extracted the pick into encounters.fish(mapId, tier) (FRLG bands: Old [0,1] / Good
[2,4] / Super [5,9]) so it's unit-testable; castRod behaviour is unchanged.

Test: overworld/tests/encounters_daynight_test.mjs (8 — nocturnal up at night, the
night overlay injects off-table dwellers after dark but never by day, Clock.phase
drives the live roll, and each rod hooks its slot band). Regression green
(boot5/legendary30/progression15/quest76/crossregion21/villain47/rival9).

entries.title: Grand Champion finale — capstone after all three Leagues (Phase 4)
entries.body:
The interleave had no ending: becoming Champion of all three regions did nothing
special. Add the capstone.

- main.js: when the third region's League falls (the champion branch finish() now
  checks Quest.SHARED.every(isChampion)), grandChampionFinale() plays a crowning
  cutscene and grantGrandChampionReward() pays the one-shot capstone ($50000 + a
  GOLD TROPHY + 3 rare candies + 3 max revives), gated by a grand_champion flag.
  A boot catch-up grants it silently to saves that were already 3x champion before
  this shipped. overworldSummary() gains a grandChampion field (+ server validator),
  so the profile "Grand Champion" achievement + future post-finale gating can read it.

Test: overworld/tests/grandchampion_test.mjs (8 — boot catch-up crowns an already-
3x-champion save; the capstone is a one-shot payout; the finale fires only when the
THIRD league falls, not the second, via onTrainerDefeated's finish guard). Regression
green (postgame17/achievements28/gymstory15/quest76/boot5/villain47/legendary30/
crossregion21).

This completes the 4-phase spine/story improvement roadmap (legibility, rival,
rewards+tune, finale).

entries.title: Per-tier completion rewards + gym level-curve tune (Phase 3)
entries.body:
Clearing a tier gave no payoff, and vanilla gym-leader levels differ wildly at the
same badge index — jarring under the interleave.

- Tier rewards: in onTrainerDefeated's gym branch, capture globalTier before/after
  Badges.earn; when the badge was the LAST region to reach that tier (globalTier
  ticks up), grant a one-shot scaling reward (TIER_REWARDS: money + real bag items,
  greater at higher tiers, capstone at tier 8). Chained after the badge toast, or a
  quiet HUD line + grant for scripted (silent) wins. Idempotent via a tier_reward_N
  flag; feeds syncOverworldAchievements. JohKanto gyms route to the excluded slice,
  so they never trigger it.
- Level floor: an audit showed same-tier spreads up to 16 levels (tier-7 Blaine L47
  vs Pryce L31). applyGymLevelFloors() runs once after trainers.init(), shifting each
  shared-region gym leader's team up to a per-tier floor [14,20,26,29,40,42,46,48]
  (never lowers; matched by leader name, JohKanto dupes excluded). Post-floor the
  same-tier spread drops to <=3, so all three regions' gyms feel like real gyms.

Test: overworld/tests/tierreward_test.mjs (9 — the tier reward fires once through
onTrainerDefeated when the third region clears the tier + pays money, and the floor
raises Falkner/Whitney/Pryce to their tier floor while leaving Blaine untouched).
Regression green (gymstory15/quest76/villain47/progression15/crossregion21/boot5/
intro59/postgame17/achievements28).

entries.title: Recurring cross-region rival + tri-region premise (Phase 2)
entries.body:
The badge-thirds interleave forces region-hopping with no narrative reason. Thread
one through it: your home-region rival (GARY/SILVER/BRENDAN, from the intro) is
climbing all three regions too and intercepts you once per tier.

- rivals.js (new): RIVAL_TIERS — one authored, escalating team per tier (0-7),
  mixing species from all three regions (evolving cores pidgey/growlithe/geodude/
  gastly/dratini lines + a Hoenn dog + late SNORLAX; levels a warmup under each
  tier's gym). rivalDue(mapId) returns the tier when the current map is the gym
  town of your CURRENT shared tier (PORTAL_TOWNS + globalTier), the intro's done,
  and you haven't fought this tier's rival yet; rivalFlag(tier) one-shots it. A
  single region-agnostic table sidesteps Johto SILVER having no ported team data.
- main.js: checkRivalTrigger (on-arrive, the villain-beat pattern) + startRivalEncounter
  (taunt startCutscene -> battle.startTrainer vs the tier team -> flag set win OR
  lose, heal on loss); hooked into refreshMapContent beside checkVillainTrigger.
  Connective opening frame: the intro professor now explains the tri-region rule +
  the portal + that a rival is climbing alongside you.

Test: overworld/tests/rival_test.mjs (9 — rivalDue gating: after-intro only, current
tier's gym town only, one-shot per tier, follows the tier forward across regions;
and the encounter taunts then starts a real battle from the tier team). Full overworld
regression green (intro59/gymstory15/quest76/crossregion21/villain47/legendary30/
postgame17/achievements28/awakening15/plot13/boot5/portals12/legibility8/rival9).

entries.title: Cross-region legibility: portal onboarding + tier tracker (Phase 1)
entries.body:
The badge-thirds interleave is live but under-explained. Make it legible:

- Portal onboarding: the FIRST time a cross-region tier wall turns you back
  (either onArrive choke point), a one-time dialog (maybePortalTutorial, gated on
  !Story.getFlag('tut_portal_seen') and a real tier gate — not a villain seal)
  explains the badge-thirds rule and points at the PORTAL by the Pokemon Center.
- Trainer Card: reworked drawTrainerCard into a two-column layout (the card was
  already dense) — stats left, a cross-region GYM TIER X/8 tracker right: one row
  of 8 pips per shared region, the current tier's pip ringed on the regions that
  still owe this tier's gym, a * for champions, GRAND CHAMP when all three. Frontier
  symbols moved under it.
- QUEST menu title now reads "<REGION> — GYM TIER X/8" (the objective subtitle
  already spells out who's behind). Town Map right rail gains a WORLD GYM TIER line,
  this region's gym count, an "Owes GYM N here" flag for lagging regions, and a
  "GYM N: <leader>" tag when the selected town is a gym town (via PORTAL_TOWNS).

Test: overworld/tests/legibility_test.mjs (8 — tutorial fires once then never,
villain seals don't trigger it, and Trainer Card/QUEST/Town Map render the tier
tracker from a mocked K=2/J=1/H=1 state). Regression green (quest76/crossregion21/
boot5/progression15/gymstory15/villain47/portals12).

entries.title: Cross-region badge-thirds progression + inter-region portals
entries.body:
The three shared regions (Kanto/Johto/Hoenn) were independent, map-isolated
campaigns. Fuse them into one interleaved circuit: each gym gives a third of a
tier's badge — you must beat gym N in all three regions before advancing to gym
N+1 in any of them. JohKanto (the Gen-2 Kanto 16-badge post-game) is excluded.

- quest.js: globalTier() = min gyms cleared across the three shared regions.
  blocked() now gates on globalTier instead of the region's own count. globalTier
  is monotonic and a region can lead it by at most 1, so this single change
  enforces the interleave, preserves region-internal gym order, and stays
  strand-safe. objective()/shortObjective() gain a cross-region "you're ahead —
  beat gym N in the lagging regions via the PORTAL" message; the block message
  names the lagging regions' same-tier gym towns.
- blockers.js: {badge} tier guards now key on globalTier too, so a corridor/gym
  guard sprite stays until the tier is cleared everywhere (keeps guard + gate in
  sync — no invisible wall). {item}/{flag}/{hm} unchanged.
- portals.js (new): inter-region PORTAL pads — the connective tissue that makes
  visiting all three isolated regions in one save possible. A glowing canvas pad
  is placed beside each of the 24 gym towns' Pokemon Centers (anchored to the PC
  door via /POKE(?:MON_)?CENTER_1F$/), linking the three regions' SAME-tier gym
  towns at all 8 tiers. Using one (face + A -> destination menu) flips the current
  region and flies you to the dest town's PC-front landing (beside its own pad),
  auto-registering the Fly point. Mirrors the blockers.js per-map-object pattern.
- main.js: portal instance + player.blocked/interact/draw/refreshMapContent
  wiring, the portal destination menu (ferryMenu pattern), travelPortal(), __ow.

Tests: crossregion_test.mjs (21 — globalTier gate, objective text, JohKanto
excluded), portals_test.mjs (12 headless — all 24 towns get a pad on a walkable
tile with the right same-tier dests; travel flips region + lands by the arrival
pad + registers Fly). quest_reach.mjs gains 72 cross-region strand assertions
(portal-joined graph: every region's current gym town reachable at every tier).
Updated quest_test/villain/blockers_ingame to lockstep badge setup (single-region-
ahead is now an unreachable state). Full overworld regression green.

entries.title: Overworld achievements: sync gym/champion/Frontier/legendary/villain milestones to the account
entries.body:
The Profile achievements page derives its tiles from the server account state,
but overworld progress (badges, championships, Frontier symbols, caught
legendaries, villain arcs, Pokedex) lived only in localStorage — invisible to
achievements. Bridge it:

- main.js: overworldSummary() builds a compact serializable snapshot from the
  existing local sources (Badges/Frontier/Dex/Story). syncOverworldAchievements()
  pushes it to the account (fire-and-forget, no-op when logged out) on boot
  (backfilling existing progress) and after each milestone hook: gym badge /
  Championship / RED (onTrainerDefeated), Frontier Brain (runFrontierBattle),
  legendary CATCH (startLegendaryBattle — catches only, not defeats), and villain
  arc (completeVillainBeat).
- server/mp.mjs: new overworld-sync action stores a validated/clamped blob on
  user.stats.overworld (publicState already returns the whole stats object).
- profile/index.html: 24 new achievement tiles reading stats.overworld — gym
  circuits x3, Champions x3, Grand Champion, Indigo Conqueror (16 badges), Rival
  at the Summit (RED), Frontier Challenger/Conqueror/Gold Standard, five legendary
  sets + Legendary Master, villain busters, Weather Crisis Averted, Pokedex
  50/150. Only shown once the player has booted the RPG logged-in.

Tests: overworld/tests/achievements_test.mjs (28 — summary correctness, the
Dex-caught-vs-defeated legendary distinction, sync fires on boot/milestone,
login-gated no sync when logged out, profile tiles unlock/lock from state, and
the tiles hide entirely for card-only players). Regressions green
(boot5/badges106/frontier24/postgame17/legendary30/villain47).

entries.title: overworld: spectator chat for Battle Frontier runs (like Battlecards)
entries.body:
Reuses the shared chat overlay (battlecards/chat.js) exactly as the Battlecards
solo-run spectate does. While you run a Frontier facility, a chat mounts on your
own screen for the run's room (u:<you>, canPost) so you can talk with your
spectators; a friend watching mounts the same run room read-only plus a
spectator-only room (spec:<you>) so watchers can chat among themselves. Both mount
on start and unmount when the run / the watch ends. No server change — the chat
rooms (u:/spec:) are already generic.

Test: factoryspec_test.mjs (11 — the chat overlay mounts for the runner and the
spectator and unmounts on leave). frontier/boot regression green.

entries.title: overworld: "N watching" badge on the runner's Frontier screen
entries.body:
While your Battle Frontier run is being spectated, a live "👁 N watching" badge
shows in the top-right of your screen. The runner already gets the current watcher
count back from each publish-factory call (the relay returns it); we now stash it
and draw the badge on top of the battle/overworld whenever a run is active and
someone's watching. Clears when the run ends.

Test: factoryspec_test.mjs (9 — the runner picks up the watcher count that drives
the badge). boot green.

entries.title: overworld: make Battle Frontier runs spectatable (like Battlecards)
entries.body:
A friend can now watch your live Battle Frontier run, mirroring how Battlecards
solo runs are spectated (the relay is a polled KV store).

Runner: factorySnapshot() reads the live battle into a lean board (both active
mons' name/level/HP/status/types/boosts, team dots, current message, facility +
streak); a ~1.2s publish loop posts it to the relay for the duration of a run, and
the heartbeat reports presence `factory:<facility>` so friends see you're in a run.

Server (server/mp.mjs): two handlers cloned from the card broadcast — publish-factory
(writes factorystate:<user>; unlike the card page it does NOT set presence, since the
overworld heartbeat owns it) and factory-state (friend-gated read, spectator-count
heartbeat, delta-suppressed by seq). live-friends lists factory runs too.

Viewer: new overworld/factoryspec.js — a read-only scoreboard that polls the snapshot
and renders it with the shared battle UI (both mon panels with easing HP bars, team
dots, the current line, a "N watching" header), no input beyond leaving. friendAction
gains a Watch option for a `factory:` friend that opens /overworld/?watchfactory=<user>,
and a ?watchfactory boot param starts the view. Wired into the overworld loops in
parallel with the existing PVP spectate.

Test: factoryspec_test.mjs (8 — the live snapshot shape + the read-only render).
Regression green (frontier/postgame/boot). Note: this is a periodic board snapshot
(~1/sec), the same fidelity as Battlecards' solo-run spectate — not a frame-perfect
relay; no changes to the local battle engine were needed. The relay endpoints are
line-for-line clones of the tested card handlers (not separately 2-client tested).

entries.title: overworld: show Frontier Symbols on the trainer card
entries.body:
The trainer card now displays a FRONTIER SYMBOLS row — a compact line of seven
diamonds (one per facility: Tower/Dome/Factory/Palace/Arena/Pike/Pyramid), coloured
GOLD or SILVER for the symbol you've earned from that facility's Frontier Brain,
