entries.body:
Fixes the fuzzer's "current player is eliminated" invariant (was ~23/120 FFA
games; FFA fuzz now 251/251, was 118/33).

When the active player dies mid-turn in a 3+ player game that isn't over (a
self-lethal card, attacking into a lethal counter, fatigue, concede), the turn
never advanced: checkGameOver runs deep inside sweepDeaths, mid effect-
resolution, where re-entering endTurn would run the next player's whole turn on
top of a half-finished effect. So it left state.current on the dead seat — and a
live FFA would STALL there, nobody able to act. (1v1 never hit this: a self-
elimination ends the game.)

Fix: a new engine/core.js settleTurn(state) that drains the strand at a SAFE
top-level boundary — `while (!over && current.eliminated) endTurn(state)`, which
also loops for a new current player who dies during their own start-of-turn
triggers. It's a no-op whenever the active player is alive, so 1v1/solo play is
byte-for-byte unchanged (legacy fuzz seeds still 61/61, determinism preserved).

Wired at the two boundaries every advance funnels through:
- engine/actionlog.js dispatch() — after each action (covers fuzzer + replay)
- game.js pump() — after the resolveAI* drain, before events flush (covers all
  host/AI/solo play); the two ad-hoc concede handoffs collapse into it.

Regression: tests/regression/ffa_duel_test.mjs asserts the active seat conceding
strands current (validator catches it), settleTurn advances to the next living
seat + leaves a valid state, and is inert when the active player is alive / the
game is already over. Full engine suite 190/190; FFA fuzz 251/251; game.js parses.

entries.title: Deeper fuzzing: fix Felstring Harp crash + FFA-capable fuzzer
entries.body:
Ran the engine fuzzer far harder and extended it to fuzz 3-8 player FFA.

- Fix (damage.js): Felstring Harp broke on the same hit it healed — breakWeapon
  nulls p.weapon, then the next line read p.weapon.healInsteadOnOwnTurn on null
  and crashed. Capture the heal amount before breaking. Deep 2-player fuzz clean
  (151/151).
- fuzz_test.mjs: new --players arg (0 = seed-derived random 2-8 per game via a
  dedicated stream, so legacy 2-player seeds stay byte-identical; the action
  loop was already seat-generalized). Fuzzing FFA surfaced a real gap.

Found + documented (deferred, needs a careful fix): FFA "current player is
eliminated" invariant — when the current player dies mid-turn in a 3+ player
game (not over), state.current is left on the eliminated seat, which would stall
a live FFA. checkGameOver runs inside sweepDeaths mid-resolution, so endTurn
there is unsafe re-entrancy; the fix belongs at a safe point (deferred engine
turn-advance, or a game.js settle-time endTurn). See the plan note.

Full engine suite 190/190.

entries.title: Harden the relay against read-modify-write races
entries.body:
The backend is KV on D1 and get->setJSON is not atomic, so a key written by
different users at the same instant can lose an update.

Sharpest case fixed — the card-intent queue: in an FFA, two guests relaying at
the same instant both read the shared cardintent:<id> list, both append, last
write wins -> a move silently vanished -> desync. Now each intent is its OWN row
(cardintent:<id>:<seat>_<seq>), so concurrent appends can't clobber; drain uses
a prefix list() + deletes exactly the drained rows (a row added meanwhile
survives). The client sends a monotonic seq so a guest's moves apply in order
even if the fire-and-forget relays arrive reordered. Added store.list(prefix) +
deleteKeys(keys).

Also: rematch-join self-heal (the client re-offers if a concurrent write dropped
its join). Audited + documented the rest in a CONCURRENCY NOTE in mp.mjs
(matchmaking self-heals via repeated polls + the deterministic minter; per-user
collection is rarely concurrent; analytics counters are approximate).

Tests: extract test proving concurrent relays lose no intents + order preserved
(8); the rematch client test still green (6).

entries.title: FFA post-game standings screen
entries.body:
3-8 player free-for-alls showed a one-line self-summary; now they show a full
standings table: placement 1st->last (the survivor on top, then everyone else
in REVERSE elimination order), each row with the result (Survived / KO'd · turn
N), cards played, and creatures summoned — the human row highlighted, 1st in
gold.

- matchStats.elim records {seat, turn} on each 'eliminated' event (elimination
  order → placement); reset per match.
- duelStatsPayload carries elim so a duel guest renders the same standings from
  its own ingested final board.
- appendMatchSummary's 3+ player branch builds the table; 2-player keeps the
  head-to-head table.

Tests: extract test of the real appendMatchSummary (9 — placement order,
per-row result/stats, human row, 2-player unchanged) + a rendered screenshot.

entries.title: Deck builder: sort control + set filter
entries.body:
Alongside the existing type/keyword/owned filters:
- a Sort dropdown (Cost / Rarity / Name) — applyFilters now runs the filtered
  list through sortCards (cost/rarity tie-break to name).
- a Set filter dropdown, built from the pool's `set` values (57 sets; short
  lowercase codes upper-cased, others title-cased).
Both compose with tab/search/mana/type/keyword/owned.

Dropped the plan's "craftable/affordable" hint: there's no crafting or
targeted-buy economy (gold buys random packs; MP accounts use earned packs), so
a craft hint would mislead.

Tests: extract test of the real applyFilters/sortCards predicate (8 —
cost/rarity/name sort, set filter, composition) + deck-builder boot (set
dropdown populates 57, sort has 3, no regression, no errors).

entries.title: Perf headers/preconnect + cookieless self-hosted analytics
entries.body:
Analytics (no cookies, no accounts, no IPs):
- hit + stats actions in server/mp.mjs, before the token gate so anonymous
  visitors count too; a daily rollup (stat:<UTC-day>) capped at 400 keys with
  slug-sanitised labels (no injection reaches storage).
- a sendBeacon page-open beacon in the shared site/topbar.js that derives a
  coarse mode label from the URL (home, bc:duel, bc:dungeon, overworld, ...).
- stats.html (noindex): totals-over-window bars + a per-day breakdown.

Perf:
- new root _headers: code/markup revalidate (etag) for instant deploys, JSON
  5-min cache, media 7-30 day cache, + nosniff / Referrer-Policy.
- offload art cache bumped 1d -> 7d (battlecards/art/_headers) — crops are
  effectively immutable.
- preconnect/dns-prefetch to the offload domains (cardart, owdata) on the
  art-heavy pages so the TLS connection is warm before the first image.

Deferred (noted in the plan): a direct art URL to skip the 302 redirect hop
(biggest first-load win, wants a prod check), and minifying cards.json (needs a
build step, not an in-place edit the importers would revert).

Tests: analytics logic (10 — rollup, sanitisation, key cap, stats window, label
derivation) + a headless boot (beacon fires with the right label; stats.html
renders; preconnect present).

entries.title: Deck builder: type + keyword filters, Owned/All toggle
entries.body:
The builder had CLASS/NEUTRAL tabs, text search, and a mana-cost row but was
owned-only with no type/keyword filters. Added:
- a card-type dropdown and a keyword dropdown, both built from the actual
  collectible pool (no dead options), title-cased;
- an Owned/All toggle (was hard-filtered to owned) — All shows the whole
  class/neutral pool with unowned cards dimmed + "Not owned" and still
  non-addable;
- all filters compose with the existing tab/search/mana.

Tests: extract test of the real applyFilters/baseList predicate (11 —
owned-vs-all, type, keyword, mana, search + combinations) and a headless
deck-builder boot (7 — dropdowns populate from the pool, controls visible,
toggle re-filters and changes the pool, a type filter only narrows).

entries.title: FFA rematch lobby (N-player rematch)
entries.body:
Generalize the 1v1 rematch handshake into an N-player rematch lobby.

Server (duel-rematch): humans opt in with op:'offer'; a deterministic minter
(the lowest-original-seat joiner = the new host) mints a fresh cardmatch once
>=2 have joined AND either everyone present joined or a ~12s grace elapses,
reusing each returning player's original seat + deck and AI-backfilling anyone
who didn't come back. Idempotent via rematchMatchId and minter-only, so
concurrent polls can't double-mint. 1v1 is the special case (everyone present =
both) and keeps its exact behavior.

Client (mountDuelRematch): roster-generic (identity from seats[HUMAN].name, not
host/guest) with a live lobby count (joined/present) and a Join prompt for late
players; ungated so FFA over-screens offer it too. 1v1 keeps its "Accept X's
rematch" phrasing.

Tests: server extract test (19 — 1v1 preserved, FFA grace-mint + AI backfill,
seat/deck reuse, minter-only, idempotency, auth) + client extract test (6 —
join relays op:offer, mint navigates, lobby relabel, seat-aware identity).

entries.title: Match UX: opening-hand mulligan
entries.body:
At the start of your first turn (Quick Match / AI / duels) you now get an
opening-hand mulligan: tap cards to swap, confirm, and the picks shuffle back
while replacements come off the top (HS-style; the Coin can't be swapped).

- Engine mulligan(state, pi, uids): net-zero hand/deck sizes, once-per-player,
  Coin-safe, deterministic via state.rng.
- Client offers it to the human (a card-picker modal reusing the scry chrome),
  auto-mulligans AI seats (toss cost>=5), and the guest relays {k:'mulligan',
  uids} — the host is authoritative and the seeded rng keeps the swap in sync.
  Surfaced via nextEvent for host/local and openDuelModals for the guest.
- PvE run modes keep their tuned openings (mulligan gated off there).

Tests: engine mulligan_test (12), client relay/AI extract tests, and a headless
Quick-Match boot confirming the modal appears/marks/confirms/logs with no
errors. Full engine suite 190/190.

entries.title: Match UX: concede everywhere + a scrollable game log
entries.body:
Concede (Quick Match / AI / duels):
- New engine concede(state, pi) = drop to 0 life + checkGameOver. 1v1 hands the
  opponent the win; FFA drops just the conceder and the others play on.
- The 🏳 Concede button now shows in any active game you're playing (not just
  runs), hidden while spectating. Guests relay a {k:'concede'} intent (the host
  is authoritative); the host/local path applies it and, in FFA, hands the turn
  on. Local FFA vs bots ends for the player rather than watching the bots; an
  FFA host stays hosting for the remaining humans.
- A "concede" event logs "You/<name> conceded".
- Bugfix from the FFA work: the gameOver overlay only offers a rematch in 1v1
  (mountDuelRematch gated to size<=2).

Game log:
- The in-game log was a 7-line ephemeral strip (hidden on mobile). Added a 📜 Log
  button that opens a scrollable drawer with the full match history (bounded to
  500 lines), working on mobile too; the inline strip still shows the last few.

Tests: engine concede assertions in ffa_duel_test (31, 1v1 ends / FFA drops-out /
double-concede no-op), headless DOM+CSS check of the log drawer, full engine
suite 189/189.

entries.title: Multiplayer free-for-all matchmaking (2-8 players)
entries.body:
Find Match now has a table-size selector (2-8). Matchmaking gathers other
waiters who chose the same size and backfills empty seats with AI on the
existing 12s timeout, so even an 8-player table starts promptly as humans +
bots. Win = last hero standing (already in the engine).

Server (mp.mjs):
- matchmake-join takes a size; matchmake-poll groups same-size waiters, uses a
  deterministic oldest-waiter "minter" (no double-mint race), and mints a
  cardmatch with a seats[] array — humans fill 0..h-1, AI backfills the rest.
  2-player host/guest aliases kept so the rematch handshake is untouched.
- The relay generalized from host+guest to seats[]: card-act stamps each intent
  with the sender's seat (server-side, un-spoofable), card-drain returns
  seat-tagged intents, per-seat aliveness lets the host auto-pilot a dropped
  human's seat (FFA) or end by abandonment (1v1). card-match/-poll report the
  caller's seat.

Client (game.js):
- The host deals all N seats (each its own deck/hand/coin, seeded via duelSeed).
- One isAiSeat(seat) predicate replaces the old "=== HUMAN" binary: the host
  runs AI.step + resolveAI* only for seats with no live human behind them; a
  guest never simulates. applyGuestIntent applies on it.seat; a converted seat
  ignores late relays. Each guest learns its own seat (HUMAN = seat, was 1).
- Off-turn queue/priority resolves (respond/sac/dredge) now bypass the turn
  gate (they self-guard) — more correct with more players.
- The deterministic-RNG carry pays off: every guest restores the host's rng
  stream, so N optimistic mirrors stay in lockstep. Rematch stays 1v1-only.

start.html: a 2-8 size chooser in the Find Match flow; FFA-aware status text.

Tests: new ffa_duel_test (27 — engine N-seat deal, AI FFA to a winner, seat-2
guest ingest with rng-carry) in the suite (now 189/189); extract-run
seat-routing (11) and matchmaker minter/backfill (19) tests; prior duel relay
regressions still green (13, 15).

entries.title: Deterministic RNG for PvP card duels
entries.body:
Even with the relay-desync fixes, a *random* duel effect (Swamp conjure,
Discover, random target, coin flip) could flicker on the guest: the host ran
unseeded Math.random and the guest's optimistic engine re-attached its own
Math.random, so it resolved a different result for ~1.3s before the host's
snapshot corrected it.

The engine already routes all randomness through state.rng (no raw
Math.random) and ships a serializable seeded PRNG, it just wasn't wired into
duels. Now:
- host seeds its game from the shared match id: seededRng(duelSeed(duel.id))
- toSnapshot carries the rng position ({seed, calls}) for seeded games only
- fromSnapshot, given no explicit rng, reconstructs that exact stream

so the guest's rolls are byte-identical to the host's and its optimistic board
matches. Duel-only: unseeded solo/AI/run games emit no rng field and still fall
back to Math.random; normalize() strips the rng position so gameplay digests
stay rng-agnostic. seededRng/restoreRng re-exported through the engine facade.

New deterministic_duel_test (16/16) pins every link + backward compat; full
engine suite 188/188 incl. the seeded fuzz determinism test.

entries.title: Duel relay sweep: fix 5 more guest-desync action paths
entries.body:
Audited every guest-side engine mutation against the relay/host-handler
machinery (following the land-tap conjure bug). Found the same class of gap
in five more no-target action paths: the guest applied them optimistically
but never relayed an intent, so the host's next snapshot reverted them.

Cross-check first confirmed every relayed intent already has a host case.
The gaps were all "engine called directly in a menu/click handler":

- Untargeted activated ability (openActivateMenu) — {k:'activate'} existed;
  only the no-target branch skipped the relay.
- Untargeted planeswalker ability (openWalkerMenu) — same, {k:'walker'}.
- Artifact {T} ability (tapArtifact) — worse: no 'tapart' intent OR host case
  at all, and commitPending's guest branch had no 'tapart' mode, so even the
  TARGETED artifact tap relayed a stray 'play'. Added the intent, the host
  case, and the commitPending guest branch.
- Token sacrifice (Treasure/Blood/Food, sacrificeToken) — new 'sactoken'
  intent + host case.
- Hero attack into a creature/walker/hero (4 call sites) — new 'heroattack'
  intent + host case, carrying the target object.

New act* wrappers (actActivate/actWalker/actTapArtifact/actSacToken/
actHeroAttack) mirror the established pattern: guest → guestApply + intent,
host/solo → engine + pump (+ publishDuel in a duel). All loose call sites
now route through them.

Verified headless with the real extracted code (15/15 + land-tap 13/13):
each wrapper relays the right intent + applies locally, host/solo runs
direct, the host applies each on seat 1, and commitPending's targeted
artifact tap relays 'tapart' not 'play'.

entries.title: Fix: land tap card-generation desyncs for the duel guest
entries.body:
In a PvP duel the guest applies actions optimistically and relays an
intent for the host to run authoritatively. Tapping a land for a NO-TARGET
ability — e.g. Swamp's "conjure a black card" — went through a code path
(openTapMenu) that called E.tapLand directly and pumped locally, but never
relayed an intent. The host therefore never tapped/conjured, and its next
snapshot reverted the guest: the land untapped and the freshly-conjured
card vanished from hand (the log had already printed it from the guest's
optimistic run). The TARGETED tap path already relayed correctly, so only
no-target land abilities were affected.

- New actTapLand()/actSacLand() wrappers mirror actPlay/actLand: guest →
  guestApply with a {k:'tap'|'sacland'} intent, host/solo → engine + pump
  (+ publishDuel in a duel). openTapMenu now routes both the tap and the
  "cash a land in for a card" (sacrifice) buttons through them.
- Host applyGuestIntent gains a 'sacland' case (tap was already handled);
  it applies on seat 1 only during the guest's turn.

The sacrifice-for-a-card button had the identical latent desync and is
fixed the same way.

Verified with the real extracted functions (13/13): guest relays the
correct intents + applies locally without pumping, host/solo runs directly,
and the host applies the relayed tap/sacland on seat 1 (and ignores it off
-turn).

entries.title: Rematch button for PvP card duels
entries.body:
The duel-over overlay only offered "Back to your world". Both players now
get a Rematch button that jumps straight into a fresh duel with the same
decks — no re-challenge through the inbox.

- Server `duel-rematch` action (op: offer | poll): the first offer records
  the offerer; a second offer from the OTHER player (or the "Accept" the poll
  surfaces) completes the handshake, minting a new cardmatch that reuses both
  players' deck/class/commander/companion, points curmatch at it for both, and
  links back via rematchOf. This makes the flow race-safe (a double-offer
  converges to exactly one match) and idempotent (re-offering returns the same
  id). Offers expire after 120s.
- Client mountDuelRematch(): added to both the host (gameOver) and guest
  (poll over-handler, when not abandoned) duel overlays. One handler both
  offers and accepts; a poll returning the opponent's offer flips the button
  to "Accept X's rematch", and rematchMatchId (or the offer's direct matchId)
  navigates both sides to ?cardpvp=<newId>. Failed offers reset for retry.

Verified headless with the real extracted code: server handshake 18/18
(offer/poll/complete, deck reuse, race convergence, staleness, idempotency,
auth) and client wiring 8/8 (offer→navigate, incoming→Accept→navigate,
failure reset).

entries.title: Publish duel stats to the guest's post-game summary
entries.body:
In a PvP duel only the host runs the engine's event stream, so the guest —
which renders purely from relayed snapshots — had an empty matchStats and
its post-game overlay showed the result with no stat table.

- Host: publishDuel() now includes duelStatsPayload() — the seat-indexed
  tally (turns/cards/summons/heroDmgTaken) with the duration baked in as
  durS, since the guest can't read the host's performance.now() clock.
- Server: card-publish stores `stats` in the payload; card-poll already
  spreads the payload, so it reaches the guest as data.stats.
- Guest: at game-over adopts data.stats into matchStats and calls
  appendMatchSummary, which renders the You-vs-opponent table from the
  guest's HUMAN=1 seat (life still read from its own ingested final board).
- appendMatchSummary prefers a baked durS over the local start timestamp.
- Older host without stats → guard leaves the overlay clean (unchanged).

Verified headless with the real extracted functions (11/11): payload bakes
durS + carries seat arrays (no start), guest renders from seat 1 with correct
damage/cards/life attribution, and the no-stats path appends nothing. Original
post-game suite still 19/19.

entries.title: Post-game summary screen for Battlecards matches
entries.body:
Quick Match, AI matchmaking matches, and PvP duels used to end on a bare
banner + a restart button. Now they show a proper end screen.

- A per-match stat tally accumulates from the event stream (reset on turn 1
  so a same-page rematch starts fresh): turns, cards played, creatures
  summoned, and damage-to-hero (credited to the other seat in a 2-player
  game). Guarded statInc ignores bad indices.
- showPostGameSummary(): VICTORY/DEFEAT/DRAW title + a You-vs-opponent stat
  table (2p) or a one-line self summary (FFA), with the leading value gold.
  Buttons: Play again (fresh match / in-place restart), Find Match, Deck
  Builder, View final board. Duels reuse the same stat block and keep
  "Back to your world".
- Resumed/spectated games (no turn 1) degrade gracefully to just the result.

Verified headless by extracting and running the real functions: damage
attribution from both seat perspectives, life/turns/duration, the gold
highlight, the FFA fallback, the four-button wiring, and all three titles
(19/19).

entries.title: Spectate a live friend's battle from the standalone inbox
entries.body:
The spectator machinery already existed (Pokémon: pvp.js "watch" mode via
enterMatch(id, true); cards: /battlecards/?spectate=<user> polling cardstate),
but you could only trigger it by walking up to a battling friend in the
Overworld. Now the inbox Friends tab surfaces it directly.

- Reads each friend's live presence `status` from the `friends` payload:
  `battling:<matchId>` (Pokémon) or `card:<mode>` (card duel/dungeon/run).
- Tags live friends with a pulsing ● LIVE pill + a labelled sub ("in a card
  duel", "in a dungeon run", …) and swaps the challenge buttons for 👁 Watch.
- Watch routes to the existing read-only views:
    Pokémon → /overworld/?mp=1&watch=<matchId>  (new boot param → enterMatch
              spectator=true; server gates the match fetch to friends of a
              participant, so a forged id just 403s gracefully)
    card    → /battlecards/?spectate=<user>&mp=1
- Reduced-motion guard on the LIVE pulse.

Verified headless: LIVE pills, correct mode labels, the mid-match button
swap, and both spectate routes.

entries.title: Send/accept Pokémon challenges from the standalone inbox
entries.body:
The social inbox could only send *card* challenges; Pokémon challenges
routed to the Overworld because building a party snapshot needed the
Overworld's runtime team + move data.

Now site/topbar.js rebuilds that snapshot standalone: it reads the saved
team from localStorage (magepunk_party_v1) and enriches each move's
power/type/category/acc/priority from the battle move table
(/overworld/data/moves_battle.json, served cross-origin with CORS) —
producing the exact shape the Overworld's pvpParty() builds.

- Friends tab: a "⚔" Pokémon-battle button next to the card (🃏) one.
- Alerts tab: incoming Pokémon challenges now have a real "Accept"
  (was "Open in Overworld").
- On send-accepted / accept, both players are redirected to
  /overworld/?mp=1&battle=<id>; the Overworld boot reads ?battle and
  enters the match directly (no "you left a battle" rejoin prompt).
- Fainted/empty team falls back to "set up a team in the Overworld first."

Verified headless: snapshot is field-for-field identical to pvpParty(),
fainted mons are dropped, and the empty-team guard sends nothing.

entries.title: matchmaking + lobby with AI-opponent fallback
entries.body:
A "Find Match" on the start screen queues you against a real player; if nobody
else is waiting after 12s you're handed an AI opponent so you're never stuck.
The AI plays a real decklist from a pool seeded with the starter decks that
GROWS with every deck real players queue with (harvested, deduped, capped at
200) — so bots begin on the starters and are gradually replaced by real
players' decks.

Backend (server/mp.mjs):
- matchmake-join/-poll/-leave: a live queue that pairs two waiters into a
  host-authoritative cardpvp duel (host + guest, mm:matched relay, curmatch for
  both), or after MM_AI_TIMEOUT_MS mints an aimatch and returns { status:'ai' }.
  Stale entries (no poll in 8s) are dropped.
- ai-match: returns the aimatch config (human deck + AI deck + classes).
- AI deck pool: starters + harvested real decks; pickAiDeck never mirrors the
  requester's own deck.

Engine (engine/core.js): createGame gains an opponentDeckIds param so player 1
(the AI) can be dealt a specific decklist instead of a class-pool deck; the
opening hand is drawn from it.

Game (game.js): ?aimatch=<id> boots a local match vs the AI using that deck.

Frontend (start.html): a Find Match banner -> deck picker -> a searching
overlay (spinner, live elapsed, "no one around — bringing in a challenger…")
that redirects to index.html?cardpvp= (real) or ?aimatch= (AI).

Verified: pairing (two players -> same matchId, host/guest), AI fallback fires
~12s with regular polling, deck harvesting + own-deck exclusion, the engine
deck-override (AI gets exactly its deck), and the full UI flow end to end.

entries.title: Site: daily quests — 4 per day, class/type/keyword/cost/win, pack rewards
entries.body:
Backend (server/mp.mjs): four fresh quests each UTC day, seeded deterministically
per account (a refresh never rerolls them; they regenerate at UTC midnight). A
varied pool: play N cards / creatures / spells, N cards of a given CLASS, with a
KEYWORD (Taunt/Rush/Lifesteal/Deathrattle/Battlecry/Divine Shield/Windfury/
Poisonous/Reborn/Stealth/Charge), at a MANA COST (>=X / <=X / exactly X), or win
N matches — with slot 0 always completable by any deck. New actions:
- quests: the day's list + ms to reset.
- quest-event: the game reports plays/wins (batched) -> advances matching quests.
- claim-quest: a finished quest's reward packs drop into the 12h pack inbox.
Verified the generator (deterministic, 4 distinct kinds, all 6 kinds appear
across the pool) and event matching (class/type/keyword/cost/win).

Frontend (/site/topbar.js): a new Quests tab with per-quest progress bars, reward
icons, a countdown to the daily reset, and Claim buttons; the bell badge and tab
dot nudge when a quest is claimable.

Game hook (battlecards/game.js): actPlay reports {class,type,cost,keywords} for
each card the human actually plays; gameOver reports a win. Batched + fire-and-
forget (wins flush immediately; a pagehide flush avoids losing a partial batch);
gated on being logged in and not a guest.

Verified headless: the Quests tab renders progress/claim/claimed states and the
Claim flow; all files syntax-check. Plan #9 daily-quest follow-up marked done.

entries.title: fidelity fixes batch 34 — Jade Telegram, Unshackle Soul
entries.body:
- Jade Telegram: new look-enemy-hand-shuffle handler offers 3 random cards
  from the opponent's hand as a pick; a new resolvePick branch shuffles the
  chosen one (matched by instance uid) into their deck. Keeps the Jade Golem.
- Unshackle Soul: new selfCostIf cond 'enemy-copy-while-held' reads the
  pre-existing _enemyCopyWhileHeld tracker (set when you play a card copied
  from the opponent) — the destroy now costs (1) in that case.

registry 1107. 6-assertion inline check (3-of-5 offered, chosen card moves
hand->deck, Jade summoned, cost drops to 1), 187/187 suites.

FIDELITY SWEEP COMPLETE: 113/114 fully faithful; the last (lesser_sapphire_
spellstone) was already correct — its Overload upgrade conditional predates
this sweep. Every dropped HS rider across the 114 flagged spells is restored.

entries.title: fidelity fixes batch 33 — Trolley Problem (Quickdraw + spell filter)
entries.body:
discard-lowest gains a spellsOnly filter (targets the lowest-Cost SPELL, not
any card). Trolley Problem now discards your lowest-cost spell and creates two
3/3 Rush Tram Cars, with a Quickdraw rider (selfDrawnThisTurn conditional)
that skips the discard when the card was drawn this turn. No new registered
types.

4-assertion inline check (spell discarded not the creature; Quickdraw skips
the discard; Tram Cars made either way), 187/187 suites. Fidelity: 111/114.

entries.title: fidelity fixes batch 32 — Remixed Rhapsody
entries.body:
Reuses the held-card turn-start hook: a remix = {index} is whitelisted onto
instances and rotates each of the owner's turns. New
remix-damage-all-rotating-bonus handler deals 3 to all creatures and runs the
current bonus (draw / armor / a 2/2 / a random spell), which changes each turn
the card is held. registry 1106.

4-assertion inline check (3-to-all, the turn-0 draw bonus, index rotates, the
turn-1 armor bonus), 187/187 suites. Fidelity: 110/114.

entries.title: fidelity fixes batch 31 — Trust Fall
entries.body:
Paired-discover support: the discover producer forwards pairFirst/pairSecond
flags, and resolvePick remembers the first discovered minion so that when the
second resolves, the two swap-add each other's Attack and Health. Trust Fall
now Discovers two <=5-cost creatures that each gain the other's stats
(verified 3/1 + 1/5 -> both 4/6). No new registered types.

Deterministic + pool-based inline checks, 187/187 suites. Fidelity: 109/114.

entries.title: fidelity fixes batch 30 — Shroud of Concealment (forward stealth)
entries.body:
New set-stealth-summons-turn handler + a stealthSummonsTurn flag checked at

entries.title: art + integrity sweep — 100% art, 11 missing tokens, 69 dup ids
entries.body:
Art sweep: every card now has real art — 7,486/7,486. The ~80 cards added
since the art offload (aura/spend-X/hero-power/time-bomb/deck-rewrite/
modifier/one-off/warlock/rogue/final-seven families + their tokens) got HS
256x crops by name-match against the full dump; the 8 original tokens with no
HS source got thematic aliases (Essences -> the Dragonflight Explorers +
Onyxia/Twilight Drake, Crate -> Smuggler's Crate, Worm -> Bloodworm, the
Discover token -> Explore Un'Goro). Deployed to magepunk-cardart.pages.dev
(index 7,892 entries).

Functionality sweep (mechanical layer):
- Smoke-cast ALL 1,942 castable spells under strictEffects incl. resolving
  their picks/dredges: ZERO crashes.
- Effect-type audit across all cards: every referenced type is registered
  (the only flags were static/titanPassive/adventure containers, which are
  not registry effects — false positives).
- Reference audit found 11 cards pointing at token ids that never existed
  (mine, gear, worthless_imp, ww_murloc_11, all_fel_breaks_loose_infused +
  6 cosmetic inline-summon ids). All 11 defs now exist — Iron Juggernaut's
  Mine actually explodes, Scramble for Gear's Gear actually armors,
  Impbalming's Worthless Imps actually shuffle, Infuse on All Fel Breaks
  Loose actually upgrades.
- Duplicate-id audit: 69 ids appeared TWICE in cards.json (overlapping
  import waves). Deduped keeping the LAST entry — byId iteration order means
  the runtime already used it, so zero behavior change; the gallery stops
  double-listing them. 7,555 -> 7,486 cards.

186/186 suites pass. Fidelity layer (114 HS-set spells with dropped text
riders identified, fix list built) queued — the fix workflow hit the session
limit and resumes when it clears.

entries.title: additive hero powers everywhere + the time-bombs family
entries.body:
Additive conversion (house rule, now universal): new shared core helper
addHeroPower() — a granted power always JOINS your row (max 3; at the cap the
discardPower pick opens). Converted every legacy replace/push site: the
set-hero-power handler (Vilefin, Dinomancy, Charged Hammer, Naielle, the ULDA
divers), Sir Finley's discovered power, Sideshow Spelleater's copy, and Blood
Doctor Thalena (now cap-safe). Yoink was a silent no-op (its discover flag was
never handled) — now it works: discovers a power, adds it at Cost (0), and it
vanishes after 2 uses (setCost/uses ride the pick). Converted card texts say
"Gain a new Hero Power: ...".

Time-bombs family (4 hard-listed spells, real HS cost/rarity/set):
- Wheel of DEATH!!! (warlock): destroy your deck; in 5 turns destroy target
  opponent. New generic 'delayed' effect — an enchantment counting down at
  your turn-ends that fires onExpire effects (rides the timed-aura loop).
- Immolate (warlock): marks target opponent's current hand instances; the
  3-turn bomb destroys any still in hand (played/new cards escape).
- Rhythm and Roots (druid): Choose One — three 5/5 Ancients in 2 turns, or
  three 8/8s in 4 (delayed summons).
- Silk Stitching (death knight): choose a friendly minion, discover a <=4-cost
  spell; it gains "Deathrattle: cast it" (new castOnDeathUid pick mode +
  cast-random-spell with a fixed id pool; targeted discover map entry).

timebombs_test (17). Pool regenerated (6,231). 180/180 suites pass.

entries.title: hero-power family — additive powers per the house rule
entries.body:
Shadowform (priest), Metamorphosis (demon hunter), Story of Sulfuras (warrior)
+ their power tokens (Mind Spike, Demonic Blast, DIE, INSECT!).

House rule (per design): gaining a hero power never replaces your old one —
the new power JOINS your row, up to the 3-power cap; at the cap a pick opens
(resolvePick mode discardPower) and the power you choose is discarded to make
room. So the HS "swap back after 2 uses" becomes power.uses = 2: the granted
power simply vanishes after its 2 activations (lifetime counter _usesGame —
the existing _uses counter is per-turn and resets, which the first cut missed).

New add-hero-power handler (registry 1048 -> 1049) + resolvePick discardPower
branch + limited-use removal in useHeroPower. 12-assertion behavior test incl.
the cap pick flow; pool regenerated (6,227). 179/179 suites pass.

entries.title: card-language normalization sweep (create / gain life / target opponent)
entries.body:
Vocabulary rules, applied to every display-text field (description + all
nested `text:` strings; ids, names, and effect types untouched):
- "summon" -> "create" (Summon/Summons/Summoned/Summoning, Resummon ->
  Recreate) EXCEPT sentences that genuinely summon from the deck. Shuffle-
  tokens that create a minion "when drawn" count as creates (the shuffled
  card is in the deck, not the minion).
- "Restore X Health to your hero" -> "Gain X life" (matches the MTG-voiced
  WUBRG imports); "to each/both heroes" -> "Each player gains X life";
  "equal to" variants too. Combined-target texts guarded (Fan Club now reads
  "Gain 3 life & restore 3 Health to your creatures").
- "the enemy hero" -> "target opponent", acknowledging multiplayer.

211 strings across 196 cards in cards.json + 47 run-mode texts (heist/tombs/
duels boss powers, treasures, passives) + the Cook glossary line. The one
surviving "Summon" in run-mode text is Kaye Toogie's real from-deck summon.
176/176 suites pass.

smaller MAGEPUNK on the card back + unhurried pack opening
entries.body:
Card back: the MAGEPUNK wordmark drops from 44px to 28px so it sits comfortably
inside the sigil circle instead of overflowing it.

Pack opening: finishing a pack no longer arms every click to tear the next one.
In the done phase a stray click does nothing dangerous — clicking a revealed
card inspects it (tooltip), and only a deliberate action opens the next pack:
the new "Open another pack (N left)" button, clicking the pack/stack itself,
or the Z / Enter shortcut. The hint invites you to linger, and the button
hides when you're out of packs (or gold in free play).

entries.body:

- 207 slash tribes ("Elemental/Beast", "Undead/Pirate", ...) rewritten space-

supports the new space form and fixes a latent bug: paper multi-word tribes
("Undead Beast", "Pandaren Samurai") never matched those mechanics because
they only split on slashes. ff5 tribe pins + wave8's tokenizer updated to the
space form. 176/176 suites pass.

entries.title: Add a working /login screen; retire the defunct /magepunktest door
entries.body:
The /magepunktest login page has been dead since the Cloudflare + D1 migration
(that path never actually deploys — it falls through to the root landing page,
even on the last-good build). The account BACKEND is fine (verified register/
login against /api/mp on D1 live), only the page was gone — which the new
mandatory-login gating exposed.

New simple /login screen (login/index.html) wired to the same mpmode.js auth
(register/login -> /api/mp): username+password, login/create-account toggle,
error display, and a ?next redirect back to wherever you were sent from
(default /overworld/); already-logged-in visitors skip straight through.
requireLogin() and logout() now point at /login/ instead of /magepunktest/,
and the learnmagepunk link too.

entries.title: Offload battlecards/art + overworld/data to their own Pages projects
entries.body: Root fix for the 20,000-file Cloudflare Pages limit that was failing every build for ~4h. The two big asset folders now live in dedicated Pages projects and are served cross-origin with CORS: - battlecards/art -> magepunk-cardart.pages.dev (7,838 files) - overworld/data -> magepunk-owdata.pages.dev (11,896 files) _redirects routes /battlecards/art/* and /overworld/data/* to them (302), same pattern as designwiki/sprites. Both projects serve Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (via a _headers file), and the canvas image loaders now set crossOrigin 'anonymous' (cardart.js artFor/preloadArt, overworld engine.js getImage) so WebGL/2D canvas draws stay untainted. Audio and plain display need no change. The folders are git-rm --cached'd and gitignored (kept on disk to redeploy the sub-projects). Main deployment drops 21,862 -> 2,128 tracked files, far under the limit. This unblocks the whole 4-hour backlog.

entries.title: Overworld: arcade box launches Pair of Pears directly + require login

Account system reactivated (Part 2):

with bottom edges tilted forward — then drew over its lower half. Pull the
hovered card toward the camera (+0.45 z) instead so it sits in front. Faces are
opaque and depth-tested, so this is a depth fix, not a renderOrder one.

entries.title: Heist/Tombs boss decks: make buildBossDeck spell-inclusive
entries.body:
The generative boss decks were minion-only (filtered type==='creature'),
so Heist/Tombs bosses never cast spells - inaccurate vs real HS decks.
Now class-themed bosses draw ~1/3 of their deck from real class spells
(sorcery/instant/secret/trap of the boss's class); tribe-only and neutral
bosses stay minion-heavy (a spell can't carry a creature tribe). Mage
bosses now run 5 spells, Priest 5, etc.

Exact per-boss decklists are NOT sourceable (dungeon-run decks are
server-side; the wiki/datamining only document boss hero-powers + special
cards, which the pool JSON already has - that's why dungeon.js's hardcoded
decks are labeled "community records"). So spell-inclusive themed
generation is the accurate-achievable fix, and it auto-benefits from every
imported spell.

Applied identically to heist.js + tombs.js. Boss-deck tests + full battery
175/175 (bosses playing spells doesn't destabilize the AI).

entries.title: @ Hunter spell import batch 1: 19 spells incl. the first Traps
entries.body:

then an unlock wave recovered 11 more -> 19/30 (best batch yet).

Traps: per the "trap in the name -> it is a trap" rule, Dart/Ice/Rat Trap
become type:trap (p.traps) instead of secrets. Traps already fire
identically to secrets via fireSecrets but are not counted by
secret-synergy.

New engine support (registry 1011 -> 1013):
- secret/trap triggers hero-power-used (Dart Trap) and enemy-card-played
  + cardsPlayedThisTurn condition (Rat Trap, Motion Denied)
- buff-minion honors of:target (Bait and Switch)
- summon-copy-of-triggering-minion dormant param (Emergency Maneuvers)
- summon-redirect cost param = random N-cost as new target (Wandering Monster)
- bounce-caster-spell: counter + return to caster at +cost (Ice Trap)

Test spells_hunter_batch1_test.mjs (33). Battery 173/173 incl. fuzz.

entries.title: secret-reward unlock wave 2 — recover 5 more Mage Secrets

Appended the 5 secrets. 13-assertion test drives each end-to-end. As with the last
secret wave, these reward primitives unblock the same patterns for every class's
Secrets. Battery 172/172, fuzz clean.

pool-index shifts with every card added (and this file's own t_kill test def is in
the pack pool), so it now just asserts the battlecry resolved. No new registered
effect types (trigger effects don't count). Battery 170/170, fuzz clean.

entries.title: Mage unlock effects — recover 3 rejects (2 recurring)

entries.title: lifesteal on damage-adjacent — unlocks Felscream Blast
entries.body:
damage-adjacent now sums the damage it deals (target + neighbors) and, with
e.lifesteal, heals the caster's hero for that total — matching the per-effect
lifesteal convention already used by damage/random-damage. Recovers Felscream Blast
(DH Fel: "Lifesteal. Deal 1 to a minion and its neighbors."), which was rejected in
the Fel batch only because damage-adjacent ignored the lifesteal flag. Appended it.

No new effect type (registry stays 1009). Battery 163/163, fuzz clean.

entries.title: Relic subsystem + Relic Vault — HS location set now 52/52 COMPLETE
entries.body:
Unblocks the last missing location by building the DH Relic mechanic:
- `relic:true` instance flag. Player-level relicImprove counter: each Relic played
  bumps it, and runSpell sets card.improveCount = relicImprove before resolving so
  the existing improveScaled machinery scales the Relic (Extinction hits, Phantasms
  Spirits, Dimensions draws) by how many Relics you've played. Incremented once
  after (a doubled Relic still improves once).
- nextRelicDoubleCast flag + next-relic-double-cast effect: Relic Vault's tap makes
  your next Relic this turn cast twice (via card.castTwice), consumed on use, reset
  at turn end.
- Imported the 3 Relic cards (Extinction/Phantasms/Dimensions, relic:true +
  improveScaled:'count') + Relic Vault (DH location). Set REVENDRETH.

18-assertion test (relics) covers improve scaling, cross-Relic improve, the Vault
double-cast, single-improve-when-doubled, and the turn-scoped flag. Registry 1009
(registry-count assertion 1008->1009). Battery 163/163, fuzz clean.

HS collectible set: minions + weapons (200/200) + locations (52/52) all COMPLETE;
only spells remain.

Battery 162/162, fuzz clean.

entries.title: two spell-import unlock effects — deckNoMinions + excessToNeighbors
entries.body:
Highest-leverage new mechanics from the Mage-damage prototype's rejected tail:

- `damage` gains an excessToNeighbors rider on the chosen-target branch: excess

Appended the two cards these unlock (Malfunction, Combustion). No new registered
effect types (registry stays 1008). 10-assertion test (spells_new_effects) covers
both bonus/no-bonus and excess/no-excess paths. Battery 161/161, fuzz clean.

entries.title: spell-import prototype — 12 Mage damage spells via workflow

(greps handlers, copies structure from existing cards, refuses to invent effects).
A deterministic gate validated effect vocab + smoke-tested + honored self-reported
needsNewEffect flags.

Result: 12/20 passed clean (60% — matches the scope estimate); 8/20 correctly
rejected as needing new engine mechanics (double-spell-damage, deckNoMinions,
excessToNeighbors, elemental-conditional-target, died-this-game scaling, etc.).

Appended the 12 survivors + 7 companion tokens (Second Flame, Roaring Torch, the
Ignite escalation chain, Frozen Touch infused). 23-assertion behavioral test
(spells_mage_damage) verifies real behavior: Icicle's frozen-conditional draw,

discount, Frost Lich Cross-Stitch's on-death summon, Arcane Barrage's 7-total,

Battery 160/160, fuzz clean. HS spells: ~34 -> ~46 real + prototype validated.

entries.title: locations wave 5 — Zuramat's Prison (+ Zuramat the Obliterator)
entries.body:

Card texts + token stats web-verified. Registry 1006 -> 1008. 9-assertion test

covers use 1, the improved use 2, and the improveCount across 3 uses.
Battery 157/157, fuzz clean. Locations: 49 of 52.

entries.title: locations wave 2 — Clutch of Corruption (Dragon egg-hatch)

  Dragon. Uses summon+summonId so the copy keeps the Dragon's own abilities, plus a

- Clutch of Corruption (Warrior epic, Into the Emerald Dream): tap targets a

covers summon, hatch, buffed-stat copy, and the Dragon-required targeting.

entries.title: locations wave 1 — Cenarion Hold (Choose One = both effects)
entries.body:
- next-choose-one-both effect sets a nextChooseOneBoth flag; consumed at play time
  onto a per-card _chooseBoth latch, which liveEffectsOf honors by forcing the
  choice to ALL branches (effectsOf already supports an array of indices). Latching
  per-card keeps "both" intact across doubled battlecries (Brann/castTwice).
- Cenarion Hold (Druid epic, Caverns of Time): tap -> your next Choose One card
  this turn has both effects combined. Flag lasts one turn, consumed by one card.

Location wiki-diff: exactly 6 HS locations missing (46/52 owned; 5 of mine are
Battlecards originals). Relic Vault DEFERRED — the Relic mechanic/cards aren't
modeled yet. Card text web-verified. Registry 1003 -> 1004. 8-assertion test
(locations_wave6). Battery 155/155, fuzz clean. Locations: 47 of 52.

entries.title: wave 34 — Tiny Pal (4-element ammunition weapon)
entries.body:
- set-tiny-pal-ammo + tiny-pal-attack effects: the weapon carries an `ammo` field.

  fires the loaded element then rotates to a different one.
- Ammo effects reuse existing handlers: Fire = 1 to all enemies, Frost = Freeze 2
  random enemies, Earth = summon a random 3-Cost minion with Taunt, Air = a random
  Battlecry minion that costs (2) less.
- "Choose another ammunition" is modeled as a random rotation to a different element
  (initial pick is a real player choice; effects are faithful).

All four ammo texts web-verified (EfVH). Registry 1001 -> 1003. 15-assertion test
(weapons_wave34). Battery 154/154, fuzz clean. Progress: 136 of 153 — collectible
weapon set COMPLETE (all known-missing weapons wired).

entries.title: wave 33 — Stardust Scythe + Void Soul (improve-scaling token)
entries.body:
- void-soul effect: summons a random Demon whose Cost is 1 + a player-level
  voidSoulImprove counter, then increments it — so each Void Soul you play summons
  a Demon one Cost higher (1-cost, then 2, then 3...).
- Stardust Scythe (DH): a hero-attacks ongoing conjures a Void Soul to your hand
  after each hero attack. Void Soul is a 1-mana uncollectible spell.

Found via wiki weapon-list diff. Card texts + Void Soul cost web-verified (EfVH).
Registry 1000 → 1001. 10-assertion test (weapons_wave33) covers the get-on-attack
path and the 1/2/3-Cost improve scaling. Battery 153/153, fuzz clean.
Progress: 135 of 153.

entries.title: wave 32 — Barbed Thorn (Choose One weapon)
entries.body:
- Weapon equip now passes the Choose One selection to runBattlecry (was dropped),
  so choose-one weapons work.
- grant-weapon-ability gains keywordTurn (grant a weapon keyword until end of turn,
  tracked in _turnKeywords and cleared at turn end) and deathrattle (append a

entries.title: "improve" Festival instruments — 7 weapons + scaling-deathrattle mechanic
entries.body:
Built the Festival-of-Legends "improve" mechanic: a weapon's ongoing ticks
source.improveCount on a matching action while equipped, and its Deathrattle's
number scales by that count. execEffects honors an `improveScaled` field
(stats|count|value) that bumps the effect's attack/health, count, or value by
source.improveCount. Two new effects (improve-tick, discount-next-spell) + a
minCost ongoing condition. Registry 979 → 981.

Instruments:
- Disco Maul: play minions → Deathrattle +N/+N to a random friendly.
- Timber Tambourine: play 5+ Cost cards → summon N 5/5 Ancients.
- Glaivetar: play Outcast cards → draw N.
- Record Scratcher: play Combo cards → refresh N Mana Crystals.
- Kodohide Drumkit: gain Armor → deal N to all minions.
- Jazz Bass: Overload → your next spell costs (N) less.
- Jungle Jammer: cast spells → summon N random 1-Cost Beasts.

entries.title: missing HS weapons & locations wave 3 — 37 cards (multi-agent workflow batch)
entries.body:

pipeline: a 35-agent wiring pass produced faithful specs by grepping the engine
to reuse real effects, then a 13-agent adversarial verification pass confirmed
each against the real card text (catching silently-broken wiring — e.g. Poison
conditions that never fire, `traded` ongoings unreachable from hand).

Orchestrator-side QA before applying anything:
- strict validation of every effect / event / condition-key / per-value against
  the real engine vocabulary (not just "does the name exist");
- kept only the 40 `faithful` verdicts + 1 machine-verified fix (Rinling's Rifle);
- crash-smoke all 37 with strict-effects on;
- caught + fixed a data-prep bug: all workflow weapons had durability 0 (HS stores
  weapon durability in the `health` field, not `durability`) — restored from the
  authoritative HearthstoneJSON data.

Includes Warglaives of Azzinoth, Defiled Spear, Hope of Quel'Thalas, Necrium
Blade, Light's Sorrow, Ringmaster's Baton, + 6 locations (Muck Pools, Mosh Pit,
Spawning Pool, Starport, Warp Gate, Fairy Tale Forest).

entries.title: fix Glowstone Gyreworm's real Forge text (Quickdraw → Battlecry)
entries.body:
The earlier wiring guessed "Forge: Deal 10 instead". Verified against the
Hearthstone wiki: the real card is "Lifesteal. Quickdraw: Deal 5 damage. Forge:
Change Quickdraw to Battlecry." — the damage stays 5; Forge changes WHEN it fires.

- Base: Quickdraw (engine `miracle`, gated on drawnThisTurn) deals 5; removed the
  stray Battlecry keyword so the base is Quickdraw-only.
- Forge: new `clearMiracle` applyForge primitive drops the draw-gated version and
  installs a plain Battlecry (Deal 5) + the Battlecry keyword — so a forged copy
  deals 5 on every play, drawn or not.

Description corrected to the verbatim card text. forge_riders test now covers all
three cases (Quickdraw hits when drawn, whiffs when not, forged always fires).

entries.title: wire the 7 remaining Forge cards (bespoke upgrade riders)
entries.body:
Completes Forge coverage. Three new applyForge primitives (core.js): `ongoing`
(replace the trigger), `miracle` (replace the Miracle), `clearChoices` (drop a
Choose One). Plus a `buff` param on the summon handler's summonId branch.

Cards:
- XB-488 Disposalbot: Forge → Gain Lifesteal (keyword).
- Eulogizer: Forge → deal 3 AND gain 3 Corpses instead of spending them.
- Champion of Storms: Forge → the summoned 4/2 Elemental now has Rush (ongoing
  replaced with a Rush-granting summon).
- Disciple of Sargeras: Forge → the two Imps get +2 Health and Taunt (summon
  buff + grant → 3/4 Taunt).
- Mechagnome Guide: Forge → the Discovered spell costs (3) less (discover costMod).
- Gloomstone Guardian: Forge → "Do NEITHER" (clearChoices removes the downside).
- Glowstone Gyreworm: wired its base Miracle (Deal 5) that was unimplemented,
  then Forge → Deal 10. NOTE: the source data left this rider "pending" with no
  text, so the +5 upgrade is an inferred, sensible reading.

Battery 115/115, fuzz clean.

entries.title: implement the Forge mechanic (+ Melted Maker)
entries.body:
Forge (Showdown in the Badlands) was entirely unimplemented — 13 cards named it
in text, none had wiring. Built the mechanic end to end:

Engine (core.js):
- `forge` instance field + `canForge` / `forgeCard(state, pi, uid)` action:
  pay the cost (default 2), upgrade the card in hand, fire the `forged` event.
- applyForge primitives: buff (+X/+Y), keywords, magnetic, costDelta, endless
  (re-forgeable), battlecry (replace effects), addBattlecry (append), into
  (transform). One-time forges spend the ability; endless ones keep it.

Melted Maker: `ongoing:{on:'forged'}` → new `copy-forged-to-hand` trigger clones
the UPGRADED card into your hand (spent, so the copy can't be re-forged).

Wired 5 real Forge cards across every primitive: Cyclopian Crusher (+3/+2),
Storm Giant (-2 cost, endless), Lab Constructor (gain Magnetic), Muscle-o-Tron
(battlecry +1/+1 → +2/+2), Watcher of the Sun (append: restore 6 Health).

UI (game.js): Forge surfaced exactly like Trade/Prepare — context menu, card
action panel, and the multiplayer intent replay case (deterministic guest play).
AI (ai.js): forges leftover-mana cards; endless cards only Forge while still
unplayable (shaves cost toward castability, no mana-drain loop).

23-assertion regression test (forge_test): cost gate, one-time vs endless, all
five upgrade primitives, and the Melted Maker copy. Battery 114/114, fuzz clean.

entries.title: Group F wave 4 (tail) — Whirlwind Tempest + Glinda Crowskin
entries.body:

  maxAttacks now reads it (4 attacks). Pure aura — retracts if the Tempest leaves.
- Glinda Crowskin: minions in your hand have Echo. New `handMinionEcho` instance
  field; the play path's echo branch now also fires when a creature is played
  while a handMinionEcho minion is on board (leaves the Echo ghost copy). Spells
  are unaffected (minions only).

Documented SKIPS (need a bespoke mechanism, not card wiring): ogre_gang_rider
(50% attack-replacement) and the MTG-Cascade cards (fandral_staghelm,
the_first_sliver, nak_stormspell_sneak).

12-assertion regression test (groupf_wave4): mega-windfury grant/retract + attack
cap, Echo ghost on minion play, spells excluded, no-Glinda control. Battery

entries.title: Group F wave 3 — hero & weapon auras (Spiderling / Inara / Spirit of the Team / Vulpera Toxinblade)
entries.body:

(state, p) so it can gate "on your turn" live; it adds:
- heroAura: board minions grant the hero +Attack, `yourTurn` gates to your turn.
- weaponAura: board minions grant your weapon +Attack (only while armed).

Signature change threaded through all 13 call sites (core.js, damage.js, ai.js,
exec.js, handlers-hero/summon, tombs_powers test). New instance fields registered
in instantiate.

Cards:
- Spiderling: hero +1 Attack on your turn.
- Inara Stormcrash: hero +2 Attack & Windfury on your turn (reuses the existing
  heroWindfury flag for the second swing).
- Spirit of the Team: hero +2 Attack on your turn + battlecry temp-stealth-self
  (the existing "Stealth until your next turn" effect).
- Vulpera Toxinblade: your weapon has +2 Attack (pure aura — drops if removed).

17-assertion regression test (groupf_wave3): on-turn vs off-turn gating, the
Windfury second swing, battlecry stealth, and weapon aura add/remove. Battery
112/112, fuzz clean.

entries.title: Group F wave 2 — conditional/filtered auras (Funkfin / Red Herring / Vessina)
entries.body:
Three new additive aura filters in engine/auras.js, then pure-data wiring:

- divineShield: applies only to creatures that currently HAVE a Divine Shield
  (reads c.shield, so the buff drops when the shield pops) — Funkfin (+2 Atk to
  your shielded creatures; also restored its own Divine Shield keyword).
- notName: excludes same-named creatures — Red Herring (your NON-Red Herring
  creatures have Stealth; all copies excluded, not just the source; also
  restored its own Taunt).
- whileOverloaded: the aura only applies while the source's owner is Overloaded
  this turn (p.overloadLockedThisTurn > 0) — Vessina (+2 Atk to your other
  creatures while Overloaded).

15-assertion regression test (groupf_wave2) covering shield-pop drop-off,
multi-copy name exclusion, and the overload on/off transition. Battery 111/111,
fuzz clean.

entries.title: Group E wave 5 — Harried Herdsman (Fire spell → Beasts attack random enemies)
entries.body:
Harried Herdsman made faithful: an ongoing on spell-played gated to school:Fire
(schoolOf reads the spell's `tribe`; 4 real Fire spells + 59 schooled spells
exist) fires a new `beasts-attack-random` handler. It snapshots the friendly
Beast uids up front (combat reshapes the board), then swings each surviving,
non-dormant Beast at a random enemy CREATURE via resolveCombat + sweepDeaths —
the same fuzz-safe loop attack-random-enemy uses. The Herdsman (Human Ranger)
never swings itself; Beasts never hit the enemy hero; empty enemy board no-ops.

This is the last easily-wired Group E card. The remaining ones each need a new
subsystem, not wiring: melted_maker (no Forge), misplaced_pyromancer (no
Shatter), sanctum_spellbender (spell-redirect), the_harvester_of_envy
(copied-from-opponent provenance), auctioneer_jaxon (Discover-to-draw-from-deck),
service_ace (self-gains-attack hook), neptulon (Colossal Hands).

entries.title: Group E wave 4 — condition-awaken sleepers (Stockades Prisoner / Crystalline Statue / Dozing Kelpkeeper)
entries.body:
Three "Starts Dormant, awakens after you <action>" cards made faithful. Each now
carries a big dormant:99 fallback (matching Slumbering Sprite) plus an ongoing
that counts the action and wakes early:

- Stockades Prisoner: card-played need:3 (once) → awaken-self.
- Crystalline Statue: card-drawn need:4 (once) → awaken-self.
- Dozing Kelpkeeper: spell-played → accrue-mana-awaken (threshold 5), summing
  the played spell's Cost per-instance.

New trigger handlers awaken-self + accrue-mana-awaken share a wakeDormantSelf
helper that mirrors the turn-tick awaken path (dormantLeft→0, drowsy for the
turn, fire the `awaken` effects). Dormant minions' ongoings already fire (only
isDead is skipped), and the played card is added to the board AFTER card-played
fires — so a sleeper never counts its own play. ongoing is cloned per-instance,
so the need/_manaAccrued counters are safe. Previously these were plain
dormant:2 (woke purely on a turn timer).

12-assertion regression test (groupe_wave4), incl. the Rush cards attacking the
turn they wake. Battery 108/108, fuzz clean. registerTrigger — registry 975.

entries.title: Group E wave 3 — Invent-o-Matic + Clumsy Steward + Orion (Magnetize / draw / secret-reveal triggers)
entries.body:

  card-drawn event + new `make-drawn-temporary` handler (sets card.temporary;

  draw — owner-scoped, since an enemy-wide version would be broken.
- Orion, Mansion Manager: after a friendly Secret is revealed, cast a different
  Mage Secret and gain +2/+2. Threads `secretOwner` into the secret-revealed
  ctx + new `friendlySecret` condition, then reuses install-random-secret
  (cardClass mage) + buff-self. secretOwner is additive — existing consumers
  (Eaglehorn) ignore it.

Verified ALREADY faithful (not re-wired): Lumia (heroImmuneOnDamage, damage.js),
Anchorite (overhealReactive, exec.js).

entries.title: fix Duels/Heist/Tombs hero power rendering as a loose table card
entries.body:
In run modes the hero power is a special power in heroPowers[0] (e.g.
duelshp_primal_power), not <class>_power. classPowerOf only treated that slot-0
power as the orb power for the HUMAN, so an OPPONENT's run-mode power had no orb
and fell through to the table-render filter (which places any non-<class>_power
on the field) — showing the enemy hero power as a card among the minions
(reported: Darius Crowley's "Primal Power" on the board).

Fix: classPowerOf recognizes the slot-0 run-mode power for EVERY player, and the
table-render filter now excludes whatever classPowerOf returns. The opponent's
power now draws as their orb; also removes a double-render of the human's own
run-mode power (previously both orb and table card).

Battery 84/84.

entries.title: Aggramar + Sargeras — Group B (Titans) COMPLETE, 12/12

entries.title: Titan framework + 5 faithful Titans (Group B wave 1)
entries.body:
Builds the Titan mechanic on the existing activated-ability system: a Titan
can't attack until it has used all 3 of its abilities (canAttackWith gate),
one ability per turn (abilityUsedThisTurn), each usable once (oncePerGame),
and each use fires its "After this uses an ability, ..." passive
(fireTitanPassive: double-other-abilities / repeat-on-random-friendly /
after-ability-effects). activated is now deep-cloned in instantiate so
Norgannon's power-doubling can't leak across instances.

Faithful this wave: Norgannon (5 dmg + double the other abilities; Ancient
Knowledge via new enemy-cards-cost-more effect; Cast a random Mage Secret),
Khaz'goroth (added — was missing; +2/+2 & draw a weapon / +5 Atk / +5 Health,
passive Immune + attack a random enemy minion), V-07-TR-0N Prime (abilities
repeat on another random friendly), Eonar (draw-to-full / heal-full / refresh
mana, passive summons a 5/5 Ancient), Yogg-Saron (mind-control / mass-attack /
fill hand with 1/1 Chaotic Tendrils, passive casts two random spells).

Client: Titans present their abilities as a Discover-style pick (used/locked
options removed); all-spent Titans fall through to attacking. AI already drives
activated abilities. One new effect handler (registry 957 -> 958).

entries.title: Group A transform: Lady Naz'jar (while-held school trigger + 3 forms)

The 3 forms are new non-collectible cards whose battlecries reuse existing

The other two transform cards are bigger and deferred: Lady Naz'jar and Carress

entries.title: Faithfulness wave 2 (Group A core): in-hand "swap Attack/Health each turn" hook

entries.title: Totemic Power: implement the real basic/non-basic Totem behavior
entries.body:
Was a placeholder that summoned a single generic Totem. Now matches the actual
Instructor Fireheart hero power: summon a random basic Totem; if you're
Overloaded, summon a non-basic Totem instead.

Basic pool = the 4 classic totems (Healing / Searing / Stoneclaw / Wrath of
Air) via summon-random `ids`. Non-basic pool = summon-random over tribe Totem
capped at cost <= 3 — the default random pool already excludes the 4 basics
(they're token cards) and the cost cap excludes the oversized totem minions
(Gigantotem 8/8 @10, Totem Goliath 5/5 @5), leaving the real utility totems
(Mana Tide, Flametongue, Totem Golem, EVIL Totem, etc.). Gated with a
conditional on `overloaded`. Every summonable totem already has art.

Test (8): not-overloaded only ever yields the 4 basics (all with art);
overloaded never yields a basic, only real Totem-tribe minions, never the
oversized ones. Battery green (71/71) + fuzz clean.

entries.title: Totemic Power: summon the real Stoneclaw Totem (has art) instead of a generic Totem

entries.title: Raise the Alarm: reword to "Create two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens"

entries.title: Kor Hookmaster -> "Battlecry: Freeze target creature"

entries.title: Blacksmith's Skill -> Immune for 3 turns; Elite Vanguard -> Human Soldier
entries.body:
Blacksmith's Skill previously granted `indestructible` permanently. It now
gives a creature IMMUNE (can't take damage, destroy-proof) for 3 of the
controller's turns. Reused the existing grant-immune-turn handler with a new
`turns` option (Immune for N of the controller's turns instead of just this
turn); a turn-start countdown in core.js decrements immuneTurnsLeft for the
active player's creatures and drops IMMUNE at 0. No new effect type, so no

Elite Vanguard is now tribe "Human Soldier".

Test (8): Elite Vanguard's tribe; Blacksmith's Skill grants Immune, blocks all
damage, stays through your next two turns, then wears off on your 3rd turn and
damage lands again. Full battery green (69/69) + fuzz clean.

entries.title: Ravenous Squirrel: reword to "gain +1/+1"; drop the wrong Counter hovertext
entries.body:
Its text read "put a +1/+1 counter on this creature." The card-face keyword
tooltips (keywordsFor) match phrases in the description with a word-boundary
regex, so the word "counter" pulled in the spell-counter keyword's tooltip
("Counter target spell — play in response to counter it") — completely wrong
for a +1/+1 buff.

The `add-counters` effect was already a plain permanent +1/+1 buff, so only the
wording was off. Reworded to "Whenever you sacrifice a token, gain +1/+1.",
which removes the "counter" match and its incorrect hovertext. Verified
keywordsFor now returns no keywords (was ['Counter target spell']) and the
+1/+1 still fires on a token sacrifice (2/2 -> 3/3). Battery green (68/68).

entries.title: Fix: dungeon-run overlays clipped their top when taller than the viewport
entries.body:
The shared dungeonOverlay is a full-screen flex column with
`justify-content:center` + `overflow:auto`. When its content is taller than
the viewport (e.g. the Duels hero picker, now 18 heroes), centering pushed the
top above the scroll origin — so the title and first row of heroes were cut off
on desktop with no way to scroll up (mobile's taller aspect happened to fit).

Switched to `justify-content:safe center`: it still centers when the content
fits, but falls back to top-aligned (fully scrollable) when it overflows.
Applies to every dungeon overlay (hero/power/anomaly/draft/bucket pickers).

Verified headless at a short desktop viewport: the "PICK YOUR HERO" title sits
at the top and the grid scrolls all the way down to Diablo and the generals.

entries.title: Board: pull the creature row off the land slots; always hide enemy hands
entries.body:
Two 3D-board fixes:

1. Creature row overlapped the land slots. The creature row sat at slice-Z 2.0,
   the land row at 3.05 — the large creature tokens bled into the lands. Added a
   CREATURE_Z constant (1.15) that pulls the creature row forward toward the
   battle line, clearing the lands while staying short of the center so it never
   collides with the opponent's mirrored creatures.

2. The opponent's hand could show its faces. Hiding relied purely on card
   orientation ("back to the table"), which can leak the face at some camera
   angles / modes. faceMaterialFor now renders enemy hand cards (zone 'hand',
   controller !== HUMAN) with the card BACK regardless of orientation, and
   faceSig tracks that hidden state so the face repaints the instant the card
   leaves the hand (e.g. the opponent plays it). Your own hand is unchanged.

Verified with headless board screenshots: creatures sit clear of the lands and
of the enemy line, and the opponent's hand shows card backs.

entries.title: Fix stale Duels menu text; news feed catches run-mode commits
Add 5 cards + fix a latent once-ongoing determinism bug
entries.body:
New paper cards (all data-only except one shared condition):
- Rothga, Bonded Engulfer (4, legendary Phyrexian Beast, 4/4): Battlecry reveal
  a Phyrexian -> next Beast this turn +4/+4 (conditional holdingTribe ->
  set-next-tribe-play-reward); Trample.
- Magmatic Scorchwing (5, Dragon, 4/4): Battlecry, if you control a Mountain and
  no other lands, deal 3 to any target; Firebreathing & Windfury. Needed one new
  `conditional` predicate `onlyLandName` (control only lands of a given name);
  the targeted damage flows through the conditional's `target: any`.
- Blightwing Whelp (3, Phyrexian Demon, 2/2): Poisonous & Windfury.
- Feywild Prankster (4, Faerie Rogue, 1/4): Battlecry Choose One - swap a
  creature's Attack & Health, or deal 3 to a creature & give it +3 Attack.
- Underbridge Warlock (5, Ogre Warlock, 5/4): Deathtouch; turn-end ongoing deals
  5 to each opponent hero (enemy-heroes).

Engine fix (surfaced by the new cards reshuffling fuzz seed 9419695): the
singular `ongoing` was copied BY REFERENCE in instantiate() while the plural
`ongoings` was deep-cloned. A `once`/`need`/`every` trigger (e.g. Warsong
Envoy's Frenzy, Outfitted Jouster's Frenzy) set its spent/trigCount on the
SHARED card def, leaking to every other instance and across games in one
process — a determinism failure. instantiate() now clones `ongoing` too.

Tests: 15-assertion batch covering all five cards; a dedicated ongoing-clone
isolation test (two Warsong Envoys each Frenzy independently; same card fires
identically in a fresh game). Full battery green (67/67 -> now 69 suites) +
fuzz clean incl. the previously-failing pinned seed; headless-verified all five
render with art & are collectible.

entries.title: Fix: mouse-hover card tooltips in overlays on touch-primary devices
entries.body:
The overlay mini-face tooltip (packs, the Duels loot buckets & 10-card draft,
treasures, etc.) is wired by attachTip, which chose hover vs long-press from
the global `TOUCH = matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches`. On a hybrid /
touchscreen laptop that flag is true, so the mouse-hover branch was never
attached and hovering a bucket card showed nothing.

attachTip now attaches both handler sets and gates them on the event's
pointerType instead of the global flag: a mouse/pen hover always pops the
rules tooltip, while touch keeps the long-press (350ms) reveal — so it works
on every device, not just pointer:fine ones.

Verified headless on the Duels draft (same miniFace path as the loot buckets):
a mouse pointerenter shows the tooltip with the card's name; a touch
pointerenter does not (long-press only). Full battery still green (65/65).

entries.title: AI: use {T} artifact abilities (taps Detective's Satchel in runs)
entries.body:
Adds an artifact-tap step to the enemy AI's action loop, right after it cashes
in field tokens: for each of its artifacts with a tapAbility, if canTapArtifact
passes (its per-turn condition is met and it's untapped), the AI taps it,
picking a random legal target when the ability needs one. Since the AI already
sacrifices Clues when its hand is short, it now naturally sacrifices a Clue and
then taps Detective's Satchel for a 1/1 Mech with Taunt.

canTapArtifact gates on the condition, so the AI never wastes a tap; tapping
sets tapped=true, so it fires at most once per turn and can't loop.

Test (5): the AI plays the satchel, sacrifices a Clue, and taps it to create a
1/1 Mech with Taunt, leaving the satchel tapped. Full battery green (65/65) +
fuzz clean (the fuzz harness drives the AI).

entries.title: Engine+UI: real "tap this artifact" ({T}) interaction; Detective's Satchel uses it
entries.body:
Adds a first-class activated tap ability for permanent artifacts, then makes
Detective's Satchel use it instead of the earlier auto-trigger adaptation.

Engine (core.js):
- instantiate carries `def.tapAbility = { effects, text, condition? }`.
- canTapArtifact / tapArtifact / tapArtifactSpec: tap a {T} artifact on your
  turn (once — it taps), optionally gated by a per-turn condition; targeted
  abilities derive a spec like land taps do.
- sacrificeToken records `p.sacrificedThisTurn[id]++`, powering the
  condition `{ sacrificedThisTurn: 'clue_token' }` ("sacrificed a Clue this turn").
- turn start untaps {T} artifacts and resets the per-turn sacrifice tracker.
  (Serialization already carries player/card fields by reference, so tapped /
  tapAbility / sacrificedThisTurn persist for free.)

UI (game.js):
- click a {T} artifact to tap it (no-target resolves immediately; a targeted
  one opens a 'tapart' pending pick).
- tappable {T} artifacts glow green like other usable permanents; a tapped one
  turns sideways like a tapped land.

Card: Detective's Satchel drops the `ongoing` adaptation for a real `tapAbility`
(condition: sacrificed a Clue this turn -> summon a 1/1 Mech with Taunt) and its
text is back to the faithful "{T}: If you've sacrificed a Clue this turn...".

Test (12): can't tap before a Clue is sacrificed; after sacrificing, tap makes a
1/1 Mech with Taunt; it's then tapped (a second Clue sac makes no extra Mech);
it untaps next turn and the tracker resets. Full battery green (64/64) + fuzz
clean; verified the tap lifecycle in-browser and the render loop (highlight +
tapped rotation) over live tappable/tapped artifacts with zero page errors.

entries.title: Add card: Detective's Satchel (paper, Artifact, 4)
entries.body:
Battlecry: Investigate twice. {T}: If you've sacrificed a Clue this turn,
create a 1/1 Mech with Taunt.

Pure data — reuses existing mechanics:
- Top half: an artifact's `effects` run on play (the engine's "permanent
  battlecry"), so two `investigate` effects make two Clue tokens.
- Bottom half: the `{T}` tap is adapted to an automatic `ongoing` trigger on
  `token-sacrificed` (the engine/UI has no way to tap an artifact), gated with
  `if: { cardId: clue_token }`, summoning a 1/1 Mech with Taunt. fireOngoing
  scans p.artifacts and is fired per-player by sacrificeToken, so it only
  triggers for the satchel's controller. It fires on each Clue you sacrifice.

Test (10): Investigate twice -> 2 Clues; sacrificing a Clue -> a 1/1 Mech
with Taunt; a second Clue -> a second Mech; an opponent's Clue sac makes no
Mech for the owner (controller-scoped). Art cropped from the Card Creator
scan. Full battery green (64/64) + fuzz clean; headless-verified the face
renders with art and the card is collectible.

entries.title: Add card: Holy Avenger (paper, Artifact — Equipment, 3)
entries.body:
Equipped creature has +3/+3 & Taunt. Equip (1). Pure data — reuses the
engine's existing MTG equipment system: the artifact enters the p.artifacts
zone on play, equip() attaches it to a creature (attachedTo), and auras grant
equip.attack/health/keywords while attached.

The requested behaviour — when the equipped creature dies the equipment
returns to the artifacts section so it can be re-equipped — is already how
the engine works (death.js clears attachedTo, leaving the equipment in play).
The test proves the full lifecycle: play -> equip (+3/+3 & Taunt) -> holder
dies (detaches, stays in artifacts) -> re-equip onto a fresh creature.

Art cropped from the Card Creator scan -> art/holy_avenger.jpg + index.
Full battery green (63/63) + fuzz clean; headless-verified the face renders
with art and the card is collectible.

entries.title: Add card: Windswept Heresy (paper, Fel sorcery, 4)
entries.body:

handler (two options = a 50/50 coin flip); the branches hit both boards.

registry bump):
- grant: new `all-creatures` target (both boards), reusing the existing

- buff: the existing `all-creatures` branch gains an optional include-`tribe`
  filter (previously only `exceptTribe`) for the Demon/Spirit +2/+2. No card
  set all-creatures+tribe before, so existing behavior is unchanged.

Test covers both coin branches (all-boards Windfury; Demon/Spirit +2/+2 &

art and the card is collectible.

entries.title: Duels: low-hanging polish — enemy hero-power parity, flavor, no repeats, cleanup
entries.body:
Four small fixes to the Duels run:

1. Enemy hero-power parity. You pick an alternate Duels hero power, but the
   generated enemy only ever used its vanilla class default — a gap against
   the "exact parity" goal. genDuelsEnemy now rolls the enemy a power too
   (class default = null, or a random alt from its class Duels pool),
   applied to player 1 at boot alongside its deck/passives/treasures.

2. Anomaly flavor. During a Duels run the anomaly prompt said "The magic of
   Dalaran is unstable" (shared with the Heist). pickAnomalyOverlay now
   takes an optional flavor; Duels passes "The rules of the Duel bend…".

3. No back-to-back rival. genDuelsEnemy takes an avoidId and the enemy now
   carries its rival `id`; advanceDuels passes the current enemy's id so you
   never face the same opponent twice in a row.

4. Dead code. Removed the unused BOSSES / ROUNDS / buildBossDeck boss-ladder
   (leftover from the pre-rework model; unreferenced by game & wiki) and its
   test block + now-unused getEffectHandler import.

Tests: boot test mirrors the enemy-power roll and asserts the parity path is
exercised & every rolled power is equipped/fired legally (121); run test
drops the boss-ladder block (177). Full battery green (61/61) + fuzz clean;
headless-verified the new anomaly text and the enemy receiving a hero power.

entries.title: Duels: implement Drek'Thar & Vanndar as choose-your-class heroes
entries.body:

data ships them as a NEUTRAL base plus 5 per-class variants (PVPDR_Hero_
DrekTharvN / VanndarvN). The mechanic isn't dual-class — you pick ONE of
the general's classes at the start, then play as a normal single-class
hero of that class (its powers, draft pool & signature buckets), wearing
the general's portrait.

  Drek'Thar (Horde)     Druid / Mage / Shaman / Warlock / Warrior
  Vanndar   (Alliance)  Demon Hunter / Hunter / Paladin / Priest / Rogue
  Together: all 10 non-DK classes.

classesOf still yields a single default and drafting never unions all
five) + `classChoicesOf(hero)` helper. game.js: a new CHOOSE YOUR CLASS
step (pickDuelsClassOverlay) fires after the hero pick when the hero has
classChoices; the chosen class is stored on run.classChoice and resolved
everywhere via duelsEffectiveHero(run) — so the power picker, 10-card
draft, loot buckets, and in-game class identity all use the chosen class.
Resume overlay shows the chosen class. Fetched both general portraits.

Wiki: overview cards read "choose 1 of 5 classes"; the hero page shows a
choose-your-class body listing the five class chips. app.js ?v bump.

Tests: classChoicesOf + both rosters + all-10-class span + single-class
(no-union) draft/powers/buckets per choice (run test 184); boot test
plays choose-class runs as the chosen class (119). Full battery green
(61/61) + fuzz clean; headless-verified game (Drek'Thar→class picker→Mage
powers) and wiki.

entries.title: Duels: real per-class signature buckets + playable dual-class heroes (Diablo)

entries.title: Duels rework part 2: arena draft + generated enemies + win/loss run (game.js)
entries.body:

  via Duels.generateEnemy) instead of fixed boss decks; both sides equal HP,

  after every game, plus a passive at games 1/5/9 and a treasure at 3/7/11
- run ends at 12 wins or 3 losses (duelsRunComplete / duelsRunOver)

(BOSSES/ROUNDS kept only for the wiki). Boot test rewritten for the new model;

entries.title: Fix wrong cards in Dungeon/Heist/Tombs decks & buckets
entries.body:
Audit of every enemy decklist + player bucket across the three run modes
found no unresolved/undraftable cards, but 5 Hearthstone ids had been
overwritten by the MTG (WUBRG) import, so decks/buckets were serving the
wrong cards, plus one boss power was a silent no-op:

- Elder Brandlemar's "Dampen Magic" installed `counterspell` as a Secret,
  but that id is now an MTG instant with no secret behavior -> installed
  nothing. Now installs `castblock` (a real counter Secret).
- azure_drake (now a vanilla MTG 2/4) -> bone_drake / hungry_dragon in the
  8 dragon decks/buckets that drafted it.
- counterspell (bucket) -> mana_bind; naturalize -> wrath; lightning_bolt
  -> stormcrack/frost_shock; air_elemental -> earth_elemental (shaman
  starter + shaman buckets).
- bear_trap (retagged to bounty_hunter) leaked into 2 hunter buckets ->
  snake_trap / pack_tactics.
- wild_growth carried the orphan class "naturalist" (not a real class) ->
  druid. mirror_image was a sorcery mislabeled token:true (nothing summons
  it) -> token:false so it drafts cleanly.

Colored cards, tokens, and heropower-type cards were all verified castable
in these colorless modes, so nothing here was a crash/dead-card — just the
wrong or no-op card. New mode_decks_buckets_test.mjs (272 asserts) locks

entries.title: Engine: fix instantiate-undefined crash on defless deck ids (Chronogor, draw-lowest)
entries.body:
Some effects mint a dynamic token_* id (become-copy / transform) that has no
cardsById entry, and a shuffle/bounce can drop that phantom id into a deck.
Deck-reading effects that pick by cost then instantiate the picked id crashed
on it — a defless id sorts as cost 0, so it's exactly what the "lowest cost"
picks land on: instantiate(undefined) -> "Cannot read properties of undefined
(reading 'id')". Found by the fuzz.

The draw pipeline already evaporates defless ids; these direct-splice sites
didn't. Guarded the two vulnerable cost-pick sites so a defless pick is
skipped (the phantom just evaporates, matching draw):
- chronogor (handlers-misc.js): both the "you draw highest" and "enemy draws
  lowest" instantiate calls
- draw-lowest / draw-highest (handlers-deck.js)
The other deck-read-instantiate sites already filter by a def property
