entries.title: Engine: fix Brilliant Macaw (repeat-last-battlecry) stack overflow
entries.body:
repeat-last-battlecry replays your last Battlecry's effects. Play two
Brilliant Macaws back to back and the second one's "last Battlecry" is the
first Macaw's repeat — replaying it re-invokes repeat-last-battlecry, which
replays it again, recursing without bound (Maximum call stack size
exceeded, found by the fuzz).

Fix: a re-entry lock (state._macawLock, mirroring the engine's existing
_chaosLock / _opLock) — while a repeat is replaying, a nested
repeat-last-battlecry is skipped. A Macaw repeating a real Battlecry still
works (one level); a Macaw repeating another Macaw's repeat now no-ops
instead of overflowing.

tests/regression/macaw_recursion_test.mjs (4 assertions: the normal single
repeat, two-Macaw non-overflow, board placement, lock reset). The failing
fuzz seed (legacy 313233) now passes; a broad sweep dropped from the two
overflows to none.

entries.title: Engine: fix runaway summon recursion (stack overflow) with depth + board guards
entries.body:
The fuzz's "Maximum call stack size exceeded" in summon() was a genuine
unbounded recursion: summon() fires fireOngoing('summoned'), and Spiritsinger
Umbra's 'summoned' trigger runs the summoned creature's deathrattle — so a
creature whose deathrattle summons (a self-summoning token, a self-copying
Pirate like Shoplifter Goldbeard) recurses summon → deathrattle → summon …
without bound.

Two guards, both needed:
- MAX_SUMMON_DEPTH (40): a per-nesting-level counter (state.summonDepth);
  past it the creature still enters play but its on-summon triggers are
  skipped, so infinite NESTING terminates.
- MAX_BOARD (40): a hard live-creature ceiling; summon() no-ops when the row
  is saturated. Without this the depth guard alone would let a branching
  deathrattle (summon 2 copies) fan out exponentially into an out-of-memory
  blowup. Callers that loop on summon() already break on null. 40 is ~5x any
  real board (HS caps at 7).

and the specific failing fuzz seed (split 909090) now passes, as does a
broad split-fuzz sweep. New tests/regression/summon_recursion_test.mjs (6
assertions) deterministically reproduces both the self-summon and branching
chains via Umbra and confirms they terminate.

NOTE: a SEPARATE pre-existing runaway remains on legacy-mode fuzz seed 51015
(JavaScript heap OOM, not a stack overflow, not board-driven — confirmed

entries.title: playtest fixes — Lone Ranger battlecry, hero-power readability, "You's Turn"
entries.body:
Three reports from a phone playtest of dungeon runs:

- The Lone Ranger had rules text but NO effects — the choose-one battlecry
  silently did nothing. Wired both branches with existing machinery:
  destroy target creature (maxCost 4) / copy-to-hand (maxCost 2).
  New suite: tests/regression/lone_ranger_test.mjs (6 assertions, incl.
  cost-gate on legal targets).

- The class hero-power orb was unreadable: hover showed no tooltip (the 3D
  panel orb has no card uid, so updateTooltip resolved nothing), and on
  touch a tap either fired it or did nothing. Now hovering the orb shows
  the power's tooltip (HERO POWER · COSTS (N) header), and a tap while the
  power can't be used (off turn / no mana / spent) opens its reader
  instead of no-oping. Press-and-hold preview unchanged.

- The end-turn button read "You's Turn…" when a game ended on your own
  turn (nameOf(HUMAN) = "You" + possessive). It now shows "Game Over"
  once the game ends, with a "Your Turn…" guard on the possessive path.

Verification: 42/42 suites green; effect census clean.

entries.title: Battlecards organization: uncollectible sorting, generated-card listings, full art coverage
entries.body:
1. UNCOLLECTIBLE SORTING (gallery + wiki): 386 non-collectible cards
   (summon/conjure tokens, corrupted forms, boss cards, ...) were falling
   through both systemBucket() copies and masquerading as class cards. Both
   viewer.js and designwiki/app.js now fall back to isUncollectible ->
   the Generic bucket before defaulting to a class. Zero leaks remain.

2. GENERATED-CARD LISTINGS (in game + wiki): new shared extractor in
   cardart.js — generatedCardIds(card, byId) scans a card's definition for
   every id-bearing effect field (summons, conjures, shuffles, equips,
   transforms, Colossal appendages, Corrupt forms, hero-power grants, ...)
   and createdByIds() gives the reverse. 345 cards get listings.
   - Wiki card pages: new "Generates" section (linked chips to each
     created card's page) + "Created by" backlinks on token pages.
   - In-game inspect: new "Creates" block under the keyword lines — tap a
     generated card's name to inspect its full face (preview instances use
     string uids so the pinned-inspect auto-close ignores them).

3. FULL ART COVERAGE: 311 cards had no art (310 missing from the index +
   time_pupil indexed but fileless). All filled:
   - 238 exact Hearthstone name matches -> art.hearthstonejson 256x
   - ~50 fuzzy HS matches (tokens with prefixed ids)
   - the rest via Scryfall art_crop, with hand-picked fitting cards for
     the customs (starships -> spacecraft, Khelos eggs -> three distinct
     MTG eggs, the three Leylines -> three real MTG Leylines, Bear Cub,
     Jar of Eyeballs, ...) and substring-accident fixes (inCUBation
     Druid, saBOTender, Druid of the COWl, JARad all replaced)
   - time_pupil corrected to its TIME-set art (Highborne Pupil TIME_704t)
   - art/index.json resynced to the files on disk (4 orphaned location
     arts like boomtown_claim are now indexed and display)
   Final: 5,664 art entries, 0 of 5,607 cards without art.

style/app tags so deployed clients pick up the new code + art index.

green (no engine changes).

entries.title: Faithful Flags Phase 3 - Dark Gift + Bonus Effects (+ swiftdraw rename)
entries.body:
- Renamed the HS Quickdraw card field to `swiftdraw` (user call) to kill the
  collision with the pre-existing paper-rules 'quickdraw' effect; descriptions
  updated to Swiftdraw.
- New shared DARK_GIFTS pool (10 curated gifts: +3/+3, Rush, Taunt, Divine
  Shield, Lifesteal, Poisonous, Windfury, Stealth, -2 Cost hand-only,
  DR-draw) + exported applyGift() for hand cards and board minions; gifted
  cards carry _darkGift + a visible "[Gift: X]" annotation.
- Discover integration: `darkGift` pend option gifts the picked card;
  `duplicate` adds an identical copy sharing the SAME gift (Shadowflame
  Stalker). New `holdingDarkGift` conditional.
- 7 Dark Gift discovers now real: Darkrider, Creature of Madness, Nightmare
  Lord Xavius, Shadowflame Stalker, Treacherous Tormentor, Brutish Endmaw,
  Raptor Herald. Holders: Frostburn Matriarch (2x 4/4 Taunt Dragon token),
  Dragon Turtle, Overgrown Horror (reduce-hand-darkgift-cost).
- Bonus Effects live on board: Dreambound Raptor (gift every played minion),
  Mutating Lifeform (gift on survive), Stranglevine (gift + chaining DR via
  propagateDeathrattle), Tyrannogill (summon-with-gifts x3), Ace Wayfinder
  (2 gifts + the next Draenei gains the SAME gifts via reward giftLabels),
  Violet Punisher (steal-bonus-keywords: strips keywords, +1/+1 each).

16 cards upgraded. 15/15 + 19/19 regression assertions pass. Flags: 378->344.

entries.title: Faithful Flags Phase 2 - Quickdraw, Temporary, Start-of-Game, in-hand transforms, Health-cost
entries.body:
- HS Quickdraw keyword: new card-level `quickdraw:{effects}` fired with the
  battlecry when drawnThisTurn (already tracked); targetSpec scans quickdraw
  effects so targeted bonuses prompt; new `selfDrawnThisTurn` conditional
  for riders. 9 Badlands cards upgraded: Glowstone Gyreworm (bonus now
  correctly conditional instead of always-on), Farm Hand (-2 discover),
  Azerite Chain Gang (extra copy), Bounty Wrangler, Benevolent Banker
  (enemy-deck discover), Drilly the Kid (QD+DR excavate), Sunspot Dragon,
  Silver Serpent (Immune), Horseshoe Slinger.
- Temporary: `temporary` card flag discarded from hand at end of turn +
  conjure-random `makeTemporary`; Hologram Operator / Frantic Forger /
  Tunnel Terror now vanish properly.
- Start of Game: real hook in createGame scanning decks for `startOfGame`
  effects. Chainbreaker Hogger duplicates deck legendaries (new
  duplicate-deck-legendaries), Ysera Emerald Aspect gives both players
  +5 max mana, Spore Empress Moldara shuffles her 7 Spores at game start.
- In-hand turn transforms: generalized the Chameleos machinery into a
  `handTransform` field (cost-pool + grant/spellDamage, fromEnemyHand,
  intoId + hand-parity). Black Morass/Durnholde/Mount Hyjal Imposters,
  Shapeshifter, and Genn Cursed King (-> 6/5 Worgen King token) all morph.
- Health-cost: conjure-random `altLife` sets altCost {life: cost} - the
  engine's existing alt-payment path; Whispering Stone's Fel spells now
  genuinely cost Health.

Adds the last 9 collectible minions (cost 7-9) with art. New engine:
cleave-enemies-by-attack ctx case on self-attacks-creature (The Great
Dracorex). Reused: summon-random requireKeyword+minCost (Atlasaurus 5+
Taunt), summon-from-deck-keyword x2 (High Cultist Herenn Deathrattle
minions), damage + armor (Windpeak Wyrm), buff-zones skipBoard (Seismopod
hand+deck +3/+3), grant-immune-turn (Whirling Stormdrake Kindred approx).
Flagged base-only: Wilted Shadow attack-on-heal-enemy, Entomologist Jars,
Loh minion cost-set aura, Kindred cost/Immune, "they fight" / attack
riders. THE_LOST_CITY is now 100% of collectible minions (36th set
complete).

entries.title: The Lost City of Un'Goro (THE_LOST_CITY) batch 5 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 5-7 with art. New engine: destroy-strongest `lowest` option
(Scalehide Kodo); destroy-target-gain-stats (Ravenous Devilsaur Kindred);
summon-copies-of-damaged-rush (Nablya, the Watcher); trigger-died-
deathrattles (Endbringer Umbra). Reused: damage-flanks (Diabolus Rex
Kindred), random-damage x3 (Bonechill Stegodon), summon-random tribe/cost
(Ankylodon/Deathrot Maw), Fan of Knives = damage enemy-creatures + draw
across BC/Combo/DR (Opu the Unseen), buff friendly-others (City Chief Esho
all-same-type approx), conjure-random Fel spells (Whispering Stone),
discover Legendary Beast (Beast Speaker Taka), Cinder/2-1-Murloc tokens.
Flagged base-only: Kindred, Stormbrewer pre-strike, Ankylodon attack-random,
Tyrannogill/Whispering Bonus/Health-cost, Beast Speaker stats+DR-summon,
Pterrorwing Kindred cost. THE_LOST_CITY now 102/111.

entries.title: The Lost City of Un'Goro (THE_LOST_CITY) batch 4 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 4-5 with art. New engine: summon-copy-of-killed toHand option
(Primal Sabretooth); summon-from-deck-tribe grant keyword (Possessed
Animancer Lifesteal); mill-own-top (Willful Watcher). Reused: ongoing
spell-played Fire-gated buff-self-by-spell-cost (Mechanized Magma),
if-summoned-tribe-then Elemental -> random-damage (Windswept Pageturner),
self-kills-creature ctx (Primal Sabretooth), damage-random-enemy-by-attack
(Ravasaur Matriarch Kindred approx), discard-random (Razidir), conjure-
random weapon other-class (Neferset Weaponsmith), grant-self reborn on
friendly-death (Hollow Direhorn Corpse approx), summon-copy-of-self
(Crater Experiment Kindred), add-card token on self-damaged (Gorishi Wasp),
hero-attack 5 (Silithid Queen Kindred), Blob/Murloc/Stinger/Gift tokens.
Flagged base-only: Kindred, Ido while-alive, Neferset Combo-buff, Razidir
opponent-discard, Torga Kindred-draw, Corpse cost. THE_LOST_CITY now 86/111.

entries.title: The Lost City of Un'Goro (THE_LOST_CITY) batch 3 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 3-4 with art. New engine: double-triggering-minion-stats +
recast-triggering-spell via two ongoings gated on spellCost:1 (Niri of
the Crater); reduce-discovered-cost ctx case on card-discovered (Vault
Breaker). Reused: dormantSelf turn-start buff-self (Petrified Ogre),
Choose grant keyword (Ancient Pterrordax), tutor requireKeyword+maxCost
(Dread Raptor), tutor school Fire (Volcanic Thrasher), conjure-random
cost 2 x2 (Tunnel Terror Temporary approx), random-damage x2 + freeze
(Chillspine Stegodon Kindred approx), reduce-random-hand-cost anyCard x2
(Skittish Saucier adjacency approx), damage enemy-creature 6 (Bugsquasher),
summon Egg token (Egg of Khelos). Flagged base-only: Kindred, Primalfin
next-Kindred-twice, Stranglevine Bonus Effects, Relic Miner rarity-match,
Crater Gator heal-lock, Elise Locations/deck-check, Egg hatch chain.
THE_LOST_CITY now 70/111.

entries.title: The Lost City of Un'Goro (THE_LOST_CITY) batch 2 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 2-3 with art. New engine: set-attacker-health-from-source ctx case
(Archaios); buff-friendly-others-filtered maxAttack+grant (Hatchery Helper);
cast-spell-from-deck maxCost (Violet Treasuregill); buff-self-attack-random-
enemy health option (Barricade Basher, on armor-gained); copy-random-hand-
card tribe filter (Cloud Serpent Elemental|Dragon); buff-random-friendly
requireDamaged in BOTH the runSecretEffects case and execEffects branch
(Stonecarver). Reused: Choose grant/buff (Ancient Stegodon), self-attacks
ongoing damage enemy-hero (Gorishi Tunneler), turn-end buff-self (Grazing
Stegodon), damage-then ifDies armor (Latorvian Armorer), set-tribe-discount
+ nextTribePlayReward DS (Hot Spring Glider Kindred approx), summon-copy-of-
self + tutor spell DR (Conjured Bookkeeper Kindred approx). Flagged base-
only: Kindred condition, Tortollan "different type", Bralma Elemental-damage
aura, Costume Merchant Masks, Dissolving Ooze Bones. THE_LOST_CITY now
54/111.

entries.title: start The Lost City of Un'Goro (THE_LOST_CITY) batch 1 (16 minions)
entries.body:
First 16 collectible minions (cost 1-2) with art (TLC_/DINO_ prefixes).
New engine: discover costFromMana (Scrappy Scavenger); tutor attack
filter (Holy Eggbearer 0-Attack); reduce-random-enemy-hand-cost (Curious
Explorer); gain-mana-to-match (Crystal Tender). Reused: conjure-random
cost/school/rarity (Raptor-Nest Nurse/Glade Ecologist/Merchant of Legend),
Choose w/ grant-deathrattle summon Plants (Ancient Raptor), ongoing
turn-end reduce-random-hand-cost tribe Beast (Dinositter), grant rush
friendly-others (Firegill Kindred approx), summon token + buff DR
(Longneck Egg), add-card Rock token (Rockskipper). Flagged base-only:
Kindred condition, Quests (Questing Assistant), Temporary (Spelunker),
Tradeable (Crystal Tender), enemy-deck peek (Eyes in the Sky), Platysaur
DR discard, Merchant shuffle-others. THE_LOST_CITY now 38/111.

entries.title: complete Into the Emerald Dream (EMERALD_DREAM) (final 20 -> 118/118)
entries.body:
Adds the last 20 collectible minions (cost 7-10) with art. New engine:
buff-self-by-dead-attack ctx case (Scavenging Flytrap); set-next-spell-double
count (Tyrande 3 spells) + consume/reset wiring; summon-random countPer
self-deaths via diedCountById (Ysondre); eat-own-deck-minion (Hungering
Ancient); fill-hand-enemy-deck costMod (Ashamane). Reused: self-attacks-
survives ongoing + random-damage countByAttack (Magma Hound), put-card-
bottom-deck token (Meadowstrider), cast-highest-hand-spell (Ursol),
attack-all-minions + summon-all-died-this-turn (Ursoc), choices buff/summon
(Volcoross/Forest Lord Cenarius/Ancient token), gain-empty-mana-crystal
(Ysera), self-damaged armor+buff (Tortolla), damage enemies DR (Omen),
random-damage split (Fyrakk). Flagged base-only: Aessina 20-death, Aviana
lunar cycle, Goldrinn double-damage aura, Agamaggan Health-cost, Malorne
Wild-God/Imbue-4, plus Start-of-Game / Corpse / aura riders. EMERALD_DREAM
is now 100% of collectible minions (35th set complete).

entries.title: Into the Emerald Dream (EMERALD_DREAM) batch 5 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 5-7 with art. New engine: summon-random-died-game maxCost/minCost +
count (Ravenous Felhunter <=4 x2, Ferocious Felbat 5+ x2 = resurrect+copy);
resurrect-died-distinct-mincost (Merithra 8+); copy-lowest-hand-tribe
(Tending Dragonkin Beast); reduce-hand-if-distinct-costs (Zaqali
Flamemancer). Reused: summon options = Animal Companion (Broll Bearmantle),
ongoing spell-played Nature -> summon Treant (Grove Shaper), ongoing
every:3 spells -> upgrade-hero-power (Hamuul, Imbue/Start-of-Game approx),
buff-hand all (Keeper of Flame), tutor tribe Dragon costMod (Tormented
Dreadwing), selfCost per hero-powers-game (Glowroot Lure), summon Leech/
Beetle tokens (Hideous Husk / Nythendra split). Flagged base-only: Dark
Gift (Frostburn Matriarch), Grove Shaper Treant spell-copy DR, Keeper
3-turn destroy, Verdant cost-check attack, Wisprider HP trigger, Nythendra
reform, Leech steal boost. EMERALD_DREAM now 98/118.

entries.title: Into the Emerald Dream (EMERALD_DREAM) batch 4 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 4-5 with art. New engine: requireHeroPowerUpgraded damage guard
(Resplendent Dreamweaver, Imbued-twice proxy); buff-next-drawn-minions
counted draw-buff (Beanstalk Brute approx "top 3 minions in deck").
Reused: conjure-random Fire-gated Elemental costMod (Inferno Herald),
Choose One buff+grant (Lightmender), turn-end armor (Merry Moonkin),
conditional selfAttack summon-copy (Mythical Runebear), discover
fromOwnDeck (Nightmare Lord Xavius), discover school Fel +
reduce-hand-school-cost (Scorchreaver), conditional enemyTurn DR AoE
(Tindral Sageswift), discover rarity legendary (Treacherous Tormentor),
dormantSelf turn-end armor+draw (Ancient of Yore), Imbue -> upgrade-hero-
power DR (Umbraclaw). Flagged base-only: Dark Gift (Xavius/Overgrown/
Shadowflame/Treacherous/Tormentor discover base only), hand-match
(Shadowcloaked Assailant), hand transform (Alara'shi), Wisp scaling
(Merry Moonkin). EMERALD_DREAM now 82/118.

entries.title: Into the Emerald Dream (EMERALD_DREAM) batch 3 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 3-4 with art. New engine: damage requireHoldingSpellMinCost guard +
damage target friendly-others (Weaver of the Cycle / Afflicted Devastator);
reduce-rightmost-hand-cost (Nightmare Dragonkin); heroPowerUpgraded
conditional (Petal Picker Imbue proxy); selfCost per cards-played
(Everburning Phoenix). Reused: lock-enemy-hand-card (Renferal),
copy-random-enemy-hand (Tricky Satyr), reduce-random-hand-minion-cost
(Living Garden), summon token BC+DR (Dreadsoul Corrupter), drawTrigger
"Summoned When Drawn" token (Illusory Greenwing), Imbue -> upgrade-hero-
power (Living Garden/Flutterwing Guardian). Flagged base-only: Dark Gift
(Dragon Turtle), hero Divine Shield (Curious Cumulus), deck transform
(Envoy of the Glade), Q'onzu opponent-deck option, Renferal improve-per-
play, Tricky Satyr lowest-card, Dreamwarden non-starting-card condition,
Dreadseed Dormant. EMERALD_DREAM now 66/118.

entries.title: Into the Emerald Dream (EMERALD_DREAM) batch 2 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 2-3 with art. New engine: buff-self-by-spell-cost attackOnly option
(Animated Moonwell); damage-triggering-minion ctx case (Corpse Flower, on
enemy-creature-played); playedBefore ongoing cond via playedCountById
(Twisted Webweaver); gain-empty-mana-crystal eachPlayer (Tranquil Treant);
debuff-random-hand-each (Twisted Treant). Reused: hero-power-discount 10 =
next HP free (Dreambound Disciple BC+DR), own-hero-damaged ongoing ->
random-damage enemy minion (Emberroot Destroyer), debuff-enemies-attack-turn
(Kaldorei Priestess), buff-random-friendly tribe Dragon (Petal Peddler),
heroPowerUsed cond buff self (Spirit of the Kaldorei), tutor minCost spell
(Fae Trickster), summon-copy-of-self (Bloodthistle Illusionist), Imbue ->
upgrade-hero-power (Spirit Gatherer/Goldpetal Drake/Kaldorei Priestess).
Flagged: Imbue per-class powers, Corpse cost (Corpse Flower), illusion
death, Emberscarred next-turn mana, Harbinger return-to-hand trigger.
EMERALD_DREAM now 50/118.

entries.title: start Into the Emerald Dream (EMERALD_DREAM) batch 1 (16 minions)
entries.body:
First 16 collectible minions (cost 1-2) with art (EDR_/FIR_ prefixes).
New engine: gain-deathrattles-died-this-turn (Archdruid of Thorns).
Imbue approximated as Justicar-style upgrade-hero-power (Bitterbloom
Knight, Exotic Houndmaster, Lunarwing Messenger) - flagged. Reused:
heroPowerUsed cond (Charred Chameleon), holdingSpellMinCost cond
(Ashleaf Pixie), holdingTribe Dragon cond + discover (Darkrider),
hero-power-used ongoing buff-self (Barkshield Sentinel), turn-end heal
all-heroes (Critter Caretaker) / buff friendly-others (Monstrous
Mosquito), tutor minCost 7 (Rotheart Dryad), Spellburst-style Fel-gated
destroy-self + AoE (Felfire Blaze), buff-random-friendly grant rush
(Charred Chameleon). Flagged base-only: Dark Gift (Darkrider/Creature
of Madness discover base only), Bonus Effects (Dreambound Raptor),
Plucky Podling transform-intercept, Slumbering Sprite Dormant/HP-wake,
full Imbue per-class powers. EMERALD_DREAM now 34/118.

entries.title: complete The Great Dark Beyond (SPACE) (final 13 -> 122/122)
entries.body:
Adds the last 13 collectible minions (cost 7-100) with art. New engine:
The Ceaseless Expanse dynamic cost (state.expanseEvents counter bumped on
every draw/play/death + effectiveCost hook) with BC destroy-all-others;
double-self-stats (Immortal); mill-except-highest N per deck (The 8 Hands
From Beyond); conjure-random school filter (Galactic Crusader Holy);
summon-random-died-game requireKeyword (Wakener of Souls -> Deathrattle
minion). Reused: summon-random tribe Murloc x4 (Grunty), damage x2 to
enemies (Colossus), damage 5 (Thor), conjure-random Mech x2 BC+DR
(Mothership -> Protoss approx). Flagged base-only: Kil'jaeden (endless
portal), The Exodar (Starships), Velen (Draenei replay log), Murmur
(Battlecry-cost aura), plus Archon-merge / Protoss / Starship-transform
riders. SPACE is now 100% of collectible minions (34th set complete).

entries.title: The Great Dark Beyond (SPACE) batch 5 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 5-7 tier with art. New engine: set-hand-spell-cost random +
fromSourceCost option (Lunar Trailblazer). Reused: random-damage pool
enemy-creatures (Siege Tank 10 dmg), damage target:enemies (High Templar,
Xor'toth approx), destroy enemy-creature + Stealth (Dark Templar), two
ongoings turn-end ping + Spellburst summon-copy-of-self (Arkwing Pilot),
summon-died-tribe Demon (Archimonde approx), shuffle Spore tokens (Spore
Empress Moldara), discover fromOwnDeck spell costMod -5 (Cosmonaut).
Flagged base-only: Farseer Nobundo (Galaxy's Lens), Mutating Lifeform
(Bonus Effects), Star Vulpera / Gravitational Displacer (Starships +
Tradeable), Exarch Maladaar (Corpse cost), Lumia (Immune-on-damage),
Saruun (deck Elemental buff), plus Stars-collision / Archon-merge /
Start-of-Game / launch riders. SPACE now 109/122.

entries.title: The Great Dark Beyond (SPACE) batch 4 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Yrel (deferred) + cost-4 tier + two cost-5, with art. Extended the Draenei
"next X you play" reward system with three new payoffs: summonCopy (Askara,
count 2), refreshManaByAttack (Ingenious Artificer), heroAttackByOwnAttack
(Unyielding Vindicator). New engine: conjure-random nameIncludes filter
(Yrel Librams -> Paladin spells approx); refresh-friendly-attacks (Exarch
Akama). Reused: reduce-libram-cost BC+DR (Interstellar Wayfarer),
destroy-random enemy (Yamato Cannon), armor DR (Arkonite), Spellburst
shuffle Asteroids (Bolide Behemoth), copy-random-enemy-deck-card
(Doommaiden), ongoing friendly-attacks random-damage (Lurker), shuffle
Crewmate tokens + DR summon (Dirdra), discover costMod (Exarch Hataaru).
Flagged base-only: Ace Wayfinder (Bonus Effects), Mystified To'cha (42-HP
niche), Uluu (in-hand growth), plus Starship/Asteroid-boost/Doommaiden
put-back/Hataaru-repeat riders. SPACE now 93/122.

entries.title: The Great Dark Beyond (SPACE) batch 3 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost-3 cluster with art. New engine: recast-triggering-spell reading
Spellburst ctx.played (Starlight Reactor, Arcane-gated, no re-trigger loop);
steal-health random option (K'ara); random-damage excludeSourceTribe
(Hydralisk "each other Zerg"); damage-random-enemy-by-attack count +
minionsOnly (Felfire Thrusters). Reused: Draenei reward immediateAttack
(Expedition Sergeant), emblem tribe-aura (Infestor Zerg +1 atk),
attack-played-minion on enemy-creature-played (Specimen Claw),
summon-random costFromSelfAttack (Soulbound Spire) + cost:3 (K'ure),
damage-then ifDies discover tribe (Relentless Wrathguard), buff-random-hand
(Nexus-Prince Shaffar), combo add-card backstab (Talgath), damage +
shuffle Asteroids (Ultraviolet Breaker), dormant:5 (Gorm). Flagged
base-only/approx: Starships (Exarch Othaar / Gorm acceleration / Soulbound
Spire / Specimen Claw / Starlight Reactor launch), Spellburst-refresh
(K'ara Shadow / K'ure Holy), Shaffar propagation, Talgath double-damage
static, Void Ray cost-0 buff. SPACE now 77/122.

entries.title: The Great Dark Beyond (SPACE) batch 2 (16 minions)
entries.body:
Cost 2-3 collectible minions with art. New engine: trigger-one-deathrattle
random option (Guiding Figure Spellburst); buff-self-per-other-friendly
(Ultra-Capacitor); conjure-minion-of-spell-cost reading Spellburst ctx.played
(Deep Space Curator); shuffle-random-spells-into-deck school/costMod
(Blasteroid, via deckCostOverrides). Reused Draenei reward system
(Stranded Spaceman +2hp+Rush), set-tribe-discount (Planetary Navigator),
conjure-random tribe/count (Hologram Operator), damage target:enemies
(Missile Pod), copyOnDraw + conditional controlOtherTribe Zerg (Roach),
buff-hand-tribe BC+DR (Crimson Commander), static spell-damage + Spellburst
tutor spells (Ethereal Oracle), drawTrigger Asteroid token (Moonstone Mauler),
Spellburst ongoing (spell-played once). Flagged base-only/approx: Anchorite
(overheal-reactive aura), Blazing Accretion (deck-dig -> tutor Elemental),
Scrounging Shipwright/Exarch Naielle (-> Discover), Starships/Temporary/
Overload riders. SPACE now 61/122.

entries.title: start The Great Dark Beyond (SPACE) — batch 1 (16 minions)
entries.body:
First 16 collectible minions of SPACE with art. Built the Draenei
"next X you play" reward system: nextTribePlayReward field + creature-play
hook (stats/keyword/immediate-attack) + lastDraeneiId tracking, driving
Starlight Wanderer (+2/+1 next Draenei) and Astral Vigilant (copy last
Draenei). New engine: minion-reborn ongoing trigger +
summon-copy-of-triggering-minion (Auchenai Death-Speaker); card-discovered
ongoing trigger + add-copy-of-discovered (Rangari Scout); nextWeaponDiscount
+ cost hook (Space Pirate); silence target:self (Overzealous Healer
Spellburst); grant-deathrattle tribe filter (Braingill); copy-last-tribe-
played, set-next-tribe-play-reward, set-next-weapon-discount,
damage-random-enemy-by-attack (Biopod). Reused Spellburst (ongoing
spell-played once), Outcast, Combo, set-combo-discount, shuffle-hand-redraw,
turn-start-once discover (Astrobiologist). Flagged base-only: SCV/Crystal
Welder (Starships not modeled), Foreboding Flame (foreign-Demon discount).
SPACE now 45/122.

entries.title: complete Perils in Paradise (final 11 minions -> 108/108)
entries.body:
Adds the last 11 ISLAND_VACATION collectible minions with art. New
engine primitives: swap-hand-spell-costs (Portalmancer Skyla),
summon-random-from-deck (Travelmaster Dungar), shuffle-into-own-deck
(Incindius), summon-enemy-beast-attack-all (Snoozin' Zookeeper),
summon-random countPer schools-cast-game (Razzle-Dazzler). Reuses
reduce-random-hand-minion-cost (Spirit Peddler), hero-attack on
self-attacks (All Terrain Voidhound), summon-with-source-stats on
turn-end (Muensterosity), conditional controlOtherTribe +
equip-weapon-from-deck (Weapons Attendant). Flagged base-only: Marin
(treasures via Discover), Sasquawk (last-turn replay), plus noted
approximations on Incindius/Travelmaster. Perils in Paradise is now
100% of collectible minions.

entries.title: Perils in Paradise batch 5 (16 collectible minions)
entries.body:
Adds 16 ISLAND_VACATION minions with art. New engine primitives:
buff-friendly-didnt-attack (A. F. Kay), set-deck-top-cost + drawCards
override wiring (Twilight Medium), eat-enemy-deck-minion (Hamm),
maybe-draw on card-drawn (Package Dealer), dormantSelf ongoing cond
(Dozing Dragon). Reuses destroy-friendly-remember+summon-remembered
(Carnivorous Cubicle), gain-coin on self-damaged (Cash Cow),
set-cast-when-drawn (Surfalopod), turn-end token summon + DR buff-hand
(Ranger Gilly). Flagged base-only: Bayfin, Mistah Vistah, Sanc'Azel,
Scrapbooking Student, Sunsapper Lynessa, Cruise Captain Lora, Party
Planner Vona (locations / delayed-replay / niche triggers not modeled).
Perils now 80/108.

entries.title: Perils in Paradise batch 4 (16 collectible minions)
entries.body:
Adds 16 ISLAND_VACATION minions with art. New engine primitives:
draw-lowest/draw-highest (Grillmaster), replay-last-card (Conniving
Conman), copy-deck-top-to-hand (Narain), summon-random-cost-ds (Raylla).
Reuses emblem aura, set-spells-lifesteal, freeze all-others, destroy
maxAttack, buff all-others, choices. Tourist/Sidequest/Drink flagged
base-effect-only. Perils now 64/108.

entries.title: Perils in Paradise batch 3 (16 minions, 65/108)
entries.body:
Added: Job Shadower, Line Cook, Mixologist, Overplanner, Robocaller,
Sacrificial Imp, Sailboat Captain, Sea Shill, Swarthy Swordshiner,
Terrible Chef, Tortollan Traveler, Turbulus, Alloy Advisor, Buttons,
Cabaret Headliner, Carry-On Grub (+ Imp/Egg/Potion/Suitcase tokens).

Engine:
- set-weapon-stats (Swarthy Swordshiner); buff-battlecry-minions (Turbulus
  hand+board); destroy-friendly-by-id (Terrible Chef DR destroys its Egg).
- Reused: heroTookDamage cond (Job Shadower), copyOnDraw field (Line
  Cook), conditional enemyTurn-else summon (Sacrificial Imp), grant
  windfury (Sailboat Captain), set-next-cards-discount (Sea Shill),
  reorder-deck (Overplanner), self-damaged armor (Alloy Advisor), tutor
  requireKeyword taunt costMod (Tortollan Traveler), reduce-random-hand-
  cost (Cabaret Headliner), add-card tokens (Mixologist/Carry-On Grub).

Simplifications: Tourist/Locations not modeled; Robocaller random costs ->
draw 3; Buttons per-school draw -> tutor 2 spells; Cabaret Headliner
each-school -> one hand spell; Overplanner choose-3-top -> reorder;
Mixologist/Carry-On tokens are generic; Gorgonzormu-style upgrades N/A.

entries.title: Perils in Paradise batch 2 (16 minions, 49/108)
entries.body:
Added: Tidepool Pupil, Travel Agent, XB-931 Housekeeper, Bumbling Bellhop,
Carefree Cookie, Carress Cabaret Star, Chatty Macaw, Chillin' Vol'jin,
Clumsy Steward, Concierge, Cryopractor, Customs Enforcer, Dreamplanner
Zephrys, Frostbitten Freebooter, Gorgonzormu, Hozen Roughhouser (+ Cheese
token).

Engine:
- buff-attacker on friendly-attacks+tribe (Hozen Roughhouser buffs the
  attacking Pirate); summon-random-cost-from-dead (Carefree Cookie, +1
  the dead minion's Cost).
- recast-own-last-spell at a random enemy (Chatty Macaw, via lastSpell
  Played); swap-stats-two approx (Chillin' Vol'jin swaps with a random
  other minion).
- Reused: spellsCastWhileHeld discover (Tidepool Pupil), holdingSpellMin
  Cost summon-copy-of-self (Bumbling Bellhop), buff + freeze (Cryopractor),
  freeze random-enemy x3 (Frostbitten Freebooter), foreignCostReduce
  (Concierge), conjure-random (Dreamplanner Zephrys), add-card Cheese
  (Gorgonzormu).

Simplifications: Tourist / Locations / Temporary / Travel Tour not
modeled; Travel Agent location -> Discover spell; XB-931/Customs Enforcer/
Clumsy Steward/Carress vanilla; Gorgonzormu Cheese doesn't upgrade;
Frostbitten already-Frozen 5-damage rider dropped; Vol'jin swaps 1 chosen
+ 1 random (not 2 chosen).

entries.title: Perils in Paradise batch 1 (16 minions, 33/108)
entries.body:
Set ISLAND_VACATION start (Tourist, Locations, Drinks, Pirates). Added:
Adaptive Amalgam, Brain Masseuse, Party Fiend, Patches the Pilot,
Adrenaline Fiend, Brittlebone Buccaneer, Busy Peon, Busy-Bot, Coconut
Cannoneer, Drink Server, Envoy of Prosperity, Fearless Flamejuggler,
Imployee of the Month, Maestra Mask Merchant, Pet Parrot, Service Ace
(+ Felbeast/Pirate/Parachute/Drink tokens).

Engine:
- damage-own-hero-by-amount on self-damaged (Brain Masseuse); grant-
  keyword-played on creature-played+keyword (Brittlebone Buccaneer Reborn).
- put-highest-hand-on-top (Envoy of Prosperity); buff-friendly-attack-
  filter (Busy-Bot 1-Attack); buff-self-by-hero-damage (Fearless
  Flamejuggler, via heroDamageTakenThisTurn); repeat-last-cost-card +
  lastCardOfCost tracking (Pet Parrot).
- Patches Parachutes use the drawTrigger token pattern (summon a Charge
  Pirate on draw).
- Reused: friendly-attacks+tribe hero-temp-attack (Adrenaline Fiend),
  friendly-attacks random-damage (Coconut Cannoneer), grant lifesteal
  (Imployee), summon + damage own-hero (Party Fiend), shuffle-tokens
  (Adaptive Amalgam/Patches), conjure-random other-class (Maestra).

Faceless, Celestial Projectionist, Crystalline Statue, Disciple of
Golganneth, Distressed Kvaldir, False Disciple, Flame Revenant,
Invent-o-matic, Kaja'mite Creation, Noble Minibot (+ Val'kyr / Sparkbot /
Plague tokens).

Engine:
- scaleOnEntry field + apply/increment on both entry paths (summon + play)
  via enteredCountById (Astral Automaton +1/+1 per prior copy this game).
- become-copy-of-random-damaged (Battleworn Faceless full-copies a random
  damaged minion).
- reduce-random-hand-cost gained overload filter (Disciple of Golganneth
  turn-end).
- Reused: set-heal-harm (Shadowtouched Kvaldir), cast-random-spell cost 1
  (Chaotic Tendril), buff-summoned-if-tribe Elemental (Flame Revenant),
  self-attacks add-card / buff-random-hand (Victorious Vrykul / Noble
  Minibot), copy-to-hand friendly (Celestial Projectionist), shuffle-
  cards-into-enemy-deck (Distressed Kvaldir Plagues), discover cardClasses
  +rarity / maxCost (False Disciple / Kaja'mite Creation), Magnetic keyword
  (Noble Minibot), dormant (Crystalline Statue).

Simplifications: Chaotic Tendril progression dropped; Drone Deconstructor
Sparkbot random Bonus Effect omitted; X-21 Repairbot / Invent-o-matic
Magnetize-return/trigger vanilla; Crystalline Statue draw-4-awaken ->
Dormant 2 turns; Plagues are inert deck-clog tokens; Kaja'mite "another
class" any-class.

entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 6 (final 14, 123/123 COMPLETE)
entries.body:
Set RETURN_OF_THE_LICH_KING done. Added: Sister Svalna, Anachronos,
Dar'Khan Drathir, Lor'themar Theron, Underking, Anub'Rekhan, Boneguard
Commander, Invincible, Soulstealer, Brutal Annihilan, Flesh Behemoth,
Grand Magister Rommath, Overlord Drakuru, Thaddius Monstrosity (+ Vision
of Darkness / Risen Footman tokens).

Engine:
- self-kills-creature ctx now carries victim + summon-copy-of-killed
  (Overlord Drakuru resurrects what it kills).
- damage-enemy-hero-by-amount on self-damaged/survives (Brutal Annihilan).
- deckDoubleStats draw hook (Lor'themar); parityDiscount + effectiveCost
  hook + turn-start polarity swap (Thaddius); freeMinionsCount +
  effectiveCost hook w/ same-play guard + turn reset (Anub'Rekhan);
  firstCardFree (reused from Bonelord).
- spend-corpses-summon (Boneguard Commander); destroy-all-others-gain-
  corpses (Soulstealer); draw-tribe-summon-copy (Flesh Behemoth); double-
  deck-minion-stats (Lor'themar); buff-random-friendly gained tribe+grant
  (Invincible +5/+5 Taunt to a random Undead).
- Reused: turn-end damage enemy-hero (Dar'Khan), armor battlecry+DR
  (Underking), add-card token (Sister Svalna).

Simplifications: Anachronos "future" mechanic vanilla; Grand Magister
Rommath spell-recast vanilla; Lor'themar doubles minions as drawn
(persistent); Anub'Rekhan/Blood Crusader Armor/Health cost -> free.

entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 5 (16 minions, 109/123)
entries.body:
Added: Thori'belore, Amorphous Slime, Elder Nadox, Infantry Reanimator,
Infectious Ghoul, Rotgill, Savage Ymirjar, Tenacious San'layn, The
Purator, Translocation Instructor, Blood Crusader, Bonelord Frostwhisper,
Death Beetle, Felscale Evoker, Fleshshaper, Rivendare Warrider (+ 3
Horseman tokens).

Engine:
- discard-random-tribe-remember + summon-remembered (Amorphous Slime
  discard-then-resummon).
- destroy-friendly-tribe-buff-all (Elder Nadox); swap-enemy-with-deck
  (Translocation Instructor); shuffle-tokens-into-deck (Rivendare).
- firstCardFreeEachTurn + effectiveCost hook (Bonelord Frostwhisper);
  nextClassFree + effectiveCost hook w/ same-play guard (Blood Crusader,
  Health-cost approximated as free); armorAtLeast cond (Fleshshaper).
- summon-died-tribe gained `grant` (Infantry Reanimator: rez + Reborn).
- Reused: grant-deathrattle-random (Infectious Ghoul), grant-deathrattle
  friendly-others (Rotgill), self-attacks damage enemy-hero (Tenacious
  San'layn), discard-random (Savage Ymirjar), manathirst (Death Beetle),
  spellsCastWhileHeld + summon-from-deck-tribe (Felscale Evoker),
  summon-copy-of-self (Fleshshaper), deckNoNeutral (The Purator).

Simplifications: Thori'belore Dormant-revive -> deathrattle returns to
hand; Bonelord "die in 3 turns" downside dropped; The Purator "each type"
-> draw 4 distinct minions; Rivendare Four Horsemen win-con not modeled.

entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 4 (16 minions, 93/123)
entries.body:
Added: Unliving Champion, Walking Dead, Whirlweaver, Bonecaller, Daring
Drake, Felerin the Forgotten, Goldwing, High Cultist Basaleph, Lost
Exarch, Noxious Infiltrator, Plaguespreader, Rotting Necromancer, Sanctum
Spellbender, Scourge Illusionist, Shockspitter, Silvermoon Armorer
(+ 3/2 Zombie token).

Engine:
- heroAttacksGame counter + damage valuePer:'hero-attacks-game'
  (Shockspitter: 1 + hero attacks this game).
- spend-mana-summon (Lost Exarch deathrattle); transform-random-enemy-
  hand-minion (Plaguespreader); copy-deck-deathrattle-minion set 4/4 cost
  -4 (Scourge Illusionist); add-random-outcast-card gained count+costMod
  (Felerin).
- Reused: friendlyUndeadDied cond (Unliving Champion / Noxious
  Infiltrator), summonOnDiscard (Walking Dead), castSpellLastTurn
  (Whirlweaver), summon-died-tribe Undead (Bonecaller / High Cultist
  Basaleph), holdingTribe cond (Daring Drake / Goldwing), dredge (Rotting
  Necromancer), manathirst (Silvermoon Armorer).

Simplifications: Rotting Necromancer Dredge kept but its "if Undead deal 5"
rider dropped; Sanctum Spellbender spell-redirect vanilla; High Cultist
Basaleph resurrects up to 5 Undead (deathLog, approximating "after last
turn").

entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 3 (16 minions, 77/123)
entries.body:
Added: Drakkari Embalmer, Energy Shaper, Frostfin Chomper, Halduron
Brightwing, Haunting Nightmare, Hawkstrider Rancher, Keeneye Spotter,
Knight of the Dead, Nerubian Vizier, Rimescale Siren, Scourge Rager,
Silvermoon Arcanist, Silvermoon Sentinel, Stitched Creation, Sunfury
Clergy, Timewarden (+ Murloc / Soldier / Hawkstrider tokens).

Engine:
- hero-attacks-creature ongoing now fires for board minions (was weapon-
  only) w/ ctx.target + set-attacked-health (Keeneye Spotter).
- heal target 'friendly-characters' (hero + all friendly minions, Sunfury
  Clergy).
- deckSchoolSpellDamage draw-time hook + grant-hand-school-spelldamage
  alsoDeck (Halduron: hand AND deck Arcane spells).
- buff-played-grant-deathrattle on creature-played (Hawkstrider Rancher);
  grant-tribe-summon-buff + summon() hook (Timewarden: Dragons gain
  Taunt+DS until next turn); haunt-hand-card + playCard hook (Haunting
  Nightmare summons a Soldier when the haunted card is played).
- Reused: elementalLastTurn (Frostfin), manathirst conditionals (Knight/
  Sentinel/Sunfury/Stitched), spellsCastWhileHeld (Rimescale), reborn +
  destroy-self (Scourge Rager), friendlyUndeadDied discover costMod
  (Nerubian Vizier), grant reborn (Drakkari), spell-damage static
  (Silvermoon Arcanist).

Simplifications: Energy Shaper transform-spells vanilla; Silvermoon
Arcanist "spells can't target heroes" flavor omitted; Stitched Creation
Infuse tier dropped (Combo +2/+2 & Manathirst +4/+4 kept).

entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 2 (16 minions, 61/123)
entries.body:
Added: Mind Eater, Necrotic Mortician, Nerubian Flyer, Potionmaster
Putricide, Prismatic Elemental, Rotten Rodent, Silvermoon Farstrider,
Suspicious Peddler, Vrykul Necrolyte, Wretched Exile, Arcsplitter,
Asvedon the Grandshield, Blightfang, Brittleskin Zombie, Crystal Broker,
Darkfallen Shadow (+ Nerubian / Zombie / Concoction tokens).

Engine:
- per-spell bonusSpellDamage in the damage calc + grant-hand-school-
  spelldamage (Silvermoon Farstrider gives hand Arcane spells Spell Dmg+1).
- lastSpellPlayed tracked per player (any cost) + cast-enemy-last-spell
  (Asvedon).
- deckKeywordDiscount draw-time hook + reduce-deck-keyword-cost (Rotten
  Rodent: Deathrattle cards).
- copy-random-enemy-deck-card (Mind Eater); add-random-outcast-card on
  outcast-played (Wretched Exile); infect-enemies-summon-on-death +
  summon-for-player (Blightfang grants enemies a DR that summons YOU a
  Taunt Zombie).
- Reused: friendlyUndeadDied cond (Necrotic Mortician / Nerubian Flyer),
  grant-deathrattle (Vrykul), enemyTurn cond (Brittleskin), nested
  manathirst conditionals (Crystal Broker), grant-keyword-self reborn
  (Darkfallen Shadow), discover cost/costMod (Suspicious Peddler /
  Prismatic Elemental), add-card Arcane Bolts (Arcsplitter).

Simplifications: Concoctions unmodeled (Putricide adds a generic 2-cost
"deal 3" token; Ghoulish/Peddler guess minigames dropped); Necrotic
Mortician Unholy Rune -> Discover a Death Knight card.

entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 1 (16 minions, 45/123)
entries.body:
Set RETURN_OF_THE_LICH_KING start (Undead + Manathirst themes). Added:
Arcane Wyrm, Arms Dealer, Crystalsmith Cultist, Devourer of Souls, Fierce
Outsider, Scourge Tamer, Sunfury Champion, Trinket Tracker, Wailing
Banshee, Astalor Bloodsworn, Blood Matriarch Liadrin, Bone Flinger,
Coroner, Ghoulish Alchemist, Incorporeal Corporal, Magister's Apprentice
(+ Arcane Bolt / Astalor Protector+Flamewreath tokens).

Engine:
- Manathirst already modeled (conditional if:{manathirst:N} = mana.max>=N).
- buff-summoned-if-tribe extended: maxAttackSelf + grants[] (Liadrin DS+
  Rush on smaller summons); Arms Dealer reuses tribe+attack.
- gain-dead-deathrattle ongoing friendly-creature-died (Devourer of Souls).
- destroy-self self-attacks (Incorporeal Corporal); grant-next-outcast-
  discount + nextOutcastDiscount effectiveCost hook w/ same-play guard
  (Fierce Outsider); friendlyUndeadDied cond (Bone Flinger); buff-random-
  friendly gained tribe filter (Wailing Banshee).
- Reused: holdingSchool cond (Crystalsmith), spell-played+school Fire
  (Sunfury), schoolCostReduce Arcane static (Magister's Apprentice),
  freeze+conditional silence (Coroner), tutor cost 1 (Trinket Tracker),
  add-card (Arcane Wyrm / Astalor chain tokens).

Simplifications: Scourge Tamer Zombeast -> Discover a Beast; Ghoulish
Alchemist Concoction discount vanilla; Bone Flinger "after last turn" ->
any friendly Undead died this game; Astalor 3-stage chain via tokens.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batches 5-6 (20 minions, 109/109 COMPLETE)
entries.body:
Set BATTLE_OF_THE_BANDS done. Batch 5: Inzah, Kangor Dancing King, MC
Blingtron, Magatha Bane of Music, Opera Soloist, Rin Orchestrator of
Doom, Screaming Banshee, Summer Flowerchild, Doomkin, Lead Dancer, Mister
Mukla, Unpopular Has-Been, Zok Fogsnout, The One-Amalgam Band, Tony King
of Piracy, Concert Promo-Drake. Batch 6 (final): DJ Manastorm, Mish-Mash
Mosher, Banjosaur, Fanottem Lord of the Opera.

Engine:
- overloadDiscount + effectiveCost hook (Inzah); selfCost per:'deck-size'
  (Fanottem, base cost 0).
- heroHealed cond + summon-token-by-heal-amount ongoing 'healed'
  (Screaming Banshee).
- summon-hand-minion-lifesteal (Kangor); draw-give-spells-to-enemy
  (Magatha); both-players-draw-discard-mill (Rin); steal-empty-mana-
  crystal (Doomkin); replace-deck-with-enemy-copy (Tony); equip-both-mics
  (MC Blingtron, damage-amp omitted); gain-random-keywords-per-tribe-
  played (Amalgam Band); summon-quilboar-scaled (Zok, hero-Attack scaled);
  discount-hand-mincost (Summer Flowerchild Finale); buff-self-attack-
  random-enemy guarded chain (Mish-Mash); draw-beast-gain-stats
  (Banjosaur).

Reused: summon-from-deck-weaker (Lead Dancer), summon-random cost 5
(Unpopular Has-Been), give-enemy-card bananas (Mister Mukla), set-hand-
spell-cost (DJ Manastorm), conditional noOtherCreatures / Finale destroy
(Opera Soloist / Concert Promo-Drake). Simplifications: DJ Manastorm's
post-cast escalation, MC Blingtron's damage-amp, Zok's armor-this-turn,
Amalgam Band's exact Bonus-Effect pool all approximated.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 4 (16 minions, 89/109)
entries.body:
Added: Freebird, Grimtotem Buzzkill, Halveria Darkraven, Instrument
Smasher, Jitterbug, Keyboard Soloist, Obsessive Fan, Pozzik Audio
Engineer, Rhythmdancer Risa, Speaker Stomper, Yelling Yodeler,
Boneshredder, Drum Soloist, Elite Tauren Champion, Ghost Writer, Guitar
Soloist (+ Amp / Bot tokens).

Engine:
- playedCountById tracked at play resolve -> Freebird buff-self-per-
  played-id.
- FIX: aura-granted Stealth now clears `stealthed` when the aura lapses
  (Obsessive Fan grant-stealth-while-alive via aura.targetUid; same fix
  benefits any aura-stealth source).
- discard-weapon-draw (Grimtotem); bounce-self-set-cost (Rhythmdancer
  Risa hero-attacks ongoing); corpse-gain-deathrattle (Boneshredder);
  trigger-one-deathrattle gained count (Yelling Yodeler x2).
- Reused: friendly-attacks + keyword rush cond -> buff friendlies
  (Halveria); weapon-destroyed -> equip (Instrument Smasher); friendly-
  divine-shield-lost -> draw (Jitterbug); tax-enemy-spells (Speaker
  Stomper); add-card toEnemy + deathrattle summon (Pozzik); spell-damage
  static token (Keyboard Soloist Amps); conditional noOtherCreatures
  (Drum/Guitar Soloist); Finale discover (Ghost Writer).

Simplification: Elite Tauren Champion's ROCK DUEL (spend-all-mana-or-take-8
global) left as vanilla Finale flavor; Boneshredder ties to real Corpse
resource.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 3 (16 minions, 73/109)
entries.body:
Added: Outfit Tailor, Paparazzi, Photographer Fizzle, Plagiarizarrr,
Power Slider, Rhyme Spinner, Rock Master Voone, Rowdy Fan, Tough Crowd,
Worgen Roadie, Ambient Lightspawn, Backstage Bouncer, Candleraiser,
Cover Artist, Crazed Conductor, E.T.C. Band Manager (+ Instrument Case
token).

Engine:
- tribesPlayedGame set + combosPlayedGame counter tracked at play resolve
  -> Power Slider / Rhyme Spinner buff-self-per-tribe/combo-played.
- Rowdy Fan: aura.targetUid filter in recomputeAuras (buff a specific
  minion while source lives; removed automatically on death).
- buff-target-by-source-stats (Outfit Tailor); copy-enemy-deck-top
  (Plagiarizarrr); snapshot-hand-into-deck (Photographer Fizzle);
  copy-hand-minions-distinct-tribe (Rock Master Voone); grant-adjacent-
  keyword (Candleraiser Finale DS); become-copy-of-random-minion 3/3
  (Cover Artist); fatigue-summon (Crazed Conductor).
- Ambient Lightspawn: Finale + Overheal both buff-random-friendly.

Reused: transform-target-into-source (Backstage Bouncer), Outcast bounce
(Tough Crowd), summon forEnemy (Worgen Roadie), discover rarity legendary
(Paparazzi). Simplifications: Photographer Fizzle once-per-game not
enforced; E.T.C. deckbuild band -> plain Discover a minion; Rock Master
Voone one copy per distinct tribe.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 2 (16 minions, 57/109)
entries.body:
Added: Dreamboat, Fanboy, Groovy Cat, Hipster, Jukebox Totem, One Hit
Wonder, Party Animal, Popular Pixie, Rolling Stone, Snakebite, Cowbell
Soloist, Festival Security, Harmonica Soloist, Heartthrob, Holotechnician,
Metrognome.

Engine:
- Overheal already modeled (card `overheal` field runs on heal overflow) ->
  Heartthrob summon-random-cost-overheal (source._lastOverheal); Dreamboat
  heal-friendlies-buff-per-overheal.
- creature-damaged ctx now carries `amount` + damageAmount cond ->
  Holotechnician destroy-damaged-subject on exactly-1 damage.
- lastCardCost tracking (playCard + spell resolve) + conditional cond ->
  Rolling Stone; buff target:'self' case added.
- buff-self-per-died-this-turn (Snakebite); force-all-enemies-attack
  (Festival Security Finale); discover-enemy-class-spell (Hipster);
  metrognome escalating draw (card-played ongoing, per-source metroCost);
  grant-keyword-self poisonous Combo (One Hit Wonder).

Reused: refresh-hero-power / hero-power-discount Choose One (Popular
Pixie), buff+grant Choose One (Fanboy), hero-temp-attack (Groovy Cat),
turn-end summon recruit (Jukebox Totem), conditional noOtherCreatures +
damage / discover installSecret (Cowbell / Harmonica Soloist), buff-hand-
minions (Party Animal). Simplifications: Groovy Cat/Free-Spirit-style
Hero-Power-per-game upgrades approximated as one-time; Party Animal buffs
all hand minions (not one-per-tribe).

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 1 (16 minions, 41/109)
entries.body:
Set BATTLE_OF_THE_BANDS start. Added: Air Guitarist, Annoying Fan,
Costumed Singer, Crowd Surfer, Flowrider, Free Spirit, Peaceful Piper,
Razorfen Rockstar, Saxophone Soloist, Thornmantle Musician, Arrow Smith,
Audio Amplifier, Audio Medic, Audio Splitter, Baritone Imp, Disc Jockey.

Engine:
- Finale already modeled (conditional if:{finale} = availableMana 0 after
  play) -> Audio Medic, Thornmantle.
- lock-minion-attack + cantAttackWhile check in canAttackWith (Annoying
  Fan); damage-lowest-enemy (Arrow Smith spell-played ongoing).
- set-own-max-mana (Audio Amplifier); copy-highest-spell (Audio Splitter);
  fatigue-self-buff (Baritone Imp); add-random-combo-card (Disc Jockey).
- gain-armor-no-trigger + Razorfen Rockstar armor-gained ongoing (avoids
  self-loop); buff-next-summon-tribe + summon() hook (Thornmantle);
  grant-keyword-self (Audio Medic Finale); buff-random-other-grant-
  deathrattle (Crowd Surfer chaining DR).

Reused buff-weapon (Air Guitarist), tutor secret turn-end (Costumed
Singer), conditional overloaded->discover fromOwnDeck (Flowrider),
noOtherCreatures->add-card (Saxophone Soloist), Choose One tutor/discover
Beast (Peaceful Piper). Simplification: Free Spirit gains 1 Armor now
(Hero-Power-armor-per-game unmodeled); Audio Amplifier hand-size cap
approximated by MAX_HAND.

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 5 (final 14 legendaries, 100/100)
entries.body:
Set COMPLETE. Added: Theotar the Mad Duke, Huntsman Altimor, Remornia
Living Blade, Sinfueled Golem, The Countess, Topior the Shrubbagazzor,
Artificer Xy'mox, Kel'Thuzad the Inevitable, Party Crasher, Sesselie of
the Fae Court, Torghast Custodian, Insatiable Devourer, Sire Denathrius,
The Jailer (+ Gargon / Whelp / Invitation / infused tokens).

Engine:
- devour-enemy (Insatiable Devourer) + Infuse neighbors variant.
- destroy-own-deck-gain-immune (The Jailer).
- gain-random-keyword-per-enemy-minion (Torghast Custodian).
- throw-hand-minion (Party Crasher); swap-random-hand-cards (Theotar);
  equip-self-as-weapon self-attacks ongoing (Remornia).
- add-card requireDeckNoNeutral gate (The Countess -> Legendary
  Invitations); discover rarity filter (also fixes Suspicious Usher).
- Topior emblem: spell-played + school Nature -> summon 3/3 Rush Whelp.
- Reused: random-damage pool enemies + lifesteal (Sire Denathrius; Infuse
  deals 6), summon-died-name (Kel'Thuzad Skeletons), tutor costMod -8
  deathrattle (Sesselie), summon Gargon Infuse (Altimor).

Simplifications (flagged): Artificer Xy'mox vanilla (Relics unmodeled),
Sinfueled Golem Infuse -> fixed 8/8 (infuser-stat sum approximated),
Theotar/Party Crasher approximate the Discover/throw picks, Remornia
re-equips each swing, Sire Denathrius Infuse single-step (not endless),
Altimor two-tier Infuse collapsed to one, Kel'Thuzad Skeletons by name.

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 4 (16 minions, 86/100)
entries.body:
Added: Widowbloom Seedsman, Ara'lon, Death Blossom Whomper, Elitist Snob,
Famished Fool, Lady Darkvein, Mawsworn Bailiff, Necrolord Draka,
Shadehound, Soul Seeker, Steamcleaner, Stoneborn Accuser, Decimator
Olgra, Defense Attorney Nathanos, Imp King Rafaam, Sylvanas the Accused
(+ Shade / infused tokens). Also fixes Framester art (MAW_005; had been
fetched as Soul Seeker's MAW_004).

Engine:
- gain-empty-mana-crystal (Widowbloom, via tutor school Nature).
- Death Blossom Whomper reuses tutor requireKeyword+gainDeathrattle.
- gain-random-keyword-per-class-card (Elitist Snob).
- buff-self-if-armor (Mawsworn Bailiff); equip-per-cards-played
  (Necrolord Draka); buff-friendly-tribe self-attacks ongoing
  (Shadehound) + Infuse Rush variant.
- buff-self-per-damaged-then-attack-all (Decimator Olgra).
- summon-died-name (Imp King Rafaam: resurrect Imps) + buff-friendly-name
  Infuse variant; swap-with-enemy-deck-minion (Soul Seeker).
- Sylvanas: destroy -> mind-control Infuse; Stoneborn Accuser / Famished
  Fool Infuse variants (deal 5 / draw 3).

Simplifications (flagged): Steamcleaner vanilla (deck-origin untracked),
Ara'lon summons 3 identical Wildseeds (one Wildseed type modeled), Lady
Darkvein Shades lack the cast-last-Shadow-spell Deathrattle, Defense
Attorney Nathanos gains a died minion's Deathrattle but does not auto-
trigger it, Shadehound Infuse counts any friendly death (not Beasts only).

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 3 (16 minions, 70/100)
entries.body:
Added: Baroness Vashj, Buffet Biggun, Chatty Bartender, Dispossessed
Soul, Halkias, Incriminating Psychic, Mischievous Imp, Murlocula, Orion
Mansion Manager, Partner in Crime, Private Eye, Prosecutor Mel'tranix,
Scuttlebutt Ghoul, Sightless Magistrate, Stonebound Gargon, The
Stonewright (+ infused / buffed-recruit tokens).

Engine:
- summon-copy-of-self (Mischievous Imp, Scuttlebutt Ghoul w/ requireSecret)
  + Infuse variants that summon two.
- grant-self-endturn-summon-copy (Partner in Crime): a one-shot turn-end
  ongoing that summons a copy.
- cast-secret-from-deck (Private Eye; Combo casts 2 via combo field).
- copy-random-enemy-hand (Incriminating Psychic deathrattle).
- draw-both-until (Sightless Magistrate).
- Buffet Biggun Infuse: infused token summons Divine-Shield +2-Attack
  Silver Hand Recruits; The Stonewright reuses the emblem aura
  (tribe Totem +2 Attack); Chatty Bartender reuses controlSecret turn-end
  damage; Murlocula Infuse -> 0-cost lifesteal token.

Simplifications (flagged): Baroness Vashj (transform-redirect), Orion
(secret-revealed trigger), Prosecutor Mel'tranix (hand-lock), Dispossessed
Soul (Locations), Halkias (soul-in-Secret -> Deathrattle returns to hand),
Stonebound Gargon Infuse cleave unmodeled (plain Rush).

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 2 (16 minions, 54/100)
entries.body:
Added: Creepy Painting, Demolition Renovator, Dinner Performer, Forensic
Duster, Framester, Ghastly Gravedigger, Invitation Courier, Muckborn
Servant, Murloc Holmes, Party Favor Totem, Pelagos, Shadowborn, Stewart
the Steward, Suspicious Pirate, The Harvester of Envy, Weapons Expert
(+ Framed / infused Party Favor tokens).

Engine:
- become-copy-of-dead ongoing (creature-died) — Creepy Painting.
- summon-from-deck-affordable (Dinner Performer); enemy-minion-tax-next-
  turn + effectiveCost hook (Forensic Duster); shuffle-cards-into-enemy-
  deck (Framester); shuffle-enemy-hand-card-choose w/ requireSecret
  (Ghastly Gravedigger); reduce-highest-school-spell (Shadowborn);
  summon-random-basic-totem + Infuse variant (Party Favor Totem).
- grant-next-recruit-buff + summon() Silver Hand Recruit hook, with
  self-chaining Deathrattle (Stewart the Steward).
- buff-weapon-or-draw-weapon (Weapons Expert).

Reused discover (cardClasses paladin / cardType weapon / fromEnemyHand)
for Muckborn Servant, Suspicious Pirate, Murloc Holmes. Simplifications:
Demolition Renovator vanilla (locations/Tradeable unmodeled), Invitation
Courier + The Harvester of Envy + Pelagos vanilla (copied-card/spell-
target triggers unmodeled), Framed overload-on-draw not modeled,
Suspicious/Murloc guess minigames dropped.

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 1 (16 minions, 38/100)
entries.body:
Infuse set. Added: Dredger Staff, Sinful Sous Chef, Sinstone Totem,
Suspicious Alchemist, Suspicious Usher, Anonymous Informant, Attorney-at-
Maw, Bibliomite, Class Action Lawyer, Crooked Cook, Imp-oster, Mysterious
Visitor, Priest of the Deceased, Sketchy Stranger, Spirit Poacher, Ashen
Elemental (+ Silver Hand/Wildseed/infused tokens).

Engine:
- Infuse system: infuse {count,id} field + infuseCounter; a hand card
  transforms into its infused form after N friendly minions die (Priest
  of the Deceased).
- damageToEnemyHeroThisTurn tracking + dealtHeroDamage cond (Crooked Cook).
- enemyDrawPunish (drawPunishTurn/Damage) + drawCards hook (Ashen
  Elemental); shuffle-hand-card-into-deck (Bibliomite); set-target-stats

entries.title: Voyage to the Sunken City batch 3 (16 minions, 76/115)

- Abyssal Curse = drawTrigger token dealing 3 to its holder (Sira'kess).

Reused spellsCastWhileHeld cond (Crushclaw/Handmaiden), hero-attacks tutor
(Cutlass Courier Pirate), summoned tribe-gated random-damage (Mecha-Shark),
spell-cast-on-creature selfTarget draw (Myrmidon), schoolCostReduce +
school-gated armor (Radiance), holdingSchool (Shimmering Sunfish), heal
friendly-all (Herald of Light). Simplification: Radiance drops Fire Spell
Damage +2; Snapdragon buffs hand (deck approximated).

entries.title: Voyage to the Sunken City batch 2 (16 minions, 60/115)
entries.body:

  the Tides); buff-hand-tribe (Voidgill); reduce-hand-edges-cost (Wayward

Reused Dredge (Obsidiansmith/Seafloor/Bloodscent, riders simplified),
put-on-bottom (Azsharan Mooncatcher/Sweeper), summoned tribe-gated buff-
self (Security Automaton), conjure-random mage spells (Submerged Spacerock,
Temporary dropped).

entries.title: Battlecards duel: fix stale creature faces on the guest (1/3 vs 6/2 desync)
entries.body:
Report: a Mana Wyrm read 1/3 on one player's screen and 6/2 on the other's.

Root cause was rendering, not game state. The guest never runs the event
animator: it ingests the host's authoritative snapshots (events discarded)
and drives the board purely through layoutTargets -> entityFor. entityFor
rebinds ent.card to the fresh snapshot object but never repainted the cached
face texture, so a creature's 3D face froze at its summon-time stats while
the underlying state (and the host, which is event-driven) moved on. A Mana
Wyrm that grew via spell casts kept showing 1/3 on the guest.

Fix: give each entity a faceSig() of everything the face renders (stats,
keywords, shield/stealth/disguise, cost, durability, loyalty, progress) and
repaint whenever it changes. entityFor now refreshes the face on any stat
drift — the guest's only sync path — and refreshFace keeps the signature in
step so the event-driven path doesn't double-paint. General safety net for
solo/host too.

entries.title: press-and-hold to preview the hero power without using it
entries.body:
Same treatment as cards. The class-power orb previously fired on press, so
trying to read it triggered it.

- Pressing the orb now arms it instead of activating; a quick release uses
  the power, a press-and-hold (~380ms) opens its full reader instead.
- The long-press preview resolves the hero power via classPowerOf (the orb
  has no card uid of its own) and shows it in the card reader.
- The reader gains a "Use <power>" button so it can also be triggered
  deliberately from the preview, mirroring a hand card's Play button.
- clearModes() resets the armed orb.

entries.title: press-and-hold to preview a card without casting it
entries.body:
Playtest pain: cards cast on release when the player only meant to look at
them (any pointer move >=14px on release counted as a drag-to-play), and the
hold-to-preview gesture was wired for touch only.

- Arm the long-press on every card press (desktop + touch), not just touch.
- A ~380ms hold now opens the full card reader (showInspect) — which already
  carries an explicit "Play" button — instead of the small hover tooltip.
- Once a hold fires, the release is a no-op: the drag-to-play branch is gated
  on !longPressFired, so a previewed card can never cast on release. The play
  hint and green placement marker are likewise suppressed during a preview.
- Quick drag-to-play is unchanged: moving >12px before the hold timer cancels
  it, so deliberate drags still play normally.

entries.title: Battlecards UI: bottom-left mana readout + move Auto-pass to bottom-right
entries.body:
Playtest feedback: mana wasn't visible anywhere (it only lived on the 3D
hero-panel texture, easy to miss) and the Auto-pass button floated over the
hand where it blocked cards.

- New #mana-hud chip pinned bottom-left, always in the clear; mirrors
  available/max mana every HUD update, hidden on game over. Colors shift
  when tapped out / empty.
- Auto-pass button moved from mid-right to the bottom-right corner so it no
  longer overlaps the fanned hand. Mobile positions tightened to match.
