entries.title: Monkey & Ox: true Discovers that summon the pick
entries.body:
discover effect gains `count` (queue N separate Discovers) and `to:'board'`
(summon the chosen card instead of adding it to hand); resolvePick summons on
a board-targeted pick. The Azerite Monkey now Discovers three 5-Cost creatures
and The Azerite Ox two 8-Cost creatures, each summoned — replacing the
summon-random stand-ins. Normal Discovers (to hand) are unchanged.

Verified: Monkey queues 3 board Discovers of 5-cost creatures (+ a Nature spell
to hand), Ox queues 2 of 8-cost; picks summon to the board; a plain Discover
still lands in hand.

entries.title: Make the approximated Azerite legendaries exact
entries.body:
Replaces the placeholder battlecries flagged in the last commit with faithful
implementations, backed by new engine effects:

- Lynx: destroy-all now takes side:'enemy' — wipes only the opponents' board
  (was Freeze).
- Rat: new `reanimate` effect summons the highest-Cost creature from your
  graveyard with +2/+2, Lifesteal & Reborn (was a graveyard-return pick).
- Dragon: new `buff-zones` effect buffs creatures in hand + on board now, and
  in your deck as they're drawn (deck cards have no live identity until drawn),
  so the +3/+3 reaches every zone.
- Murloc: new `transform-cost` effect transforms every creature in your hand,
  deck & battlefield into a random creature that costs 3 more (was a flat buff).
- Horse: conjure-random gains a 'weapon' filter, so it adds the Hero Weapon too.
- Goat: conjure-random gains `copies` — three copies of ONE random Holy spell
  (was three different rolls).

Verified each end-to-end. Deck unchanged at 1888 cards.

entries.title: Implement Excavate — looping tier treasures
entries.body:
Excavate digs up a treasure to your hand, then the next dig is one tier higher
(Common -> Uncommon -> Rare -> Epic -> Legendary), looping back to Common after
the Legendary. A per-player excavateCount persists all game and drives the tier
plus the "if you've excavated twice" checks.

Tiers 1-4 hand you the fixed Azerite treasures (Fool's Azerite, Azerite
Fragment/Chunk/Gem); the Legendary tier hands you a random "The Azerite ___"
from your class (dual-class cards like Wolf/Goat belong to either class). All
25 treasure cards are authored as uncollectible tokens (tools/_gen_treasures.py)
with battlecries mapped to supported effects; a few complex ones (Murloc's
transform, Rat's targeted reanimate, deck-wide buffs) are faithful approximations.

Engine: `excavate` effect + addCardToHand + class/tier tables; conjure-cost &
conjure-random gain a setCost rider and conjure-random a spell filter;
conditional gains `excavatedTwice`. Importer learns Excavate / Excavate twice /
"if you've excavated twice" (unlocks ~10 more cards e.g. Feral Forager, Jewel
Mine Overseer) and protects the 25 hand-authored treasure ids. Glossary + an
excavated log line. Deck: 1888 cards.

Verified: Mage digs Common->...->Hawk->loops to Common; excavateCount tracks;
dual-class Centurion rolls Beetle/Goat; Snake/Beetle/Fool's Azerite/Goat
battlecries all execute correctly.

entries.title: Add spell schools + Ponder keyword
entries.body:
Spell schools: canonical set (Arcane, Fel, Fire, Frost, Holy, Nature, Shadow,
Song) + schoolOf() helper. A spell's school lives in its tribe field, so the
spell-played trigger now carries the spell — school-filtered triggers ("after
you cast a Frost spell") match via the existing tribe condition. Card faces
label a spell's plate as e.g. "Frost Spell".

Ponder: an ongoing trigger that fires whenever you draw a card past your first
draw of the turn, or Scry, Dredge, or Gaze. Adds a per-turn draw counter
(reset before the mandatory draw so it doesn't count), firePonder() with a
re-entrancy lock (a Ponder effect that itself draws/scries won't loop), and
hooks in drawCards + the scry/gaze + dredge handlers. Parser learns the
Ponder: trigger (unlocks Esila, Morbid Heirophant); glossary entries for both
Ponder and the spell schools. Deck: 1853 cards.

Verified: first draw doesn't Ponder, each extra draw/scry/dredge fires it once,
no infinite loop; schoolOf + a Frost-only spell trigger both behave.

entries.title: Implement Investigate (make a Clue token); glossary Cook + Investigate
entries.body:
Investigate now mints a Clue token — a 0-cost artifact with "Sacrifice, pay 2:
draw a card" (mirrors Food/Treasure/Blood tokens). Added the clue_token card
def, an `investigate` engine effect (gainTokenCard), AI logic to cash a Clue
in when its hand has room, and glossary entries for both Investigate and Cook
(Cook already minted a Food token — documented it too).

Parser learns `Investigate`; unlocks Warped Warren Puzzlemaster. Other
Investigate cards remain blocked by unrelated unbuilt mechanics (draw-count
triggers, spell-cast triggers, granting ongoing abilities). Deck: 1852 cards.

Verified end-to-end: Investigate creates a Clue, sacrificing it (pay 2) draws
a card and removes the token.

entries.title: Implement Dredge: look at bottom 3 of deck, put one on top (no draw)
entries.body:
Engine: new `dredge` effect + dredgeQueue + resolveDredge(). Mirrors the
Scry/Discover async-decision pattern — the effect lifts the bottom N (default
3) cards off the deck into a pending queue; the chooser picks one to push to
the top (drawn next) and the rest return to the bottom. Nothing is drawn.

game.js: AI-drain (resolveAIDredges), human pick modal (openDredgeModal,
reuses the scry chrome), dredgeStart/dredgeDone events, turn guard, duel
snapshots + guest relay case, spectator overlay, guest modal. ai.js resolves
its own dredge (biggest bottom card to the top). keywords.js glossary entry.

Verified end-to-end with a seeded engine test (bottom 3 offered, pick moved
to top, others stay bottom, hand size unchanged).

Paper import: teaching the parser `Dredge`/`Dredge N` plus a trailing-comma
fix in compound tails unlocks 7 more cards (Bone Glaive, Skeletal Daredevil,
Diving Rig, Blackwing Full Armor Master, Mighty Dino King Rex, Card Grader,
+1). Set now 532/1144; deck total 1850 cards.

entries.title: Import 28 more paper OCR cards onto existing engine mechanics
entries.body:
Extended tools/import_paper_cards.py (in Magepunk66) with parse rules for
paper phrasings that map onto already-implemented engine effects:
single-target attack/health/tribe buffs, tribe keyword grants, each-
player/opponent life gains, restore-to-board, set-attack, transform,
bounce, adapt and freeze variants.

Paper set now converts 525/1144 (was 497): 13 new cards added and 15
HS-import placeholders replaced with the user's own verbatim paper text.
Cards needing unimplemented mechanics (Excavate, Dredge, Investigate,
Planeshift, Harvest, Spark) remain skipped.

entries.title: Add Swing to the keyword glossary (bold + hovertext)
entries.body:
Swing was plain text on Scurrying Scout and ~10 other cards. Added it to the
glossary so it bolds and gets an explanation line: 'Swing — Triggers when this
attacks.'

entries.title: Add the Centurion class to dungeon run
entries.body:
New Centurion class: a 10-card starter deck (legion/taunt curve of its own cards
+ two neutral taunts), five themed bucket drafts (Legion, Beetle Swarm, Bulwark,
Artillery, Legends), and a hero power — Muster (2): Create a 1/1 Legionnaire with
Taunt. It now appears in the dungeon-run class picker; new Test-Realm accounts
also get the centurion starter deck via the shared STARTER_DECKS.

entries.title: Preload card art so cards never flash without their art
entries.body:
Cards drew immediately with the procedural fallback, then the real art popped in
a moment later. New preloadArt(ids) waits for a card's art crop to fully load;
the gallery now loads a page's art before drawing its tiles (keeping the current
page up until ready), and the pack opener preloads the pull during the tear — so
a card only appears once it's complete, no artless flash.

entries.title: Add Morbid to the keyword glossary (bold + hovertext)
entries.body:
Morbid was showing as plain text on Shoreline Spectre (and Vampiric Vandal).
Added it to keywords.js so it bolds on the card face and gets an explanation
line in the tooltips like every other keyword: 'Morbid N — its effect triggers
each time N creatures have died.'

entries.title: Freeze movement instantly when a wild/trainer battle starts
entries.body:
battle.start is async and only set 'active' (which drives blocking) after the
sprites finished loading — so during that gap a held direction key took one more
step past the encounter tile. A _starting flag now makes blocking true the
moment start()/startTrainer() is called (before any await), cleared once active
takes over.

entries.title: Double battles: both active mons gain exp and show an animated EXP bar
entries.body:
grantExp now shares the yield among every active mon on your side (refactored
into a per-mon awardExp helper that handles level-ups + move learning for each).
The ally panel shows its own EXP bar, and meAllyShownExp eases up just like the
lead's so both bars visibly fill.

entries.title: Fix double-battle attack animation + animate the EXP bar
entries.body:
- Double battles: an attack lunge (and the hit flash) now moves only the mon
  that's actually acting, not both mons on a side. spritePose gates each fx by a
  slot tag; the lunge carries the attacker's slot and the hit carries the
  target's slot (single battles unaffected: slot 0 always matches).
- EXP bar: exp was applied instantly so you never saw it move. Now a shown-exp
  value eases up to the real total each frame, filling the bar (and wrapping to
  empty across level-ups via expFracFor); it snaps on a mon switch.

entries.title: Implement Static keyword + Paralyzed status
entries.body:
Static: after combat, a creature with the Static keyword has a 50% chance to
Paralyze whichever combatant survives against it (attacker or defender).
Paralyzed: the creature's attacks fail 50% of the time — you still pick the
target, then a coin flip decides if the swing connects (tails = whiff, attack
still consumed). New maybeParalyze() + paralyzed status field; hooked into the
creature-combat resolution and the attack fizzle. Float text + log + a violet
board glow + a tooltip status line surface it. Tagged the 3 Static cards
(abzan_fortification, millicent, gemspark_tunneler) and added both to the
keyword glossary.

entries.title: Make Firebreathing functional; fix the 3 broken-keyword cards
entries.body:
Firebreathing is now a real keyword: any creature carrying it gains a repeatable
activated ability (spend 1 mana any number of times: +1 Attack until end of
turn). Injected in instantiate() as a { cost:1, repeatable:true, temp-buff-self }
ability; canActivate/activateAbility honour 'repeatable' so it isn't capped by
the once-per-turn gate; the +Attack expires at turn end via the existing
tempAttack cleanup. Tagged all 7 cards whose text claimed Firebreathing.

Fixed the 3 flagged cards so their keywords are real:
- farscape_fiend: +lifesteal, elusive, tradeable (Hexproof -> Elusive).
- millicent: +firebreathing, impulsive, taunt, elusive (Hexproof -> Elusive).
- ancient_watcher: keywords -> [pacifist], text -> 'Pacifist. Inspire: ...'
  (it can no longer attack, as its text says).

entries.title: Normalize MTG phrasing to keywords where the mechanic already backs it
entries.body:
- neurok_commando: fixed trigger self-attacks-hero -> self-hit-player and text to
  'Elusive. Connect: Draw a card.' (matched its own stated text, like Precinct
  Captain).
- Hexproof -> Elusive on ethereal_escort, grandmaster_malchezaar (both carry the
  elusive keyword).
- 'Can't attack' -> Pacifist on humongous_razorleaf, blackhowl_gunspire,
  crossroads_watch_post, ragnaros_the_firelord (all carry the pacifist keyword).

The rest of the catalog already uses keywords cleanly (0 mismatches across
Deathrattle/Taunt/Lifesteal/Rush/Charge/Divine Shield/Windfury/Stealth/Reborn).

entries.title: Board tooltip shows mana cost; Precinct Captain uses Connect
entries.body:
- In-game hover tooltip now leads with 'N MANA ·' so a board creature's cost is
  visible (Core Hound etc.).
- Precinct Captain now genuinely uses the Connect keyword: its trigger changed
  from self-attacks-hero to self-hit-player (deals combat damage to a player,
  matching every other Connect card) and its text reads 'First Strike. Connect:
  Create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.'

entries.title: Lands say 'Gain N mana'; The Coin is a real card; gallery hides uncollectibles
entries.body:
- Land mana taps now read 'Gain N mana.' (77 lands).
- The Coin is a real 0-cost token card: developing a land (or a gain-coin
  effect, or the 2nd player's start) puts The Coin in your hand instead of a
  hidden counter — play it any time for +1 mana this turn (Hearthstone-style).
  New addCoin() + temp-mana effect; hand-overflow burns it like a draw.
- Gallery: a 'show uncollectible' toggle (off by default) hides lands, tokens,
  hero powers, and companions/commanders so the book is your real card pool.

entries.title: Lands: one ability per line + the universal Sacrifice ability on the card
entries.body:
Rules text now honours hard line breaks: richTokens emits a 'br' token at each newline; drawRulesText starts a new line for it and richHtml renders
. Rewrote all 81 land descriptions so each tap ability sits on its own line and appended 'Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.' — the mechanic already existed (engine sacrificeLand + the tap menu's sacrifice option); it just wasn't printed on the card.

entries.title: Use the real MTG mana/tap symbols (Mana font)
entries.body:
Render authentic symbols via Andrew Gioia's open-source Mana font (SIL OFL),
loaded from CDN. keywords.js injects the stylesheet and pipHtml now emits the
font's .ms icon classes (ms-w/u/b/r/g, ms-tap, numeric) with the authentic
ms-cost circle. cardart.js loads the woff2 via the FontFace API and draws the
real glyphs on the canvas card face (with a lettered fallback until it loads),
using the font's cost-circle colours; when the font arrives it repaints every
face via artListeners('*') — handled in game.js and the pack opener.

entries.title: Render mana + tap symbols as pips in rules text
entries.body:
Descriptions store '⟳' (tap) and '(W)/(U)/(B)/(R)/(G)/(N)' (mana) as plain
tokens. New richTokens/richHtml/pipHtml in keywords.js turn them into coloured
symbol pips: the card face draws them inline (drawPip) and the tooltips (in-game
board, pack opener, gallery tile + zoom) render them as styled spans. Fixed a
fillStyle bleak that washed out text after a pip.

entries.title: Redesign card faces: mana top-right, rules text (no orb), keyword help
entries.body:
- Mana cost moved to the TOP-RIGHT; the gallery now draws an owned-copies badge
  (×N) in the TOP-LEFT where the mana used to sit.
- Removed the iridescent 'crystal orb' (both the drawn gem and the 3D glow
  overlay in game.js). The rules text is now printed in a light-tan text box in
  black, with keyword phrases bolded (shrinks to fit, centred).
- New keywords.js glossary drives the bolding and adds small keyword-explanation
  lines beneath the main hover tooltip everywhere it appears (in-game board
  tooltip, pack opener, gallery tiles + zoom).

entries.title: Pack opener: press-and-hold to inspect a revealed card on touch
entries.body:
Touch has no hover, so a long-press (420ms) on a flipped card now peeks its full
tooltip (cost/stats/keywords/description) with a small haptic buzz; releasing
hides it. A short tap still flips the next card / opens a pack, and a drag cancels
the long-press. Mouse hover is unchanged.

entries.title: Freeze overworld movement in menus; polish pack opener + easy back-out
entries.body:
- Overworld: arrow keys no longer queue movement while a menu/dialog/battle is
  open, and the player is frozen even if a key was held as the menu opened. You
  were walking around while scrolling menu options.
- New nav.js adds a clear '← Back' button to every card mode (packs, deck,
  gallery, game) that returns to the overworld in Test-Realm mode (or the menu in
  free play). Esc backs out too on the browse pages; the live game opts out so Esc
  still drives its own menus. Cross-page links now carry mp=1 so hopping between
  card modes doesn't drop you out of the Test Realm.
- Pack opener: cards now scale/space to fit any aspect ratio (corner cards were
  clipping off-screen) and reflow on resize; hovering a revealed card shows a
  tooltip with its cost/stats/keywords/description.

entries.title: Latency: optimistic guest play + adaptive polling
entries.body:
Optimistic card-duel guest: actions now apply to the local board instantly (and
the guest can chain a whole turn's worth), relay the intent, and briefly hold
snapshot ingestion so the host's authoritative echo doesn't revert the move
mid-flight — replacing the old one-action input lock. Covers plays, attacks,
hero powers, targeted spells, land/trade/unmask/coin, end-turn, and the
scry/loot/discover resolutions.

Adaptive polling everywhere: poll fast (~300ms) while it's the OTHER player's
turn (updates streaming in) and relax (~850ms) while you're deciding; the host
drains fast during the guest's turn; Pokemon polls fast while waiting on the
opponent / spectating and relaxes in your own menu. Near-instant on co-located
screens without hammering when idle.

entries.title: In-battle chat + emote reacts for players and spectators
entries.body:
New shared chat.js overlay (DOM, floats over any canvas) used by both card duels
and Pokemon battles. Server rooms: 'm:<matchId>' (match participants + friend-
spectators) and 'u:<user>' (a solo run + its friend-spectators); chat-post/chat-get
enforce membership, cap 40 msgs, validate emote ids, strip control chars, cap text
at 140. Publishers advertise their room in the snapshot so spectators auto-join.

Wired: card duel host/guest, card + solo-run spectators, and Pokemon players +
spectators all mount the widget (emote bar + text input). Typing is guarded so
battle keys aren't triggered while composing.

entries.title: Reconnect/resume: rejoin a battle after a refresh
entries.body:
accept-challenge now records curmatch:<user> for both players. On overworld
boot, checkRejoin() asks my-current-match and prompts 'Rejoin / Forfeit' if a
battle is still live; declining calls leave-match, handing the opponent the win
so they aren't left waiting out the abandon timer. my-current-match lazily
clears the pointer once a match is over or gone.

Pokemon and the card guest rejoin statelessly (re-poll the server). A card HOST
rehydrates the engine from its last published snapshot (which is the complete
game state) instead of dealing a fresh game, then resumes publishing/draining —
verified end-to-end: a host refreshes mid-duel, the board comes back on the same
turn, and play continues.

entries.title: Abandonment detection: a player who leaves forfeits (no more infinite hangs)
entries.body:
Polling is now the liveness signal. Card duels: the host's publish/drain and the
guest's poll each stamp alive:<match>:<role>; if the opponent goes silent past
ABANDON_MS (18s), the poller wins by abandonment — card-poll ends it for the
guest, card-drain for the host, both surfacing a 'left the duel' result.
Pokemon: the match poll stamps alive:<match>:<side> and ends the match for the
present player when the opponent stops polling, flowing through the normal
over-handling. ABANDON_MS is env-overridable for tests.

Also removed the dead post-battle HP stub and documented that live PvP is
non-persistent (link-battle style): the battle runs on a party snapshot, so
damage never carries back to your overworld team.

entries.title: Spectators see Discover/scry choices read-only while a player decides
entries.body:
The pending scry/loot/discover queues now travel in both the solo-run and duel
snapshots, and a watcher renders the front decision as a read-only overlay
("<who> is choosing — Discover (watching)") with the option cards shown but no
buttons. It clears once the player commits. Answers: yes, a spectator can now
watch the choices before a pick is made.

entries.title: Interactive Discover/scry/loot relay for card-duel guests
entries.body:
Previously a duel guest's Discover, scry, and loot-discard decisions were
auto-resolved host-side by the AI heuristic. Now the host holds them open (the
AI-resolve loops skip the guest in a duel), the snapshot carries the pending
scry/discard/pick queues, and the guest surfaces the real modal when its own
decision is at the FRONT of the queue. The modal's confirm relays a resolution
intent (scry/discard/pick) which the host applies to the authoritative engine
after verifying the front entry belongs to the guest. A signature guards against
reopening the same prompt on every poll; resolutions apply on either player's
turn (e.g. an opponent-forced discard).

entries.title: Live interactive card battles (host-authoritative PvP)
entries.body:
Friends can now duel with cards, not just Pokemon. CARDS -> CHALLENGE FRIEND
(or a friend's card challenge) creates a card duel both sides boot into at
/battlecards/?cardpvp=<id>.

Architecture: the challenger (host) runs the real engine as player 0 and
publishes the authoritative board ~1s; the accepter (guest) is player 1, renders
the host's snapshots, and relays action intents (play/attack/hero-power/targeted
spells/land/trade/unmask/coin/end-turn) which the host drains and applies. The
board reorients around the local player (angleOf is now relative to HUMAN) so the
guest sees their own hand at the bottom; input locks between relaying an intent
and the next snapshot. The host mirrors state to cardstate:<host>, so a live duel
is spectatable through the same channel as solo runs.

entries.title: Live card battle / dungeon run spectation
entries.body:
A player in an MP dungeon run or card battle now broadcasts a lean board
snapshot (~1.2s) via publish-cardstate; the presence ping doubles so friends
see them as 'card:dungeon'/'card:battle'. Friends pick Watch from the overworld
FRIENDS menu to open /battlecards/?spectate=<user>, which renders the live
board read-only from cardstate snapshots (local card DB re-attached, no input,
no AI).

entries.title: Faster, mutual overworld presence
entries.body:
- Presence now updates every ~400ms when a friend shares your map (down
  from a 3s heartbeat / 1.5s poll) — minimal latency for side-by-side
  screens — and eases back to ~1.5-1.8s when roaming alone.
- Multi-player + mutual: everyone on the same map now sees everyone
  else's live ghost (not just the visitor seeing the host). A single
  friends poll drives all ghosts; visiting still follows a friend across
  maps and returns home on EXIT.

entries.title: Live PvP Pokemon battles + spectating
entries.body:
Server-authoritative multiplayer battles between friends:
- pvpbattle.js: a compact, pure, self-contained battle engine (type
  chart, Gen-3 damage, STAB/crit, status + stat moves, switching,
  faints). The Netlify function bundles it and resolves each turn once
  both players submit — cheat-resistant, no client trust.
- Backend: challenge/challenges/accept/decline, my-match handshake,
  match/match-action (submit move|switch|replace|forfeit), spectate.
  Parties travel as self-contained snapshots (move power/type baked in).
- Overworld: challenge a friend from the FRIENDS menu (Z=battle,
  X=visit); incoming challenges pop a prompt (polled); accept drops
  both into a live battle. pvp.js renders the match (battleui) and
  submits actions; both clients poll ~1s and animate the published turn.
  A battling friend shows 'is battling — Z=Watch' for read-only spectate.
- dialog callback now receives the closing key so prompts tell Z from X.

Card-battle PvP is still the remaining piece; only Pokemon is live.

entries.title: Multiplayer foundation: friend codes, friends, world visiting + traditional menu
entries.body:
- /magepunktest now launches the overworld (Enter the World); all card
  features moved into an in-game menu.
- Traditional FireRed-style START menu (Enter/MENU button): POKeDEX,
  POKeMON, CARDS, FRIENDS, BAG, SAVE, OPTION, EXIT — keyboard + touch.
- CARDS submenu: Gallery, Deck Builder, Packs, Dungeon Run, Challenge
  Friend (all carry the ?mp account context).
- Backend: every account gets a unique 6-capital-letter friend code;
  add-friend/remove-friend (mutual), heartbeat presence (map/x/y/facing),
  friends list with live online status, single-friend presence lookup.
- FRIENDS menu: shows your code, add by code, lists friends with online
  status + where they are.
- Visit a friend's world: warp into their current map at their position
  and see their sprite move live (presence polled every 1.5s); EXIT
  returns home. Heartbeat every 3s while roaming.
- Fix: -ate abilities reassigned a const mv in battle.js (latent crash
  on any Normal move + Pixilate/Aerilate/etc.); now a let.

Live card/pokemon battle + spectate are the next phase.

entries.title: Trim redundant 'Hero Power (N):' prefix from power tooltips
card tooltips for buckets + hero powers, scaling dungeon HP
entries.body:
- Bucket-pick cards and the hero-power orbs now reveal their rules on
  hover (desktop) or long-press (mobile), via a shared attachTip helper.
  The orb's quick-tap still activates the power; a hold shows the text.
- Dungeon runs: both heroes start at 15 HP on level 1, +5 per level
  (20/25/…/50), instead of the boss's designed health. Heal now caps at
  a per-hero maxLife, and Potion of Vitality lifts that cap when it
  doubles your total. One-off ?boss= fights keep the boss's set health.

entries.title: Unlock all three regions: region select, ferries, and Surf
entries.body:
The web port only ever let you into Kanto. Now:
- Region select on new game: the starter row you pick (Kanto/Johto/
  Hoenn) starts you in Pallet/New Bark/Littleroot. Unlocks ~900 maps
  of already-complete Johto and Hoenn content.
- Ferries at Vermilion (S.S. Anne dock), Olivine Port, and Slateport
  Harbor sail between all three regions from a single save.
- Surf: face water with a healthy Water-type and it carries you out;
  water tiles (behavior 0x10-0x1B) block walking but open up while
  surfing, with a bobbing mount under the sprite; stepping ashore
  dismounts. Water-type wild encounter tables (105 maps) now trigger.
- Position persistence + resume handle surfing and the new maps.

entries.title: Double battles
entries.body:
Two-a-side battles: 10% of grass encounters become wild doubles when
you have two healthy mons (and trainer Twins/Couples with two mons
fight both at once). You pick a move for each of your two active
Pokemon — single-target attacks ask which foe (tappable buttons),
spread moves (Earthquake, Rock Slide, Surf, Blizzard, ...) hit both.
All four actions resolve in speed order with priority; fainted slots
retarget, trainer benches refill their slot, wild fields thin out.
Faints pull replacements from your party mid-battle. Side effects
(screens, hazards, Tailwind) and end-of-turn effects already operated
per side/actor, so weather, seeds, and abilities all work in doubles.
Singles paths untouched; all six regression suites green.

entries.title: Full ability roster + held items
entries.body:
Abilities: ~160 handlers now live (data-driven tables for type boosts,
-ate conversions, absorbers, on-hit reactions) — Adaptability, Iron
Fist, Strong Jaw, Mega Launcher, Reckless, Sheer Force, Tough Claws,
Tinted Lens, Filter/Solid Rock, Fur Coat, Ice Scales, Fluffy,
Multiscale, Heatproof, Water Bubble, Sap Sipper/Storm Drain/Lightning
Rod/Motor Drive absorb-boosts, Bulletproof, Overcoat, Scrappy, Mold
Breaker, Unaware, Simple/Contrary, Defiant/Competitive, Magic Guard,
Poison Heal, Bad Dreams, Moody, Regenerator, Disguise, Imposter,
Intrepid Sword/Dauntless Shield, terrain Surges, Stamina/Berserk/
Anger Point/Justified/Rattled/Weak Armor/Gooey/Cursed Body/Iron
Barbs/Aftermath, No Guard, Super Luck, Sniper, and more. The rest
are genuinely inert here (item-less, doubles-only, forms, weight).

Held items: 40+ items — give from the bag, TAKE back in the party
menu, shown on battle panels. Berries pop at thresholds and cure
statuses (Harvest/Cheek Pouch interact), Leftovers/Black Sludge,
Choice Band/Specs/Scarf with move lock, Life Orb, Expert Belt, Focus
Sash, Quick Claw, King's Rock, Rocky Helmet, Shell Bell, Scope Lens,
BrightPowder, Light Clay, 18 type boosters. Knock Off/Thief/Covet/
Trick/Switcheroo/Bestow/Recycle are real moves now; Unburden/Sticky
Hold/Klutz work. Wild mons hold something 15% of the time; the mart
sells 26 items with a scrolling shop menu.

entries.title: Aurora Veil (both screens) + Tar Shot — status moves 260/260
Every status move functional + the ability system arrives
entries.body:
Status moves 260/260: weather (rain/sun/sand/hail with chip, elemental
scaling, SolarBeam sun-skip), terrains, Trick Room/Gravity/sports,
Tailwind/Safeguard/Mist/Lucky Chant, Substitute, Baton Pass, entry
hazards (Spikes/Toxic Spikes/Stealth Rock/Sticky Web + Defog/Court
Change), Attract (mons have genders now), Disable/Encore/Taunt/
Torment, Perish Song, Destiny Bond, Nightmare, Wish, Endure,
Transform, type-changers, Stockpile line, Metronome/Copycat/Mirror
Move/Assist/Sleep Talk, stat swaps/averages, Belly Drum, Pain Split,
Spite, and 31 items/allies-dependent moves that now fail cleanly.

Abilities: every mon rolls one from its real species options (1,364
species exported from the Love2D data). First 45 handlers: Intimidate,
Levitate, Water/Volt Absorb, Flash Fire, Wonder Guard, Sturdy, pinch
boosts (Overgrow line), Huge/Pure Power, Hustle, Guts, Marvel Scale,
Thick Fat, status immunities (Immunity/Limber/Insomnia/...), contact
reactions (Static/Poison Point/Flame Body/Effect Spore/Rough Skin/
Cute Charm), weather setters (Drizzle/Drought/Sand Stream/Snow
Warning), Speed Boost, Rain Dish, Shed Skin, Synchronize, Trace,
Download, Clear Body/Keen Eye/Hyper Cutter, Shield Dust, Serene
Grace, Inner Focus, Soundproof, Damp, Rock Head, Compound Eyes,
Sand Veil, Swift Swim, Chlorophyll, Cloud Nine/Air Lock, Battle/Shell
Armor, Natural Cure, Truant, Run Away. Panels show ability + gender;
weather tints the arena. Old saves migrate (gender/ability rolled in).

entries.title: Move mechanics batch: 45+ status moves, fixed damage, two-turn, traps
entries.body:
- Multi-stat boosts (Calm Mind, Bulk Up, Dragon Dance, Quiver Dance,
  Shell Smash, Curse, Coil, ...) and 20+ debuffs (Screech, Cotton
  Spore, Fake Tears, Tickle, ...)
- Protect/Detect with the halving success streak; Yawn (delayed
  sleep); Haze; Roar/Whirlwind end wild battles; Heal Bell /
  Aromatherapy / Refresh; Aqua Ring / Ingrain regen; Belly Drum;
  Pain Split; Swagger/Flatter boost-then-confuse
- Fixed damage (Seismic Toss, Night Shade, Dragon Rage, Sonic Boom,
  Psywave, Super Fang, Endeavor) + OHKO moves with the level gate
- Two-turn charge moves (Fly, Dig, SolarBeam, ... — auto-continue,
  AI locked in too), Hyper Beam recharge, Explosion self-KO (both
  sides fainting resolves correctly), Wrap-family trapping chip
- Secondary stat drops on damaging moves (Icy Wind, Psychic, Crunch,
  Rock Tomb, ...) and self-drops (Overheat, Superpower, Close Combat)
- Status-move coverage: 55 -> 101 of 260 learnable; the rest are
  genuinely systemic (Baton Pass, Substitute, hazards, weather)

entries.title: Battle depth: confusion, Leech Seed, Toxic, screens, ball tiers, Ether, move-forget prompt
entries.body:
- Confusion (Confuse Ray/Supersonic/Swagger + secondary chances on
  Psybeam, Dynamic Punch, Water Pulse, ...): 2-5 turns, 50% typeless
  40-power self-hit; volatile, cleared on switch/faint/battle end
- Leech Seed: fails on Grass types, saps 1/8 each turn to the other
  side's active mon
- Toxic badly-poisons: ramping 1/16 x n chip (resets out of battle)
- Reflect / Light Screen: 5-turn side screens halving phys/special
- Great Ball (x1.5) and Ultra Ball (x2) multipliers reach the Gen3
  catch formula; both plus Ether now sold at the mart
- Ether restores 10 PP to all moves (battle: costs the turn; bag: pick
  a mon)
- Learning a 5th move now asks which to forget (tappable move buttons
  or GIVE UP) instead of silently deleting the oldest

entries.title: Full-res touch menus + battle hit sparks and damage numbers
entries.body:
- Party, Bag, Shop, PC storage, and the starter picker now render at
  full canvas resolution with the battle's panel/button components:
  sprite icons, HP bars, status badges, type-colored starter cards —
  every row and button directly tappable (keyboard still works)
- Dialog text boxes draw crisp at full res (same GBA cream styling)
- Battles: type-colored spark bursts on every hit, floating damage
  numbers (gold on crits), green +heal numbers for drains and heals

entries.title: Overworld QoL: sound, saved position, running, smarter trainers, Struggle
entries.body:
- Pokemon cries (1,366, lazily fetched) + battle SFX from the Love2D
  build: cries on appear/send-out/faint, effectiveness-matched hit
  sounds, ball open/drop through the whole catch sequence
- Your position (map + tile) persists — reloading resumes where you
  stood; URL params still override for deep links
- Hold Shift (or the B button on touch) to run at ~1.9x
- Trainers now pick their strongest expected move (power x STAB x
  type effectiveness, 15% wildcard); wild mons stay random
- All moves out of PP: FIGHT uses Struggle instead of dead-ending

entries.title: Pokemon battles: Love2D-style presentation + full touch support
entries.body:
- Battle scene now renders at full canvas resolution (not the 240x160
  pixel frame): dark rounded info panels with type badges, status
  badges, stat-stage chips, animated HP bar + numbers, EXP bar, team
  dots, and the m6x11plus pixel font from the desktop build
- Type-colored move buttons with PP/Power, FIGHT/BAG/PKMN/RUN buttons,
  list rows for bag/switch — all tappable (hover states on desktop)
- Animations: entry slides, attack lunge, hit flash + screen shake,
  faint sink, recall/send-out, ball throw with arc/shakes/sparkle
- Touch: virtual d-pad + A/B + PARTY/BAG buttons on coarse pointers,
  hold-to-walk, taps advance dialogs; responsive canvas on phones

entries.title: Bucket picks: hover (or tap) a card to read its rules text
entries.body:
Mini card faces in dungeon overlays get a tooltip with name, cost,
stats, and full description; tap-away dismisses it on touch.

entries.title: Concede pays nothing; pack inventory piles up in the opener
entries.body:
- 🏳 Concede button during dungeon runs: confirm overlay, ends the run
  immediately with NO pack (only genuine defeat/completion pays)
- Test realm pack opener shows banked unopened packs as a physical
  stack beside the opener; with zero banked the pack hides

entries.title: Magepunk Test Realm: accounts, server collections, pack rewards
entries.body:
/magepunktest — username/password accounts (Netlify Function + Blobs,
scrypt hashes, HMAC session tokens). Fresh accounts own exactly the
dungeon starter deck cards + 1 welcome pack. Four modes: Dungeon Run,
Pack Opener, Deck Builder, Gallery — all server-authoritative (packs
are rolled server-side, deck saves validated against the collection).

- Dungeon runs pay +1 pack on completion, win or lose (rate-limited)
- Starter decks are editable per class in the deck builder (?mp=1)
- Gallery in MP mode shows only owned cards
- Free play at /battlecards is untouched (separate storage keys)
- Fix: returning mid-run now offers resume-or-abandon instead of
  silently locking you to last run's class
- mp-dev-server.mjs runs the whole stack locally (file-backed store)

Set MP_SECRET in Netlify env vars to make session tokens unforgeable.

entries.title: Locations: 25 Hearthstone location cards playable
entries.body:
- New location effects: copy-to-hand (Puppet Theatre), copy-summon w/
  dormant (Crimson Expanse), summon-with-stats (Forge of Wills),
  destroy-friendly rider (Construct Quarter), discover/summon-random
  minCost, grant ifTribe, buff repeatPerFriendly, random-damage
  perFriendlyTribe, summon tokens with inline deathrattles
- Locations fire their Deathrattle when they crumble (Ultralisk Cavern)
- UI: durability plate on location faces, tapped locations turn
  sideways, placement drag works for locations, AI taps its locations
- HS 'reopen' cooldown clauses dropped: double-tap IS the cooldown

entries.title: Creatures never tap; Miniaturize adds a 1/1 Mini copy for 1
entries.body:
Activated abilities: abilityUsedThisTurn (once per turn) replaces
the whole tap concept — no attack spend, no sickness gate, reset at
turn start. Miniaturize: playing the card hands you a 1/1 copy
costing 1 with the Mini keyword (minis don't chain). Mana elves
removed from the WUBRG pool.

entries.title: Five systems: Ward, Magnetic, Echo, Dormant, HS quests
entries.body:
Ward = extra cost to target an enemy creature (mana blocks the play
when unaffordable; life and discard pay on commit) — enforced across
spells, battlecries, hero powers, and activated abilities. Magnetic
merges stats/keywords/deathrattles onto a friendly Mech (drag the
card onto the Mech; solo drops play normally). Echo leaves ghost
copies in hand that fade at end of turn. Dormant creatures sleep
untouchable for N owner turns, then wake drowsy and fire their
awaken effects. Quest goals gained tribe/cost filters plus draw,
damage-taken, and play kinds.

entries.title: Engine ops for the HS fruit pass (pool 1772)
entries.body:
damage all-heroes + undamaged-enemy-creatures, heal enemy-hero,
condAttack weapon bonus in aura recompute, attackAgainOnKill refunds
the attack on kills, conditional if.handEmpty, buff-random-friendly
count picks distinct targets. 29 new cards incl. Batterhead,
Knife Vendor, City Tax, Shado-Pan Rider, Menagerie Mug, I Know a Guy.

entries.title: Land rules rework, Locations, mobile gallery, wiki design backlog
entries.body:
LANDS: the shop starts at the five basics; basics build your color
identity and advanced lands unlock only when every color they need
is covered (Swamp -> Temple of Bontu; a second basic opens the
matching duals). Lands DOUBLE-tap: tapping adds a tap stone — next
turn the stone comes off but the land stays tapped, the turn after
it untaps. Every land can be sacrificed to draw a card. LOCATIONS:
new type — creature-row permanents that tap like lands (double-tap
included), wear out after `durability` uses, can't be attacked or
damaged, don't feed auras/corpses. GALLERY: mobile 2x3 grid, tap
any card for a zoom view with full info, touch-aware tooltips.
WIKI: Battlecards > Design Work section lists all 3,048 pending
design items, searchable.

entries.title: 70 WUBRG cards live (pool 1743) + destroy maxCost filter
entries.body:
Llanowar Elves, Monastery Swiftspear, Soul Warden, Glorious Anthem,
Nantuko Shade, Lightning Bolt-family burn, Duress, Unsummon, Raise
the Alarm and 60 more join the colored pools the lands conjure from,
with Scryfall art crops. Engine: mana-value filters on destroy +
chosen-target specs.

entries.title: Six MTG engine systems for the WUBRG pool
entries.body:
Activated creature abilities ({T}/sacrifice/pay-life/discard costs;
tap spends the attack, ability menu on click, AI uses untargeted
ones), enchant-creature auras (attach/attach-curse ops with
attachment tracking), +1/+1 counters (add-counters + counter-self
trigger op), X-cost spells (spend all mana, X threads through
damage/draw/summon/counters via source.xValue), graveyard recursion
and library search (gy-return/search ops through the pick modal
with titles, new resolvePick modes; searches reshuffle). 10 showcase
cards from the planned lists, full art.

entries.title: Positional creature placement: drag to a board gap
entries.body:
playCard takes an insertion index; dragging a creature out of hand
shows a pulsing green slot marker at the gap under the cursor (far
left, far right, or between any two creatures) and plays there on
release. A plain tap still appends right. Position threads through
choose-one menus and targeted battlecries (pending.position), so an
Elven Archer dropped far-left stays far-left after targeting. Works
with touch drags.

entries.title: Touch support: play Battlecards on a phone
entries.body:
Viewport meta (no pinch-zoom, viewport-fit cover), touch-action none,
100dvh, compact chrome under 760px (log hidden, finger-sized End
Turn). Camera pulls back on narrow aspects so portrait fits the whole
table. Touch input model (pointer:coarse): hand cards play on RELEASE
so browsing can't cast, long-press (480ms) inspects any card via the
tooltip, hover tooltips disabled, drag-to-target works with a finger.
pointerdown now seeds mouseX/Y so stationary touches long-press
correctly.

entries.title: True drag-to-target: press, drag, release commits
entries.body:
Window-level pointerup: releasing after a >14px drag commits the
target under the cursor (creatures/walkers via raycast, heroes via
panel hit-test through elementFromPoint), releasing in place keeps
click-then-click intact, dragging to nothing cancels. Unified
tryCommitTargetAt covers attacks, hero attacks, and every pending
mode (play/power/walker/tap).

entries.title: Hearthstone-style targeting arrow
entries.body:
While an attacker or targeted card is armed, a red chevron arrow
curves from the source to the cursor on a pointer-events-none
overlay canvas, redrawn per frame: arc-length-resampled bezier,
marching chevrons, cursor-pinned arrowhead, source socket. Draws
for attacks, hero attacks, targeted spells/battlecries/powers/
walker abilities; right-click cancel clears it. Test hooks
armAttack/targeting on window.__game.

entries.title: Landing menu (Test Battle / Dungeon Run) + 3 new dungeon classes
entries.body:
Bare visits now land on a two-button menu: TEST BATTLE boots the
classic table unchanged, DUNGEON RUN opens the run flow. Any URL
param (?battle=1/?players/?boss/?dungeon) skips the menu for deep
links and tests. Dungeon roster grows to 12 classes: Death Knight,
Demon Hunter, and Bounty Hunter (new Dead Eye class power) each get
a curated starter deck and 6-8 themed buckets from their own card
pools.

entries.title: Dungeon Run drafts use the real Kobolds buckets (81, full coverage)
entries.body:
Victory drafts now offer 3 authentic themed buckets (Berserker,
Dragon Heart, Silver Hand, Lost Secrets...) with 3 random cards from
that bucket's real card list; every listed card is in the pool and
functional. Unique packs (Mage/Priest/Warlock) draw from the whole
class pool. Engine: add-token, forEnemy summon-random, Brann/
Rivendare double-trigger auras, named buffs/auras for Silver Hand
Recruits. +46 bucket cards incl. Thaurissan, Brann, Rivendare,
The Curator, Muster for Battle (pool 1663, full art).

entries.title: Full Dungeon Run mode at ?dungeon=1: 8 levels, 22 bosses, treasures
entries.body:
Run loop: class pick -> fight -> bucket draft (3x3, class+neutral,
rarity-weighted) -> treasure after odd levels (14 Kobolds passives:
Crystal Gem, Captured Flag, Battle Totem, Scepter of Summoning,
Cloak of Invisibility...) -> next boss; state persists in
localStorage; defeat ends the run, level 8 win banks 500 gold.
Engine: battlecries/deathrattlesTwice flags, installSecret,
discount-hand, mill, summon-self-copy, summon-from-hand, costMod
enemies scope + minCost, aura stealth flag, damaged/own-creature
damage pools, heal all-heroes, spells-this-game selfCost.

entries.title: Dungeon Run level-1 bosses: Bink, Giant Rat, Wee Whelp playable
entries.body:
?boss=<id>[&class=<cls>] starts a 1v1 encounter: boss AI on its wiki
deck at 10 HP with its real hero power (Coin/Rat Race/Baby Breath,
via classPicks synthesis), human on the class's 10-card starter
deck, corner zones cleared. dungeon.js holds decks + boss data +
randomBoss(level). Engine: forEnemy/self-attacks-hero/
enemy-spell-played/grant-self/deaths-this-turn selfCost/conjure-
random count+other. Real boss portraits from the HS CDN.

entries.title: Dungeon-run starter deck support: 5 missing cards + 3 ops
entries.body:
conjure-random (filtered random card to hand), give-enemy-random,
copy-deathrattle (chosen friendly's deathrattle onto the played
minion), buff-random-friendly on the deathrattle path. Unlocks
Tortollan Forager, Mulch, Dark Cultist, Undercity Huckster,
Unearthed Raptor; all 90 starter cards verified playable.

entries.title: All rarities imported: +185 cards incl. 29 legendaries (pool 1550)
entries.body:
Engine: summon-deck-copy (Barnes), summon forEnemy rider (Leeroy's
Whelps go to an opponent), copy-minion of:'target' + stat override
(Pack Tactics copies the attacked creature). Purged 28 mis-parsed
entries whose summon token names were unparsed rule clauses.

entries.title: Tradeable mechanic + 142 expansion commons (pool 1365)
entries.body:
Engine: canTrade/tradeCard (pay 1, shuffle back, draw, 'traded'
trigger), offTurnAttack aura, damage other-creatures, exact-cost
summon-random, buff-hand, discover keyword filter + buff rider,
holdingTribe conditionals, tribal discounts. Game: trade menu on
tradeable hand cards. AI: trades unaffordable tradeables. Art tiles
for every new card (1365/1365 coverage).

entries.title: 333 expansion commons + art (pool 1223, full art coverage)
entries.body:
The cached HearthstoneJSON dump (fetched 2026-07-04) covers all 48
sets through the 2025 expansions. New importer pass runs every
non-VANILLA COMMON through the clean-room grammar: 333 of 2,350
candidates fully parse (modern keywords like Frenzy/Spellburst/
Discover/Overload/Honorable Kill ride the wave 3-7 engine ops),
170 collide with existing pool cards (paper/vanilla win), the rest
skip. Entries tagged set:"hsx" for in-place refresh; DEMONHUNTER/
DEATHKNIGHT map to our demon_hunter/death_knight slugs. Art fetcher
now maps ids across every set - all 333 dressed, art dir 1223/1223
(~21MB). All ten suites green.

entries.title: real card art for the paper set (487 crops)
entries.body:
The art window is cut from the user's own 350x496 card scans
(tools/extract_paper_art.py in Magepunk66) into battlecards/art/
<id>.jpg + index.json (~7.4MB). cardart.js loads the manifest and
lazily streams crops: paintArt cover-fits the real image when ready
and falls back to procedural art otherwise, so card faces, board
ovals, hero-power tiles, the gallery, packs, and the deck builder all
pick it up through the one paint path. artListeners notify live
surfaces - the 3D game repaints any entity showing that card, the
gallery repaints its visible page. Disguised creatures keep the
anonymous procedural face (no art leak). HS-imported cards stay
procedural by design: HearthstoneJSON carries no art, and Blizzard's
artwork is not ours to ship.

entries.title: smaller board tokens that never overlap
entries.body:
Token base size 1.35 -> 1.1 card-widths (they were wider than the max
row spacing, guaranteeing overlap), and crowded rows now scale tokens
down to 97% of their actual spacing so neighbors keep a visible gap
at any board width.

entries.title: HS-style board presentation (user request from screenshot)
entries.body:
Board creatures shed their card frame once played: they render as
minion OVALS - elliptical generative art in a class-tinted metallic
rim with BIG bottom stat gems (white normal, green buffed, red damaged
health), a stone shield ring for Taunt, a golden halo for Divine
Shield, and a dimmed portrait for Stealth. Entities swap bodies
automatically when a card changes zone (box card in hand -> flat
oval token on board) and the rules gem rides along.

Enemy readability: board tokens always face the HUMAN viewer
regardless of slice rotation, so opponents' attack/health read
right-side-up at any table position.

Hero identity: every panel now carries a circular class PORTRAIT
(procedural art + class-color ring) with the class hero power as an
orb right next to it - the orb shows the power's cost, glows green
when usable, greys out when spent, activates on click (with targeting
and choice menus), and the class power no longer duplicates as a table
card. Foe panels get the same portrait + orb with a tooltip.

entries.title: Blood/Treasure/Food tokens are field artifacts (user fix)
entries.body:
Per playtest feedback on Batty Barker: Sanguine's Blood Token must NOT
go to hand - tokens materialize on the battlefield in the artifact row.
All three token permanents are now type 'artifact' with a `sac`
activation ({cost, discard?, effects}): click your token to sacrifice
it (Blood: pay 1 + discard a card of your choice via the loot picker,
then draw; Treasure: free, gain 1 mana; Food: pay 2, restore 3).
canSacrifice/sacrificeToken exported; resolveDiscard runs `then`
rewards after the discard so Blood's draw comes last; sacrifice fires
a 'token-sacrificed' trigger (First Little Pig re-parsed onto it).
AI cashes treasures always, food at <=30 life, blood with spare cards.
Token definitions upsert in place on re-import.

entries.title: Enrich, Cook, Medic, Draft/Discover (890 total)
entries.body:
User definitions: Enrich creates a Treasure Token (0-mana token spell:
gain 1 mana), Cook creates a Food Token (2 mana: restore 3 to your
hero), Medic N heals N damage from board neighbors at end of turn
(card.medic field, silence-stripped, grant-medic op for Abzan Charm),
Draft = Discover with 5 options instead of 3.

Discover/Draft is a real pick flow now: 'discover' op samples pick-N
distinct cards (filters: cardType incl spell/weapon, tribe, exact cost,
maxCost, hasStatic spell-damage, grant-keyword rider on the pick) into
state.pickQueue; humans choose from a card modal, the AI takes the
biggest card, maybeRunAI waits on your pick, resolvePick exported.

Extras riding along: spellsPlayedThisTurn counter powering
first-spell-each-turn-free cost auras (Kalecgos), tribal spell/creature
cost auras on creatures (Frostfire Feline's Frost discount, Millicent's
Spirits), Food-sacrifice triggers via ongoing.if.cardId (First Little
Pig), parametrized keyword lines (Medic 3 / Spell Damage+2 - Curious),
freeze keyword -> freezer on creatures, exile minAttack, 'Choose one -'
dash headers (Abzan Charm's 5 modes). ~24 cards unlocked; pool 890
(491 paper).

entries.title: Impulsive, Chromatic, Loot keywords (864 total)
entries.body:
Impulsive (user ruling: it has to attack): at the very start of endTurn,
the current player's Impulsive creatures spend any remaining attacks on
random legal targets before the turn hands over - self-enforcing for
human and AI alike, windfury-aware.

Chromatic (user ruling: color boosts roll twice and keep both): the
boost op rolls the d6 table twice for Chromatic targets. Impulsive also
fills the Red boost table's last pending slot, completing all five
boost tables.

Loot (user ruling: draw a card, then discard a card OF YOUR CHOICE):
new discardQueue + resolveDiscard mirroring the scry flow - humans get
a hand-picker modal (reusing the scry chrome), the AI dumps its most
expensive card, and maybeRunAI waits on your pick. enemy-discard op for
Aclazotz's Swing.

Unlocked: Farscape Simian, Vivid Lutrin, Verdant Behemoth (Luck tails),
Marek Devious Divebomber, Sanguine Templar (Loot twice deathrattle),
Aclazotz, Vampiric Vandal. Pool 864 (467 paper).

entries.title: Sanguine + Honorable Kill keywords (859 total)
entries.body:
Sanguine (paper rules): whenever a creature with Sanguine attacks OR is
attacked, its controller banks a Blood Token - a 1-mana token spell
that trades a discard for a draw. Fires from creature combat (both
directions) and hero attacks on a Sanguine defender. Token cards no
longer reshuffle from the graveyard (they cease to exist, like MTG
tokens). Sanguine also fills the pending Black boost-table slot.

Honorable Kill (exact lethal, HS convention: damage lands the target
on exactly 0): creatures fire it after an exact killing blow (Nostalgic
Gnome), weapons after an exact lethal swing (Bloodseeker's +1/+1),
spells when any of their damage scored an exact kill this cast (Keen
Reflex) via a per-spell exactKills counter in damageCreature. Silence
strips it; honorableKill event logged.

Unlocked ~10 paper cards: Batty Barker, Gogmazios, Darkfallen Neophyte
(corpse-paid Sanguine grant), Bloodthirsty Ragefin, Malignant Horror
(corpse-paid random keyword at turn end), Bucket of Soldiers (five
tokens with random bonus keywords via summon randomKeywords), Keen
Reflex, Bloodseeker, Nostalgic Gnome. Pool 859 (461 paper).

entries.title: Corpse mechanic (universal, DK-visible) + corpse card suite
entries.body:
Rule per design: EVERY player banks a Corpse whenever a creature they
control dies (was a Death Knight class passive). Only Death Knights
get a UI indicator; all other classes track corpses as hidden
information - the count exists in state and corpse-spend cards work,
but no panel shows it (own or foe) unless that player is a DK.

New spend variants: spend-corpses-up-to (max or ALL, effects repeated
per corpse spent - Marrow Manipulator, Lord Marrowgar, Climactic
Necrotic Explosion, Might of Menethil via new freeze-random),
spend-corpses-while (Corpse Explosion repeats while creatures survive;
deaths mid-loop legitimately re-bank corpses), grant-recent (Tomb
Guardians' Reborn riders on fresh tokens).

Unlocked 20 paper corpse cards incl. Bonedigger Geist, Defrost, Grave
Strength (base +1, corpse-paid +3 instead), Heart Strike (corpse on
kill via damage-then), Vampiric Blood, Battlefield Necromancer (turn-
end Risen Footman; creatures now parse turn-start/end trigger lines).
Paper re-imports now REFRESH stale paper entries; Southsea Deckhand's
weapon-conditional Charge parses natively (no hand patch needed).
Pool 851 (454 paper). test_wave9.js 15 checks incl. DOM indicator
gating; waves 3-8 re-green.

entries.title: paper re-import wave (+62 cards, 833 total; 435 paper)
entries.body:
Re-ran the paper importer against the wave-3..7 engine: 435 of 1,144
paper cards now convert (was 371). Engine additions for paper idioms:
tutor cardType 'spell' + maxCost, adapt-all, gain-max-mana 'all',
conditional heroAttacked/controlMinAttack/nontoken tests, hero-immune
turn flag (damageHero), weapon deathrattles fire on break (Quick Pick),
weapon cleave/freezer in hero attacks (Flamereaper), enchantment/
artifact battlecries now execute on play, cost auras scan permanents
(not just board) with tribe filters (Quokka's Last Stand), traps
springing count as secret reveals (paper Eaglehorn), plus small ops:
return-self-to-hand, shuffle-hand, destroy-strongest,
sacrifice-each-enemy, conjure-cost (Discover approximation), gain-coin,
draw-to. Unlocks include Aluneth, Desert Spear, Candleshot, Magnifying
Glaive, Abzan Ascendancy (nontoken Spirit trigger), Flipper Friends,
Healing Touch, Hidden Oasis, and dozens of spells/creatures riding the
wave-6/7 conditional + splash grammar.

entries.title: cleanup wave (43 cards, 771 total) - HS classic nearly done
entries.body:
Aura/stat systems: global cross-player tribal auras (Murloc Warleader/
Grimscale), selfScale per-tribe attack (Old Murk-Eye), statRule
attack-equals-health (Lightspawn), condKeyword while-armed (Southsea
Deckhand - also upgraded the paper card of the same name, whose printed
text is this exact mechanic and had shipped functionless).

Statics: heal-becomes-damage (Auchenai, heal op inverts), double-spell
(Velen doubles spell/hero-power damage+healing), immune-attacking
(Longbow skips counterattack), attack-costs-attack (Gorehowl).

Weapons as trigger sources: fireOngoing now includes the equipped
weapon (Sword of Justice summon blessing + lose-durability, Eaglehorn
on new secret-revealed hook). Bloodsail Corsair degrades enemy blades;
Upgrade! buffs-or-forges; Blade Flurry converts the weapon to AoE.

Secrets: friendly-minion-died trigger (Redemption revive at 1hp),
Spellbender retargets enemy spells to a decoy via ctx.target mutation.

Timing effects: doom (Power Overwhelming dies at end of turn), corrupt
(dies at caster's next turn start), mind-control-temp (Shadow Madness
returns at end of turn), temp-stealth-all w/ next-turn expiry (Conceal),
temp-immune (Bestial Wrath), commanding-shout 1-health floor,
every-turn-end trigger (Gruul), Lightwell/Nat Pagle/Master Swordsmith
tails, Alarm-o-Bot hand swap, Lorewalker Cho any-spell copies.

Splash/adjacency: swipe, damage-adjacent (Explosive Shot, Cone of Cold
w/ freeze), betrayal, shadowflame, devour-adjacent (Void Terror),
adjacent statics (Ancient Mage). Misc: swap-stats (Crazed Alchemist),
2-3 damage rolls (Lightning Storm), set-hero-health (Alexstrasza),
mana crystal ops (Wild Growth skipped as legacy collision; Felguard/
Arcane Golem), Animal Companion token trio, King Mukla's Banana token
(excluded from packs/decks via token flag), Houndmaster/Bestial Wrath
tribe-gated targeting, Flare, Divine ordering fixes.

Only 8 HS classics remain unimported, all by design: Tracking (needs
bespoke UI), Headcrack, Shadowform, ETC, Gelbin, Jaraxxus, Nozdormu,
Ysera.

entries.title: Inner Rage + Cruel Taskmaster (728 total)
entries.body:
The damage-plus-attack-rider pattern was planned in wave 3 but never
landed in the importer, so both cards silently skipped. Now imported.

entries.title: conditionals (wave 6, 27 cards, 726 total)
entries.body:
New effect frameworks:
- 'conditional' {if, then, else}: control-a-tribe (Kill Command), own
  low health (Mortal Strike), target frozen (Ice Lance), target is your
  tribe (Demonfire) - branches re-enter execEffects with the same target.
- 'damage-then' {ifDies, ifSurvives}: Slam, Mortal Coil, Bane of Doom
  (spell-damage statics still apply).
- valuePer scaling on damage/draw: armor (Shield Slam), hero attack
  (Savagery), damaged friendly characters (Battle Rage).
- targeting conditions: requireDamaged filter (Execute, Rampage) and
  tribe-gated destroy w/ 'then' riders (Hungry Crab, Sacrificial Pact).
- conditional ongoing triggers via ongoing.if (maxAttack/tribe/overload/
  cardType/controlSecret) gating before Avenge counters: Warsong
  Commander (grant-minion op), Starving Buzzard, Scavenging Hyena,
  Murloc Tidecaller, Unbound Elemental, Secretkeeper, Ethereal Arcanist.
- 'healed' trigger fired from healHero/creature heals only on actual
  healing: Lightwarden, Northshire Cleric.
- one-offs: draw-to-match (Divine Favor), draw-damage (Holy Wrath),
  consume-shields (Blood Knight), resummon-source deathrattle
  (Ancestral Spirit; deathrattles now pass the dead card as source).

entries.title: Enrage + Combo (wave 5, 12 cards, 699 total)
entries.body:
Enrage: card.enrage {attack, keywords, weaponAttack} is a self-aura that
applies only while the creature is damaged, riding the recomputeAuras
delta machinery (auto apply/retract, keyword grants tracked). Recompute
now fires on creature damage (guarded) and after every execEffects batch
so heals/set-health retract bonuses. Spiteful Smith's weaponAttack folds
into heroAttackValue while armed. Silence strips enrage.

Combo: p.cardsPlayedThisTurn counts fully-resolved plays (incremented
at the END of playCard so a combo card sees only earlier cards); when a
card.combo line exists and a card was already played, liveEffectsOf()
swaps it in for battlecries, spells, and targetSpec, so targeting UI
and AI both follow the active line. Edwin scales via buff-self
per:'cards-played'. Cards: Angry Chicken, Raging Worgen, Tauren
Warrior, Grommash, Spiteful Smith, Cold Blood, Eviscerate, Defias
Ringleader, SI:7 Agent, Kidnapper, Edwin VanCleef, Perdition's Blade.

entries.title: transforms + cost modifiers (wave 4, 15 cards, 687 total)
entries.body:
Transforms: 'transform' replaces a creature in place with a token (no
death, no deathrattle, keeps board slot + summoning sickness; random/
others/options variants) - Hex, Polymorph, Tinkmaster. 'transform-copy'
turns the played minion into a copy of a chosen creature, cloning live
stats/damage/triggers minus aura contributions - Faceless Manipulator.

Cost modifiers: new effectiveCost() used by canPlay/playCard. Layers:
selfCost per-count printed costs (Sea/Mountain/Molten Giant, Dread
Corsair), costMod board auras w/ scope own/all, floor, firstEachTurn
(Sorcerer's Apprentice, Venture Co., Summoning Portal), one-shot
costDiscounts riders consumed on play + this-turn expiry (Preparation,
Kirin Tor Mage), free-enemy-spells next-turn flag (Millhouse), and
draw-discount instance discounts (Far Sight). Silence strips costMod;
transformed/silenced sources stop contributing immediately.

entries.title: HS classic import wave 3 (79 cards, 672 total)
entries.body:
New engine ops: bounce (w/ cost mod + Vanish all-bounce), destroy-random/
destroy-all (others/spareRandom), set-health/set-attack (aura-preserving),
attack-equals-health, double stats, heal-full, mass+hero temp-buff,
copy-enemy (hand/deck/summon), mind-control (chosen/random/conditional),
draw-enemy, tutor (tribe from deck), grant-deathrattle, adjacent-buff,
buff-self scaling (per hand card / other friendly), discard-all, damage
to all other characters, tribe/others buff scopes, silence-all.

Targeting: new CHOSEN entries, friendly-any kind (Rockbiter), minAttack/
requireKeyword filters (Shadow Word: Death, Black Knight). AI aims new
debuffs/steals at the biggest enemy and self-pumps at its own board.
Tribes now imported from HS races (+backfilled onto 30 earlier imports)
so tribal auras (Timber Wolf, Tundra Rhino keyword auras) actually work.

Headliners: Sylvanas, Deathwing, Doomsayer, Mind Control, Brawl, Equality,
Truesilver (weapon trigger), Antonidas, choose-one cards (Wrath, Keeper,
Cenarius, Ancients), Unleash the Hounds, Defender of Argus.

entries.title: real Boost tables + Defender/Cleave/Reborn/Prowess/Adapt
entries.body:
The provisional Boost tables are replaced by the designed d6-per-color
tables: White (stats/Defender/Bolster/Taunt/Swift/Lifesteal), Blue
(Swing: Scry, health, Spell Damage, Prowess, Hexproof), Black
(Venomous, Avenge heals, Reborn, Deathtouch), Red (+3 Attack, Cleave),
Green (Connect: Adapt, stats, Frenzy: Bolster, Inspire, Windfury,
Trample). Entries whose systems don't exist yet (Excavate, Ward,
Advance, Planeshift, Sanguine, Dredge, Impulsive) roll as +1/+1 with a
pending label. Rolls can grant triggers, statics, keywords, stats, or
deathrattles, and the log announces each result.

New supporting mechanics: paper Defender (a coin-flip chance to
intercept attacks aimed at your other permanents - the old can't-attack
slug is renamed pacifist), Cleave (combat damage splashes the
defender's neighbors), Reborn (first death returns the creature at 1
health), Prowess via temporary +1/+1 with new temp-health support, the
Adapt d10 table, and Bolster (+N/+N to your lowest-health creature).

Fixes: granted ongoing triggers now pass their owner into self-scoped
effects, and the AI hero swing uses heroAttackValue so weaponless
class-power attacks no longer crash.

entries.title: Plunder
entries.body:
Per the design ruling, Plunder steals the top card of an opponent's deck
straight into your hand (your chosen enemy in multiplayer), stopping
politely when your hand is full. Ghostblade Privateer and Subterfuge
Swindler join the pool with their plundering deathrattles.

entries.title: Morbid
entries.body:
Per the design ruling, Morbid N fires every N creature deaths, anywhere
on the table, repeating forever - built on the ongoing trigger system
with a new repeating counter (ongoing.every) alongside Avenge's
fire-once counter. Triggered grants without a chosen target now bless a
random friendly creature (Vampiric Vandal's every-third-death Lifesteal),
and AI-owned scry/gaze decisions resolve eagerly even when Morbid queues
them off-turn, so nothing stalls waiting on a bot.

Shoreline Spectre and Vampiric Vandal join the pool.

entries.title: Scry, Gaze, and Disguise
entries.body:
Per the design rulings: Scry N peeks at the top of your own deck, Gaze N
does the same to an opponent's, each peeked card going top or bottom.
Decisions resolve through a scry queue - the human gets a modal with the
card faces and top/bottom toggles (first kept card is drawn first), the
AI keeps its own affordable cards and buries the enemy's expensive ones,
and AI turns wait politely if a human decision is pending.

Disguise turns a creature face down as an anonymous 2/2: identity,
tribe, keywords, triggers, statics, auras and deathrattles are all
stowed (aura contributions correctly excluded from the saved stats and
re-applied live to the 2/2), the face renders with a neutral art seed so
the artwork can't leak the identity, opponents' tooltips reveal nothing,
and the owner can pay the card's cost to unmask via a click menu - or
swing with the 2/2 as-is. Aftermath Analyst's deathrattle summons a
random cheap creature already in disguise.

Nine more paper cards join the pool.

entries.title: Quickdraw
entries.body:
Per the design ruling: Quickdraw N draws N cards flagged as Quickdrawn;
any still in hand at the end of your turn shuffle back into your deck,
while played ones stay played. Tooltips mark Quickdrawn cards and the
log notes the shuffle-back.

entries.title: extended auras (keywords, adjacency, position, emblems)
entries.body:
The aura recompute now grants keywords (tracked separately so lapsing
auras never strip native ones), understands adjacency (bonuses re-flow
as the board shifts), leftmost/rightmost positional scoping (Castellan),
and counts emblems and artifacts as aura sources - so quoted-emblem
battlecries like Goru the Mightree's permanent Treefolk +1/+1 outlive
their creator.

Importers gained the matching patterns: "<Tribe>s you control have
+X/+Y & Keyword" (Stormcrusher Woodsman), "Adjacent minions have +N
Attack" (Dire Wolf Alpha, Flametongue Totem), the Cautious and
Castellan aura keywords from the paper glossary, and quoted emblem
auras. Pool: 579.

entries.title: static auras + class-aware deck builder
entries.body:
Auras are live: creatures and enchantments can carry
aura = { attack, health, tribe?, others? } and every board change
recomputes bonuses as deltas on top of base stats and buffs - new
arrivals get buffed immediately, dying or silenced sources retract
their gift, tribe scoping works (Timber Wolf only feeds Beasts), and
losing a +health aura clamps damage so it can never kill. Unlocks
Raid Leader, Stormwind Champion, Timber Wolf, Grimscale Oracle and
paper aura cards; creatures triggered by your hero attacking
(Battlefiend) also work via a new hero-attacked trigger. Pool: 575.

The deck builder now speaks class: a class dropdown (shared with the
game's selection), the collection grid shows only cards your class can
run (neutrals + your class + duals), autofill respects it, and saving
or loading a deck validates class legality - the game falls back to the
demo deck if your saved deck doesn't fit your current class.

entries.title: the class system
entries.body:
The paper set's Class cards become playable identity: pick your class
from the title-bar dropdown (persisted), AI seats roll random classes,
and every player starts with their class's hero power installed in a
power slot. 14 of 16 classes have working starting powers, including
choose-one powers (Priest's Lesser Heal, Ranger's Steward of Trees,
Sorcerer's Spellweaving with tribe-filtered targets and granted
Spellburst/Spell Damage), d4-roll powers (Shaman's Totemic Call, Bard's
Village Performance), Rogue's Dagger Mastery equipping a knife token,
and Death Knight's Ghoul Charge plus the class passive that banks a
Corpse whenever a friendly creature dies. Barbarian and Wizard await
temp-keywords / cost modification.

Demo decks are class-gated per the paper rules: your class pool plus
neutrals, with dual-class cards counting for both. New effect ops:
random-effects (d4 tables), luck (coin flip), add-card, grant-ongoing,
grant-static, tribe-filtered targeting, and summoned tokens can carry
statics (Spell Damage totem).

entries.title: paper set wave 2 (569 cards)
entries.body:
Choose One is real: cards carry branch lists, playing one opens a pick
menu (walker-menu style) before targeting, and the AI takes the first
branch that is targetless or has a live target. New mechanics from the
paper rules: temporary attack buffs that expire at the owner's turn end,
hero temp attack that lets weaponless heroes swing (Feral Rage), the
Corpses resource with gain/spend effects, Mill, Avenge-style counted
triggers (ongoing.need), and triggered hero weapons (after your hero
attacks / attacks a creature / kills a creature - Bone Breaker lives).
Simple triggered enchantments and the set's planeswalkers also import.

14 more paper cards join the pool (569 total). Corpses and hero temp
attack show in the panel gear lines.

entries.title: paper Magepunk set wave 1 (330 cards, 555 total)
entries.body:
First import wave from the OCR'd 1,144-card paper set: all 77 lands
(basics with mana/boost/conjure taps, multicolor lands whose either-or
Boost choices become separate tap-menu entries, named-theme discovery
lands via a new conjure-named effect), vanilla and keyword creatures,
battlecry/deathrattle/trigger creatures, simple sorceries and instants,
and vanilla hero weapons with rune flavor. Paper cards replace colliding
HS imports per design; web originals are protected.

New engine support: Swing (when-this-attacks), Inspire (after hero
power), Spellburst (once per spell), Frenzy (once, on surviving damage),
Connect (combat damage to a player), Constellation (enchantment played),
elusive and piercing keywords (piercing ignores taunts and armor), an
enemy-heroes damage target, and targeted land taps. New paper classes
get body colors, and dual classes (Bard/Ranger) fall back to their
first class's color.

entries.title: land shop, tapping, and card colors (paper rules)
entries.body:
Lands leave decks and packs entirely: click an empty land slot to open
the shop and develop a land for 3 mana, which gives each opponent a coin
(paper rules). Lands now TAP for their abilities - once per turn each,
untapping at the start of your turn, turning sideways when spent. Tap
abilities: gain mana, color Boost rolls (per-color buff tables,
provisional until the paper rules define them), and conjuring colored
cards. Legacy bonus-mana lands synthesize a tap ability from their old
mana field, and on-play land effects still fire on purchase.

Colors: cards can carry W/U/B/R/G identity; colored cards are excluded
from decks, packs, and collections - they only enter play when lands
conjure them from outside the game. The AI buys lands when flush, taps
for mana first, conjures when its hand runs dry, and boosts friendlies.

Groundwork for importing the user's 1,144-card paper Magepunk set.

entries.title: class colors and gallery class filter
entries.body:
Every class gets its own body color on the card frame (13 classes: the
nine imported ones plus Bounty Hunter, Centurion, Naturalist, and
Neutral) while the banner and border keep the type color, so both
dimensions read at a glance. Engine card instances now carry cardClass
so in-play cards render their class too.

The gallery gains a class filter dropdown (populated from the pool,
Neutral last) and tooltips in both the gallery and the game now lead
with the class name.

entries.title: card face overhaul + collection gallery
entries.body:
Card faces are redrawn from scratch (all original procedural art - no
external assets): metallic type-colored frames with rarity pinlines, an
arched oval art window with deterministic per-card generative art (four
composition families seeded by card id), a curved name banner, big mana
gem, rarity gem, and chunky radial-gradient stat plates. Rules text no
longer appears on the face: cards with rules carry an iridescent gem
that slowly cycles the hue wheel (additive glow overlay in the 3D scene,
CSS conic-gradient animation in the gallery), and the rules text lives
in a hover tooltip that never reveals enemy hands or face-down traps.

The gallery is rebuilt as a collection browser: paginated 5x2 book with
mana crystal filters, search, type and rarity dropdowns, owned-count
badges, grayscale unowned cards, and hover zoom + rules tooltip.

entries.title: second classic import wave (39 cards, 253 total)
entries.body:
The ongoing-trigger system now extends to board creatures, unlocking the
whenever/at-style minions: spell-played (Mana Wyrm, Auctioneer, Violet
Teacher, Wild Pyromancer), card-played (Questing Adventurer, Illidan),
summoned (Knife Juggler), self/friendly/any-creature-damaged (Acolyte,
Armorsmith, Frothing + Gurubashi Berserker), creature-died (Flesheating
Ghoul, Cult Master), and turn-start/end minions (Demolisher, Imp Master,
Healing/Mana Tide Totems, Hogger, Ragnaros with Can't Attack). A minion
never triggers on its own arrival, and silence strips triggers and
statics.

New systems: Spell Damage +X statics on creatures boost direct spell
damage (Kobold through Malygos, Bloodmage Thalnos, Azure Drake);
Overload locks mana at the start of the next turn (Dust Devil,
Doomhammer, Earth Elemental, Feral Spirit, Lava Burst...); random
discards (Soulfire, Doomguard, Felstalker) and each-player-draws
(Coldlight Oracle).

entries.title: companion, command zone, emblems, exile + fatigue rework
entries.body:
Every player is dealt a random Companion (bonus creature, playable once
from its zone) and a Commander (returns to the command zone when it dies
and costs 2 more each recast). Both play straight from their zones with
the normal targeting flow and are excluded from decks. The AI deploys
them on curve.

Emblems: permanent effects with no card body, minted by new planeswalker
ultimates (Ironstar -6: 2 damage to a random enemy each turn end; Sable
-7: draw each turn end). They run on the ongoing/static systems and
survive their walker's death.

Exile: Banish to the Badlands removes a creature from the game - no
deathrattle, no graveyard, never reshuffled. Exile counts show in the
panels.

Fatigue reworked per design: reshuffling is free again; fatigue now
fires only when you draw with BOTH deck and graveyard empty, escalating
per missed draw. 214 cards.

entries.title: planeswalkers and fatigue
entries.body:
Planeswalkers (3 original cards): attackable permanents with loyalty.
Once per turn, activate one ability from a click-to-open menu - plus
abilities build loyalty, minus abilities spend it (targeted ones reuse
the spell aiming flow), and the walker dies at 0, whether burned out or
beaten down. Enemy attacks drain loyalty with no counterattack; a
player's taunts shield their walkers like everything else on the slice.
Loyalty shows as a shield badge on the card face. The AI plays walkers,
cashes minus abilities when affordable, ticks up otherwise, and
prioritizes killing enemy walkers after favorable trades.

Fatigue: each graveyard reshuffle increments a counter, and every card
drawn afterwards deals that much damage to the drawing hero. This closes
out the sustain stalemates - the 8-player stress match that previously
ground past turn 1300 now ends around turn 180.

Also fixes cardOf() so clicks resolve cards in every zone (hero power
activation clicks relied on it). 207 cards.

entries.title: enchantments and artifacts (ongoing permanents)
entries.body:
Two unlimited board rows come alive with a persistent trigger system:
permanents carry ongoing = {on, effects} and pulse on turn-start,
turn-end, creature-played, spell-played, or weapon-equipped without
leaving play, plus static passives checked continuously (Lucky
Horseshoe's hero damage reduction). New trigger ops buff-minion and
buff-random-friendly.

10 original cards: 5 enchantments (Rancher's Brand, War Drums, Campfire
Songs, Ghost Town Haunting, Night Market) and 5 artifacts (Lucky
Horseshoe, Sheriff's Badge, Mechanical Deputy, Printing Press, Iron
Safe). Rows render left/right of each slice only when occupied. 204
cards total.

Also fixes a latent crash: summoned tokens that died were reshuffled
from the graveyard into the deck by id, and drawing one (no card def)
crashed the game. Token ids are now filtered out of reshuffles.

entries.title: hero powers and quests
entries.body:
Hero powers (6 original cards): install into 3 slots, then click to
activate for mana once per turn each - damage, healing, tokens, armor,
card draw, or equipping a pistol. Targeted activations reuse the spell
targeting flow; usable powers get the green ring.

Quests (5 original epics): face-up objectives in 3 slots with a live
progress badge on the card face. Goals count summons, spells played,
creature deaths anywhere, land drops, or hero attacks; completing one
cashes out its reward (tokens, draws, armor, or equipping the Golden
Revolver via the new generic equip effect). No duplicate quests.

AI installs and activates powers with leftover mana and runs quests
to completion. 194 cards.

entries.title: traps, lands, and the hide-empty-zones rule
entries.body:
Traps (10 original western cards with lands): face-down cards set into a
3-slot zone; they fire through the same declarative trigger system as
secrets but their presence is public (opponents see card backs, you see
your own face-up). Duplicates allowed. New trigger ops: freeze-attacker,
set-attack.

Lands: 0-cost permanents, one per turn into 5 slots, each paying bonus
mana at the start of your turn on top of the auto-ramp; some have on-play
effects (draw, heal).

Zones only render when occupied - the one exception is the land row,
which always shows its 5 dashed slot outlines per slice (hidden for
eliminated players). 183 cards total.

entries.title: 2-8 player free-for-all on a radial table
entries.body:
The engine now takes a player count: every "the opponent" assumption
(effects, secrets, attacks, AI, win check) generalizes to N seats. Attacks
reach any opponent (taunts only protect their own slice), "the enemy hero"
becomes a chosen target with 3+ players, AoE hits every enemy, secrets
track the damage source, and players are eliminated at 0 life until one
slice remains. The creature row is uncapped, and each player carries the
full zone model from the board design (lands/traps/quests/hero powers/
emblems/companion/command/exile) ready for those card types.

Renderer: each board is a pizza slice rotated around a round table sliced
per player, camera and fog pull back with the count, one projected panel
per opponent doubles as their hero click-target, and a player-count
selector (or ?players=N) sizes the game. AI plays every non-human seat.

entries.title: weapons and secrets
entries.body:
Weapons: new card type with attack/durability; the hero attacks once per
turn (taking the defender's counterattack), durability drops per swing and
the weapon breaks at zero; playing a new weapon replaces the old. Panel
shows the equipped weapon; clicking your own hero panel arms a hero attack.
AI equips, buffs, and swings at good trades or face.

Secrets: hidden one-shot triggers (enemy-attack, enemy-minion-played,
enemy-spell-cast, hero-takes-damage incl. fatal) encoded declaratively per
card; opponent sees only a count; reveal banner on trigger. 13 classic
secrets implemented (traps, counters, redirects, Ice Block).

Importer additions bring 23 new cards (173 total): 4 weapons, 13 secrets,
weapon-synergy battlecries (destroy/buff/gain weapon attack), Shield Block.

entries.title: freeze, silence, and random-target mechanics
entries.body:
- freeze: frozen creatures cannot attack and thaw after missing their
  controller's next turn; freezer keyword freezes whatever the minion
  damages in combat; ice-blue glow + snowflake floaters in the scene
- silence: strips keywords, deathrattles, granted shields/stealth,
  and frozen state (stat changes stay); grey X floater + face refresh
- random-damage effect: N independent hits at random members of a
  pool (enemy creatures / all enemies / all characters), used by the
  split-damage and multi-target spells
- 10 more classic cards join the pool (150 total), including the
