  freeze package, the silence package, and the random-damage spells

Verified headless: freeze blocks and thaws on schedule, a silenced
deathrattle minion dies without its token, split damage totals
exactly, and a full 150-card match runs clean.

entries.title: classic card pool import + generic effect engine
entries.body:
- cards.json grows 35 -> 133: 98 functional cards imported from the
  original Basic+Classic Hearthstone pool via HearthstoneJSON (vanilla
  minions, keyword minions, damage/draw/heal/buff/destroy spells,
  data-driven battlecries, deathrattles, and token summons); rule text
  is generated from our own effect model, no card text copied
- engine.js: generic effect executor shared by spells, battlecries,
  and deathrattles - AoE damage (enemy board / all creatures / all
  enemies / everyone), chosen-target damage/heal/buff/grant/destroy
  with filters (undamaged, max attack), token summons; targetSpec now
  derives targeting from effects arrays; deathrattle field on cards
- ai.js: generic targeting for effect-driven cards (buffs/heals aim
  at own side, removal at the biggest enemy threat)
- collection.js: existing collections get topped up with new starter
  commons/uncommons without touching pack progress

Verified headless: Chillwind Yeti plays, Shattered Sun Cleric buffs,
Harvest Golem leaves its token, full 133-pool match runs clean.

entries.title: 3D pack opening + deck builder + collection economy
entries.body:
- collection.js: card collection, gold (start 300), and deck all in
  localStorage; pack rolls with rarity weights (60/25/10/4/1) and a
  guaranteed rare+ final card; deck rules: 30 cards, max 2 copies,
  legendaries max 1, must own every copy
- packs.html/packs.js: Three.js pack opening - foil booster hovers,
  tears open in a particle burst, five cards fly out face-down and
  flip on click with rarity-colored bursts; epic/legendary pulls get
  a toast; 100 gold per pack
- deck.html/deck.js: collection grid (rarity-striped, own/in-deck
  counts, depleted graying), mana-sorted deck list, validation on
  save, and a 3D hover preview card; double-click the counter to
  auto-fill
- Matches now use your saved deck when valid and pay gold (100 win /
  50 draw / 25 loss); starter collection = 2x commons + 1x uncommons

Verified headless: pack spent 100 gold and delivered 5 pulls (epic +
guaranteed rare) into the collection; deck autofilled to 30 and saved;
the game announced the custom deck; victory paid out.

entries.title: Overworld: item balls, hidden items, berry/fruit trees, rare candy
entries.body:
- items.js (MapItems.lua + MapTrees.lua port): visible item balls from
  ITEM_BALL object_events (script name -> item id), hidden items from
  hidden_item bg_events (Z on/facing the tile), Emerald berry trees
  (berry from the tree id) and Crystal fruit trees (berry_trees.json,
  30 trees); collected/harvested state persists in localStorage;
  balls and trees are solid
- bag.js: name registry for arbitrary picked-up items (berries, TMs,
  key items all display properly), extra known items (great/ultra
  balls, max potions), and RARE CANDY levels a mon from the bag with
  stat recalc + evolution check
- overworld bag lists everything with scrolling

Verified headless: Viridian Forest shows its 4 balls + 2 hidden items,
pickup adds to bag and persists across reload; Route 29 oran tree
gives 2 berries then reads The tree is bare; rare candy Lv5 -> Lv6.

entries.title: Overworld: starter selection, evolution, real catch rates + exp yields
entries.body:
- Fresh saves open a starter picker: all 9 starters across Kanto/
  Johto/Hoenn rows with sprites; chosen starter arrives at Lv5 with
  its real moveset
- evolution.js: post-battle level evolutions with the classic
  flashing-sprite sequence; species/stats/types/sprite swap keeps
  IVs, exp, moves, and damage taken; evolved form persists
- species_extra.json: real per-species catch rates + exp yields from
  dex.json/catchRates.lua, and 406 level evolutions sourced from the
  vendored Showdown pokedex (the games own evolution.lua overrides)
- battle.js now uses real catch rates (Pidgey 255 vs legendary 3) and
  real exp yields instead of the flat/estimated placeholders

Verified headless: fresh save -> picked Totodile Lv5 (Leer/Scratch);
Caterpie won a fight, hit Lv7, evolved into Metapod with recalced
stats, saved to localStorage.

entries.title: Overworld: Pokemon Centers, marts, bag economy, battle items + switching
entries.body:
- services.js: nurse/PC/clerk placed per map id (MapObjects.lua port -
  35 FR-layout centers, 23 Crystal-layout, 26 marts across 3 layouts);
  nurse heals with the classic dialog, counters block movement
- bag.js: money (start $3000) + item inventory in localStorage; Poke
  Ball / Potion / Super / Hyper / Revive; mart shop UI with live wallet
- PC storage: deposit/withdraw between party and box (never strands
  the last mon); overworld bag on B with use-on-party flow
- Battle menu is the real 2x2 (FIGHT/BAG/PKMN/RUN): balls now consume
  inventory, potions/revives usable in battle (foe gets the free
  turn), and manual switching with boost reset + free foe move
- Trainer wins bank prize money through the same wallet

Verified headless: nurse heal at Viridian Center, mart purchases
debit money into the bag, potion in battle heals then foe swings,
PKMN menu switches to the benched mon.

entries.title: Overworld: dialog/interaction + status conditions and move effects
entries.body:
Interaction (Z key):
- dialog.js: GBA text box with pagination/wrapping
- Talk-to trainers battle on interact - gym leaders work now (they are
  TRAINER_TYPE_NONE; trainers.js claims any NPC whose script has a
  roster entry); intro quotes show before the fight; defeated trainers
  repeat their defeat line
- Signs read their real text (858 entries exported from SignTexts.lua)
- NPCs turn to face you; gfx fallback maps OBJ_EVENT_GFX_X -> x.png so
  gym leader sprites resolve

Battle effects:
- Status conditions brn/psn/par/slp/frz: infliction moves, secondary
  chances on ~30 damaging moves, before-move checks (sleep counter,
  thaw, full para, flinch), end-of-turn chip, burn/para stat penalties,
  type immunities, status tags in the info boxes, catch-rate bonus
- Healing (Recover family, Rest), drain, recoil, multi-hit moves
- Accuracy/evasion stages (Sand Attack, Double Team, ...)
- Trainer battles show party dots for the foe team

Verified headless: sign dialog in Pallet Town; Thunder Wave paralyzes
(+full-para skips, Sand Attack miss chain); Double Kick hits twice;
Gym Leader Brock intro-quote -> real Geodude/Onix team.

entries.title: Overworld: trainer battles - sight lines, walk-up, rosters, persistence
entries.body:
- trainers.js: sight-range trainers from object_events (walls block the
  view; SEE_ALL_DIRECTIONS supported); ! bubble then FireRed-pace
  walk-up to the player; defeated set persists in localStorage and
  defeated trainers never re-engage; beaten trainers stand as NPCs
- trainers.json: 1,681 rosters parsed from the decomp + pokecrystal +
  hand-crafted gym leaders (names, classes, parties, defeat lines),
  plus class pools/names and per-map level baselines for fallback teams
- battle.js trainer mode: multi-mon foes with send-out messages, exp
  per KO, no running or catching, defeat text + prize money (banked in
  localStorage)
- npcs.js hands sight-range trainers over to trainers.js; sight check
  runs before grass encounters on each step

Verified headless: Bug Catcher Rick spots the player in Viridian
Forest, walks up, fights Weedle then Caterpie from his real FR roster,
pays $48, stays defeated across reloads.

entries.title: Overworld: exp, level-ups, catching, party menu - wild loop complete
entries.body:
- Victory grants EXP (yield estimated from base stat total, medium-fast
  curve); level-ups recalc stats from stored IVs, carry HP delta, and
  learn new level-up moves (auto-replace oldest when full)
- BALL in the battle menu: Gen3 shake-check catch formula (flat rate
  190 until per-species catch rates are sourced); caught mon joins the
  party (max 6) or goes to the localStorage box
- Party auto-sends the next healthy mon when one faints; defeat only
  when the whole party is down
- P opens a party menu in the overworld: HP bars, make-lead swap
- party.js: IV/exp migration for older saves, box storage

Verified headless: fight -> 42 EXP -> grew to Lv11 with stat recalc;
caught a RATTATA that joined the party; menu swap made it lead.

entries.title: Overworld: battle core - real wild battles replace the encounter card
entries.body:
- battle.js: Gen3 damage math (STAB, crits, 18-type chart, 0.85-1.0
  roll), stat stages with common status moves (Growl/Leer/Harden/...),
  priority+speed turn order, accuracy, run-away formula, wild AI;
  GBA battle scene (front/back sprites, HP bars with easing, message
  queue, FIGHT/RUN menu, 2x2 move menu with PP)
- buildMon ports pokemonBuilder.lua: random IVs, zero EVs, Gen3 stat
  formula, moveset = last 4 level-up moves at level
- party.js: party persisted in localStorage; starter Charmander Lv10;
  blackout heals; victories save damage taken
- encounters.js now just rolls (grass -> rate -> weighted slot) and
  hands off to the battle
- data: species_battle.json (1,364 mons: stats/types/learnsets),
  moves_battle.json (882 moves), 1,345 back sprites

Verified headless: forced + natural wild battles fight to victory via
real key input, party HP persists to localStorage, zero page errors.

entries.title: Overworld: NPCs from object_events + wild encounters
entries.body:
- npcs.js: renders map object_events with the FR people sprite sheets
  (70 gfx mappings), wander/face/look-around movement honoring
  movement_range, collision vs map/player/each other; NPCs with
  hide-flags stay hidden; sprites y-sorted with the player
- encounters.js: authentic trigger chain (step onto MB_TALL_GRASS ->
  encounterRate roll -> weighted slot -> level range) using all 329
  encounter maps parsed from encounter_data.lua; GBA-style screen
  flash into an encounter card with the species front sprite
  (placeholder until the battle engine port)
- export_web_data.py additions: people sprites, 1,592 Pokemon front
  sprites, gfx_map.json, encounters.json, species_index.json (from
  the design wiki data)

Verified headless: Pallet Town NPCs wander within ranges; Route 1
grass triggered a wild Lv 3 PIDGEY card with sprite; Z-dismiss works.

entries.title: Web-native overworld engine (phase 1 of the Love2D-to-web port)
entries.body:
- overworld/engine.js: Canvas2D port of the Lua map system - tileset
  name mangling, 16 palette bands, primary/secondary metatile split by
  tile capacity, flips, COVERED layer handling, border pattern fill,
  map connections, grid-bit collision, behaviors, ledge hops
- overworld/main.js: game loop, held-key grid movement (120 px/s,
  FireRed walk anim), centered camera, warps (incl. Crystal -1
  back-warp), seamless connection crossing with re-anchoring
- overworld/data/: 28MB exported by tools/export_web_data.py - maps,
  layouts, tilesets, metatiles, player sprite; lazy-loaded per map
  (a few files per map instead of the 38MB love.js blob)

Verified pixel-perfect in headless Edge across all three regions:
Pallet Town + Route 1 crossing + house warp (FireRed), New Bark Town
and Violet City (crystal-native Johto), Littleroot Town (Emerald).

entries.title: playable Three.js card game vs AI
entries.body:
- engine.js: rules engine ported from the Lua module (ramping mana,
  summoning sickness, taunt/charge/rush/stealth/divine shield/first
  strike/windfury/trample/lifesteal/deathtouch, battlecries,
  deathrattles, end-of-turn triggers, coin, graveyard reshuffle)
  plus scripted mechanics the Lua version left as text-only
- ai.js: greedy opponent (curve plays, removal at threats, favorable
  trades, honors taunt, lethal checks, coins when it unlocks a play)
- game.js: Three.js table - hand fan, boards, attack lunges, floating
  combat text, death animations, targeting mode, ring highlights
- cardart.js: shared canvas card faces; old browser moved to viewer.html

Verified headless: 12 engine-driven rounds to victory + real-click UI
turn vs the AI, zero page errors.

entries.title: Add playable Magepunk66 web build + Battlecards 3D prototype
entries.body:
- magepunk/: the full game compiled to WebAssembly with love.js
  (compat build; 38MB game.data, boots to Pallet Town in-browser)
- battlecards/: Three.js prototype rendering the game's cards.json
  as 3D cards (canvas-generated faces, tilt, flip, browse)
- Homepage links to both + the design wiki
